prakāśakasya nivedanam |

manyāmahahe, aho bhāgyamasmākaṃ yat ayaṃ ṣaṣṭho'pi bhāgaḥ viśvavikhyātayaśasā pariṇataprajñena mahādārśanikena paurastyapāścātyobhayatattvadarśaneṣu niṣṇātena bhāratasaṃgharājyasya dvitīyena rāṣṭrapatinā śrīmadrādhākṛṣṇamahodayena mahatā saṃrambheṇa prakāśanagocaratāmaya nīyate |
gurucaraṇanirmitasyāsya bhāgasya saṃskāraḥ gurucaraṇāntevāsinā mīmāṃsābhūṣaṇena tapaḥsvādhyāyaniratena āhitāgninā tāmravedyupākhyena dattātreyaśāstriṇā saṃpāditaḥ |
asya ṣaṣṭhabhāgasya yathāpūrvaṃ mudritapariśodhanādi sūkṣmekṣikayā dharmakośasya kāryakārisaṃpādakena śrīraṅganāthaśāstriṇā nirvartitam |
śrīraṅganāthaśāstriṇaḥ etādṛśakārya- nirvartanasāmarthyaṃ gurucaraṇānāmapi viśvāsa āsīt |
nyūnātiriktadoṣaparihārāya gurubhistena saha punaḥpunaḥ vimarśo'pi kṛto'sti |
granthaguṇavattāsaṃpattāveva śrīraṅganātha- śāstriṇaścittasamādhānamityasmākamapi cirakālīno'nubhava iti tasminviśvambhya dharmakośa- kāryamapi vayaṃ saṃcālayāmaḥ |

atha: na vidyate, prayogakāle artho na vidyate iti yāvat ' iti kutūhalam |
atra ' yeṣāṃ tatpattau sve prayoge na vidyate ' iti pāṭhaṃ prakalpya artha brūmo vayam |
utpattau ' somena yajeta ' ityādyutpattivākye ' yeṣāṃ śabdānāṃ svai. svīye prayoge prayogakāle uccāraṇakāle rūpopalabdhiḥ iti pūrvasūtrādanuvartate rūpasya vācyatvasya upalabdhiḥ jñānaṃ na vidyate ' yat utpannamātraṃ vinaśyati. tāni tadarthavācakāni padāni ākhyātāni ākhyātaśabdavācyāni syuḥ |
ityādi sarvapeṣu samānam |
tasmāt tebhyaḥ ākhyāta- śabdebhyaḥ yajeta ityevamādibhyaḥ kriyā kārya apūrva pratīyeta pratītaṃ syāt |
tāni apūrvabodhakāni padāni |
āśritatvāt prayogasya iti apūrvabodhakatve yuktya- ntaramucyate |
prayogasya prayujyamānatvāt arthasya bhāvanā saha ekaṃ padaṃ āśritatvāt |
ekapadaśrutyā dhātvarthasyaiva bhāvanākaraṇatvāt tasmādeva kriyā apūr
karmaṇā vinā |
bhavatyarthasya karttā ca karoteḥ karma jāyate |
karoternityaṃ sakarmakatvāt yāvat kriyamāṇaṃ na labhyate, na tāvadarthaḥ paryavasyati |
sarvakāraṇāṃ cāvāntara- kriyāsu kartṛtvaṃ pratipādyamānānāṃ pradhānakriyāsu karmādi- vibhāge jāyate |
pratikriyaṃ yogyatābhedādavāntarakriyā- vaicitryaṃ bhavati |
tatrānvayavyatirekāmyāmidamavagatam, bhavatikriyāyāḥ karttā karoteḥ karma saṃpadyate iti |
tathā- hi - 'nityaṃ na bhavanaṃ yasya yasya vā nityabhūtā |
na tasya kriyamāṇatvaṃ svapuṣpākāśyoriva |
' yaḥ eva hi prapañcamavanaḥ saṃbhāvitabhavano vā'nyena prayujyate, sa eva kriyamāṇatvenāpyavagamyate nānyaḥ |
tathāca na kaścit svapuṣpākāśāṃ vā kartuṃnyalpayate |
yatrāpi 'pādī kuru' ityādiṣu niṣṭhānāṃ karmatvaprayogo dṛśyate tatrāpi aniṣpannasaṃskārādivivakṣayā pādādiśabdamyogādavyabhi- cāraḥ |
satyapi ca karoternikārthatve sarvatra gandhanāvakṣepaṇādau kasmiṃścittpattipadasāmānyāmidamavagamyate |
athavā yadā asyotpādanāmādhāyitvaṃ tadaiva viśiṣṭāsyātasāmānyādhi- karaṇyaṃ dṛṣṭamiti tadatyotpādyamānameva karma bhavatītyupapa- nnam |
tena bhavatikriyā tāvallavdhā |
tataśca 'karotyarthasya yaḥ karttā bhavatiḥ sa prayojakaḥ |
bhavitā tamepakṣyatha prayojyatvaṃ prapadyate |
' bhavatikkarotyoḥ śaktibhedāt viklidipacyoriva niyataṃ prayojyaprayojakavyāpāravacana- tvam |
tatra ca kadācidabhidhīyamānakarmaśaktyā''- kṣitaprayojyavyāpāre vā (ghaṭaṃ karotītyādau dvitīyābhi- hitayā karmākhyayā śaktyā ākṣitaḥ prayojyasya ghaṭasya, bhavanākhyo vyāpāro yasya dhātostadarthaḥ |
karotimātraprayoge kathaṃ ākṣepa ityāśaṅkāyāmāha - svayameveti |
ghaṭo bhavatītyādau prathamābhihitakartṛtvākṣisaḥ prayojyavyāpāre yasmin ityarthaḥ |
tathā ca prayojyaprayojakavyāpāroranya- taravācidhātuṣu itarapratīteḥ ākṣepeṇeveti na tasminni śabdavyāpārakalpanāvasara iti bhāvaḥ :) svayamevākṣita- prayojyavyāpāre vā kevalaṃ prayojakavyāpāra eva vivakṣyate 'kaṭaṃ karoti, odanaṃ pacati' iti |
kadācidākṣita- prayojakavyāpāraṃ prayojyavyāpāramātraṃ 'ghaṭo bhavati, viklidyanti taṇḍulāḥ' iti |
kadācidubhau micau samu- ccitya prayogaḥ, 'karoti kaṭaṃ devadattaḥ sa ca bhavati' |
kadācit upasarjanabhūtaprayojakavyāpāraḥ prayojyavyāpāraḥ 'kriyate devadattena' iti 'svayameva' iti vā prayoge |
kadācidapunaḥ samānapadaikadeśopāttapasarjanabhūtaprayojyakriyaḥ prayojakavyāpāro vivakṣyate, tadā ca karotipacyostādā- tmyena adhākṣeḥ aprayogatāt bhūviklidyośca kevalaprayojya- kriyāniṣṭhatvān sākṣātpravartituṃ śaktirastīti vācakatvena dyotakatvena vā ṇic aparaḥ prayujyate bhāvayati viklideya- tīti ca |
tathā cā''ha 'prayojyakartṛkaikāntavyāpāra- pratipādakāḥ |
ṇyantā eva prayujyante tanmayayojaka- karmasu |
' na ca teṣāmapyantānāmaśaktirityeṣāmāśaktyā bhavitavyam |
anyeṣāṃ vā śaktiḥ ityeṣāmapi tadvadravi- tavyam |
kṛtaḥ |
'śaktayaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ nānuyogyāḥ svabhāvataḥ |
tena nānā vadantyarthān prakṛti- pratyayādayaḥ |
' evaṃ karotyarthadvāreṇa sarvakhyāteṣu bhāvyathaiḥ siddhaḥ |
'tena bhūtiṣu kartṛtvaṃ prati- pannasya vastunaḥ |
prayojakakriyāmāhurbhavanāṃ bhāva- nāvidaḥ |
' yasūkaṃ na vidhitvatirikte liḍādayo'thai vadantīti |
tadyuktam |
kutaḥ ? 'abhidhābhāvanā- māhuranyameva liḍādayaḥ |
arthātmabhāvanā tvanyā sarvākhyāteṣu gamyate |
' yadā hi sarvākhyātānu- vartinī karotidhātuvācyā puruṣavyāpārarūpā bhāvanā avagatā bhavati, tadā tadviśeṣāḥ sāmānyavyākhyātayati- riktaśabdaviśeṣavācyā vidhipratiṣedhabhūtabhaviṣyadmānā- dayaḥ pratīyante |
tathā ca sarvatra sāmānyataḥ karotyartho- 'vagamyate 'kiṃ karoti ? pacati' ? 'kimakarmārpitu ? apākṣīt' 'kiṃ kariṣyati ? pakṣyati' 'kiṃ kuryāt ? pacet' 'kiṃ na kuryāt ? na pacet' iti |
tatrārthātma- kāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ liḍādiśabdānāṃ yaḥ puruṣaṃ prati prayojaka- vyāpāraḥ sā dvitīyā śabdadharmaḥ abhidhātmikā bhāvanā vidhirityucyate |
viśeṣataśceyamarthādhikaraṇe varṇitā |
yattu paryāyāsthitilabdhan pratyayāparipādihitam |
tatrocyate 'kevalasyāprayogatvāt kartṛsaṃkhyādisaṃga- hāt |
rūpāvināśasiddheśca pratyayo'pi prayujyate |
' yadi hi kevalaḥ karotibhavatirvā prayogāhaiḥ syātām,
tataḥ kokilaśabdaprayoge pikāśabdavat pratyayo na prayujyeta, na tu kevalayāḥ prakṛteḥ prayogaḥ, |
apabhraṃśatvaprasaṅgāt |
tena yasmin kasmiṃścit pratyaye prayoktavye yasyaivāthaiḥ kathyate sa evānuvādabhūtaḥ prakṛtyanugrahāthai prayujyate, nānya 'pyadhikāthaintarāpattiprasaṅgāt |
nanu ca, 'ikdatipau dhātunirdeśe' vihitau atastaduktau karotibhāvayatī prayu- jyetām |
naitadasti |
tathā sati śabdapadārthakalpanācaiva tābhyāmākhyātāthaiḥ kathyeta |
yattu kacidapi dhātu- mikuditavat prayujyate yajiḥ, yajatiḥ, iti ca, tat śabda- abhihite lakṣaṇyā arthapratītirityavagantavyam |
na ceha kiñcillakṣaṇaśravaṇe prayojanamasti, yenāvācakaḥ prayujyeta |
tatrāpyadeva aniṣṭamāpadyeta, kumuvau dhāttu tiṅā abhi- dhīyete iti |
tasmādarthaparatvātsiddhayarthamākhyātāpratyayasahitā- veva prayujyete |
yadi ca bhāvanekaikā pratyayārthaḥ syāt karotibhāvayatī vā samastapratyayāthaiaupādānasamarthā bhavetām, tataḥ kevalaprayogo'pi syācchrayeta, na tu tadubhayamapyastīti karotibhāvayatībhyāṃ kathyate'pi bhāvanāthaiṃ kartṛsaṃkhyādi- pratyayāthaiṃ punaḥ pratyayaḥ uccāryate |
yastu tatra bhāvanā- bhidhānāṃśaḥ sa prāptatvāducyate, anyathā hi bhāvanai- vaikā pratyayāthaiḥ, karotibhāvayatī vā kartṛsaṃkhyādīnāmapi abhidhāyakatvamiti bhrāntiḥ syāt |
nityaṃ ca pūrvāparī- bhūtā bhāvanā ākhyātenocyate |
tatra yadi pratyayāntaṃ prayujyate tataḥ karotibhāvayatībhyāṃ dravyadupasaṃhṛtatvopa- mānā naivā''khyātāsadṛśī kathyeta |
tasmādavaśyaṃ tadapi prayoktavyamiti |
kiñca - 'bhāvanā gamyamānā ca dhātu- pratyayasaṃnidhau |
kasya vācyeti vispaṣṭaṃ na kadācit pratīyate |
' yadi hyantena asyāḥ pratyayāthaitvamava- dhāyeta, tataḥ karotibhāvayatībhyāṃ pratyayapaunaruktyācchā syāt, na tu tadasti, ubhayasaṃnidhau gamyamānatvāt |
kevalaprakṛtipratyayayogābhāvādi na viveko vijñāyate |
śakyate hi vaktu dhātusahitena pratyayenocyate iti, athavā pratyayānugṛhītena dhātunā, athobhayābhyām |
na ca śaktikalpanāyāṃ viśeṣaḥ, sarvathā arthāpattisāmyāt |
na ca vivekajñānaprayojanamasti |
syādetat, kṛdantādyatora- pratīteḥ tiṅ vyabhicāriṇyeveti |
taduktam |
asti- vidyatibhivatipareṣu pratyayeṣvapyadarśanāt |
na vā kṛdanteṣva- pyatyantaṃ bhāvanā nāsti, kiñcidupakṛpyamāṇarūpapratīteḥ |
kṛtyeṣu tāvat bhoktavyam, yakṣyatīti kiñcinnyūnā ākhyātādabhyate |
tatrāpi karmopeṣu dravyābhidhānāt 'brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ' iti bhāvotyabhebhyo nyūnatarā |
nahi tatra prayojyavyāpāramādhānānyam, ekatra dhātavarthādhānyā- daparatra svavyāpāraviśiṣṭaprayojyaparatvāt |
etena bhāva- karmopalakṣaṇakāritā''de'pi vyākhyātāḥ |
teṣvapi hi prayojyavyāpāraguṇatvapratītirviśiṣṭā |
ato na tiṅantānāṃ tulyakalpatvam |
tathā 'avyayakṛto bhāve bhavanti' iti smaraṇāviśeṣe'pi svasaṃvedyamīpannyūnabhāvanāvijñānam |
'abhigrāmaṃ juhoti' 'darbhatarukenopaghāta juhoti' 'abhiputya hutvā bhakṣyanti' 'purā vācaḥ pravaditoḥ' iti sarvatra śrutyaiva bhāvanantarāpekṣā bhāvanā avagamyate |
pakkaḥ pakvānityapi nirvṛtturūpabhāvānopasarjanadravyapratītiḥ pratyakṣā |
evaṃ pācakadādiṣvapi draṣṭavyam |
tathā ca sarvatra kārakāpekṣā dṛśyate |
anyathā hi ruditadravitasamāseṣviva iyaṃ na syāt |
na ca niṣpārāṇāmate vyapadeśa bhavanti |
na cāsti sa vyāpāraḥ, yatra kiñcidaśaṃ janyate |
tataśca siddhaḥ karotibhāvayatyorthaḥ |
śakyate ca sarvatra sāmānā- dhikaraṇyamapi darśayituṃ vinā'pi pūrvāparībhūtatvena |
tadyathā 'kiṃ kartavyam ? paktavyam' 'kathaṃkāraṃ juhoti ? abhigrāmam' 'kiṃ kṛtvā juhoti ? abhiputya' 'kiṃ kṛtavān ? pakvān' 'kiṃ kṛtam ? pakkam' 'kiṃkriyau devadattaḥ ? paktā' 'kathaṃ kriyā ? pākaḥ' iti |
na ca karotisāmānādhikaraṇyatirikte ākhyāte'pi bhāvanā- pramāṇaṃ vidyate |

'bhavanti kecit karmaśabdāḥ : ' yāgo yajanaṃ ijyā ityādāharttavye tatsāmānādhikaraṇyasiddhaye'naikikādudāharaṇaṃ yāgādikaraṇavaccodanātparatkālabhāvi karmaśadatvena pāra- tantryāt sujñānam |
svatantraṇāṃ kathañcidapi bhāvārthavā- śaśabdā''saṃbhavāt |
yāgādyo hi svātantryeṇāpi kadā- cidanāvāt na karmaśabdāḥ : ' yathā bhāvayetyuyāditi codāharaṇam |
bhūyādayastu prayojyavyāpāravacanatvāccaiva yathāvarṇitabhāvāvārthaṃ ityanudāharaṇam |
tatra yathākathañcit ṇijantayutpatyā bhāvaśabda eko nīyata, netaro |
tāvapi tu prayojyavyāpāreṇa kathañcit bhāvārtha- vityudāhṛtau |
athavā dvitīyasūtrārthavyākhyānena bhāvanā- prayojanatvamaṃśavācitve nāstīti vinā'pi sakṣatyābhi- dhānādvyavanti bhāvārthāḥ |
kathaṃ punaramī na karmaśabdāḥ : yadā dhātumātraṃ karmaśabtvenoktam, nirviśeṣasya sāmānya- syānuṣṭhānaśakyatvāt akarmaśabdatvam |
ato viśeṣa- vācinameva dhātunāṃ karmaśabdatvagrahaṇādanyadyotyametat |
yadi hi śyenacitradarśapūrṇamāsaśabdāḥ phalaiḥ saṃbandhvena tato yāgakaraṇatvābhāvāt tatsāmānādhikaraṇyanimittanāmadheyatvā- nuṣapatteḥ prasiddhayādibhirguṇavidhitvameva syāt, ataḥ 'sthite etasminnadhikaraṇe' ityāha |
kasmātpunaridaṃ tatraiva na nītam ? pramāṇalakṣaṇenāsaṃbandhāt |
atha nāma- dheyatvaṃ kasmādatra nā''nīyate ? bhedalakṣaṇāsaṃbandhāt |
tasmādatranyāsameva sthitayoryāt paurvāparyasiddheḥ |
'na caipāmarthinā' iti phalapadābhiprāyam |
'vibhaktiṣvāt' iti |
saṃbandhanimittārthāt vibhaktivibhagāt athavā niṣpannābhidhāyivibhaktiviśeṣayogo vibhakti- tvam |

bhāṣyam-- evaṃ cet bhavān paśyati, abhāva- śabdatvācca dravyaguṇaśabdā apūrvasya vidhāyakatvā iti sarveṣāṃ bhāvo'rthaḥ |
svargakāmo darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiteyoḥ saṃbandhaṃ ' yajeta ' iti vakṣyati, ' dravyenābhicaran ' ityetayośca |
tathā ' citrayā paśukāmaḥ ' iti |
tasmādete'pi sākāṅkṣa- tvād bhāvavacanāḥ |
sarveṣu bhāvavacaneṣu nāsti vini- gamanāyāṃ hetuḥ, kathaṃśabdā apūrvasya vidhāyakāḥ, na dravyaguṇaśabdā iti |

na ca dhātoḥ svatat syānnāmno vā parataḥ samam |
yadi hi bhāvanākhyasyaivārthasya pratipādaka- miṣyate dhātorvā pratyayanirāpekṣasya, tato nāmapakṣo durbalaḥ syāt, iha tu yathaiva dhātoḥ pratyayasaṃbandhānugṛhītasya bhāvanāñjananimittaṃ karaṇāvitvaṃ bhavati, evaṃ nāma- padasyāpītyaviśeṣaḥ |
yeṣāmupattau sve prayoge rūpopalabdhistāni nāmāni, tasmāttebhyaḥ parākāṅkṣā bhūtatvāt sve prayoge |
bhāṣyam-- yeṣāṃ śabdānāṃ uccāraṇotthau sve'rthe prayujyamānānāṃ rūpamupalabhyate, yat sakṛdutpannaṃ kālāntaraṃ tiṣṭhati, na kriyeva utpannamātraṃ vinaśyatītyarthaḥ |
tāni nāmāni |
te dravyaguṇaśabdāḥ |
īdṛśo dravyaguṇaśabdā- nāmarthaḥ |
te dravyaguṇaśabdā iti vaktavye, tāni nāmānīti sūtritam |
atho nāmānītyeṣāṃ paryāyaśabdaḥ |
kathaṃ gamyate ? yata eṣāṃ vibhaktayo nāmikya ucyante |
katamāstāḥ ? vṛkṣaḥ vṛkṣau vṛkṣāḥ, śuklaḥ śuklo śuklāḥ ityevamādayaḥ |
tasmāt samyak sūtritam |
yataḥ eṣāṃ na kṣaṇiko'rthaḥ, tatastebhyaḥ parākāṅkṣā pradhānākāṅkṣā na vidyate, iti naipāmupattiḥ kartavyā, bhūtatvāt sve prayoge svaprayogakāle vidyamānatvāditi |
vā-- yaduktaṃ yadaikādaśapūrva tadetattaratartha bhaviṣyatīti tadvāt tāvat vastudharmeṇa viśeṣaṃ darśayati |
katham ? ' bahuṣṭaprasaṅgāddhi dharmo neṣṭaḥ padepade |
nāmnaḥ phalena saṃbandhe parihāro na tasya ca |
' ekasmā-
dahaṣṭe kalpite yadītarad dṛṣṭārthatvena tādarthyaṃ bhajate, tato lāghavaṃ labhyate |
asya tu tādarthyasiddhaye tato'pi punardṛṣṭaṃ kalpyate eva, tato varaṃ phalena sarvāṇi saṃbandhāni |
na ca saṃbandhapairūpyakleśaśrayaṇam, nāmnaśca phalasaṃbandhe avaśyaṃ dhātvarthastadanugrahādau'bhyupagantavyaḥ |
sa ca svayaṃ niṣpādyaḥ siddharūpasya nāmārthasya na śaknoti dṛṣṭenopakartum |
nahi nāmārthastamapekṣate, śabdaprayogavelāyāmeva niṣpanna- tayā gamyamānatvāt apekṣaṇīyasya vā siddhatvenāyoga- tvāt prayujyate'sminniti vābhidheye eva prayogaḥ |
tadādhāraiva hi niṣpannarūpopalakṣitaḥ anutpannate kriyā- rūpasya vaktavye vināśitvapradarśanaṃ niṣpannasyāpi kṣaṇikatvena punaḥpunarniṣadhyapekṣopapatteḥ |
tebhyaḥ parākāṅkṣā anyākāṅkṣā, niṣpādyatvena vā pradhānākāṅkṣā na vidyate ityadhyā- hāraḥ |
ayanā tebhyaḥ parā dare, ākāṅkṣetyarthaḥ |
kutaḥ ? bhūtatvādeveti |
svarūpakathanābhyupayastaṃ niṣpannatvādeveti |
punaste tadeva hetutvenoditaṃ sūtrakāreṇa |
yeṣāṃ tūpattāvarthe sve prayogo na vidyate tānyā- khyātāni, tasmāttebhyaḥ pratīyate''śritatvāt prayogasya |
bhāṣyam-- yeṣāṃ tu śabdānāmuccāraṇotthau sve'rthe prayogo na vidyate |
prayogakāle yeṣāmartho nopalabhyate ityarthaḥ |
tānyākhyātānīti bhāvaśabdān paryāyaśabde- nopadiśati |
kathaṃ paryāyaśabdā bhāvaśabdānām |
yata eṣāṃ vibhaktayaḥ ākhyātikya ityucyante |
katamāstāḥ ? pacati pacantaḥ pacanti ityevamādayaḥ |
tasmāt tebhyo- 'pūrva pratīyeta |
bhavyārthāste bhūtārthaiḥ samucaritāḥ |
bhūtasya bhavyārthatāyāṃ dṛṣṭārthatā, bhavyārthasya prayojanavataḥ utpattirarthavatī |
sā ca bhūtena kriyate iti dṛṣṭo'rthaḥ |
bhavyasya punarbhūtārthatāyāṃ na kiñcid dṛśyate, kalpyate cādṛṣṭam |
tasmān yāgo dravyārthaḥ |
kiñca āśrita- tvāt prayogasya |
eteṣāṃ prayogaḥ puruṣeṇa āśrito bhavati, puruṣasaṃbaddhā bhāvanā ucyate |
puruṣaṃ hi vadati bhāvayediti |
tena ' svargakāmo yajeta ' iti puruṣo'pi pratīyate, yāgo'pi, saṃbandho'pi |
' svargakāmo dravyeṇa ' iti dravyaṃ pratīyate puruṣa, na tu saṃbandhaḥ |
nanu etaduktaṃ bhavati, arthinaśca dravyasya ca saṃbandhaṃ yaje- teti vakṣyati, dravyeṇa bhāvayediti, ato dravyeṇārthasya bhāvanā gamyate, ākāṅkṣā ceti |
satyaṃ gamyate |
dravyeṇa bhāvayediti tu vākyena, yāgena bhāvayediti tu śrutyā |
yadā tu, yāgena bhāvayediti yāgasaṃbandho vidhī- yate, na tadā dravyeṇa bhāvayediti dravyasaṃbandhaḥ |
na ca dravyasaṃbandhe vidhīyamāne yajetetyanena |
anūdyamāne tu saṃbhavati |
na ca yaugapadyena vidhyanuvādau saṃbhavataḥ |
tasmāt śrutivākyayorvirodhaḥ |
virodhe ca śrutirbalīya- sī |
tenāthinā na dravyasaṃbandhaḥ |
tatra dravyamasti svargākāsaṃbandhe svargārtha bhaviṣyatītyanupapannam |
eṣa vinigamanāyāṃ hetuḥ, yena bhāvaśabdā apūrvasya nodakāḥ |
na dravyaguṇaśabdā iti |
yadā yāgena kuryāditi, tadā yāgavacanameva bhavati darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiti lakṣaṇayā, darśaṃ ca pūrṇamāse ca yāgo vihita iti |

tasmin phalavatīṣṭe tu nāmno dṛṣṭārthate- pyate |
' dhātvarthastāvat prakṛtyaiva sādhyatveno viśe- ṣaḥ |
tastu ākhyātatvena dhātunā ucyamānaḥ |
sa yadi phalasādhanatvena cocyate, tato'siddharūpatasya sādhanā- kāṅkṣāyāṃ satyāṃ nāmapadaṃ guṇavidhitvena nāmeyatvena vobhayathā'pi dṛṣṭenaiva tādarthyaṃ labhate |
nanu nāma- dheyapakṣe nāmapadampi sādhyārtha bhaviṣyatīti dhātututyaṃ syāt |
na, tasya phalasattve guṇavidhitvena siddhārtha- tvāt |
api ca ' sādhyātmaka''pi dhātvartho yadā nāmnā'''bhidhīyate |

abhidhānakṛtā cāsa- kāṅkṣotpattirna vastukṛtā |
tasmādyuktā dhātorevā''- kāṅkṣā, na nāmna iti |
kiñcā'''śritatvādyogasya ' puruṣavyāpārātmikāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ dhātvarthatve'pi puruṣeṇa āśritaḥ tadatikramahetutvācca na nāmapada- grahaṇam |
tasmādasti viśeṣaḥ |
śā-- yadā ekaṃ ( apūrva ) tadā saṃdehaḥ kiṃ bhāvaśabdebhyaḥ, uta dravyaguṇaśabdebhya iti |
tadarthaṃ ca kiṃ bhāvārthāḥ phalena saṃbadhyante, kiṃvā dravyaguṇaśabdā iti |
tatra anadhyavasāyameva kecit ( prābhākarāḥ ) pūrvapakṣamāhuḥ |
taduktam |
tathā hi aprāmāṇyameva syāt, taccāyuktam |
tathā sati pramāṇalakṣaṇe evāyaṃ vicāraḥ syāt na tviha, siddhatvāt prāmāṇyasya |
nanu pakṣadvaye'pi anuṣṭhānasya ekarūpatvena adhyavasitatvāt nāprāmāṇyam |
mūrkhalapitametat |
yadi pakṣadvaye'pi kaścit anuṣṭhāne viśeṣaḥ, kimarthamadhikaraṇam |
api ca pūrvapakṣe dayenādīnāṃ guṇavidhitvāt dayenadravyeṇa yaṣṭavyam, siddhānte tu nāmadheyatvāt somena yaṣṭavyaṃ ityasti viśeṣaḥ |
yathā āha bhāṣyakāraḥ : ' sthite eta- sminnadhikaraṇe guṇavidhiranāmadheyamiti vicāraḥ : ' ( bhā. pṛ. 386 ) iti |
yatra tu na siddhānte'pi nāmadheyaṃ yathā ' somena yajeta ' iti, tatra pratinidhisadasadbhāvaḥ prayojanam |
tadapyāha bhāṣyakāraḥ : ( bhā. pṛ. 405 ) ' yadi dravyaguṇaśabdāḥ apūrvaṃ bodhayanti, dravyaguṇāpacāre na pratinidhirāpādyato yathā pūrvapakṣaḥ, yathā tarhi siddhāntaḥ, dravyaṃ guṇaṃ vā pratinidhiāya prayogo'nu- ṣṭhātavyaḥ ' iti ( bhā. 2|1|16 pṛ. 405 ) |
tasmāt prasajyate eva aprāmāṇyamiti naivaṃ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
kintu dravyādibhyaḥ apūrvam, te eva phalasādhanamiti |
kutaḥ ? ' phalaṃ hi sādhyamānatvāt siddhaṃ sādhanamicchati |
dravyādi ca tathā, yāgaḥ svayaṃ sādhyo, na sādha- nam |
' iti prāpte, abhīdhīyate |
' bhāvanaiva hi bhāvyena phalenānyetumarhati |
dhātvarthaḥ karaṇaṃ tasyāṃ lāghavāt saṃnikarṣataḥ |
' soma-- sūtrārthastu- bhāvārthāḥ pratyayena bhāvanā- pratipādakāḥ |
prakṛtyā karmavacanāḥ ye śabdāḥ tebhyaḥ apūrvaṃ pratīyate |
yadā bhāvārthāḥ bhāvanāprayojakāḥ ye karmaśabdāḥ dhātavaḥ tebhyaḥ apūrvaṃ pratīyate iti |
prayojanam-- yadi dravyaguṇaśabdāḥ apūrvaṃ pratipāda- yantīti pakṣaḥ, tadā dravyādīnāmadṛṣṭārthatvāt adṛṣṭārthasya pratinidhyabhāvāt na pratinidhiḥ |
yadā tu bhāvaśabdebhyaḥ

bhāvanā pratīta- mātraiva prādhānyāt arthāntarānadhīnatvāt prathamaṃ tāvat sādhyāgramapekṣate ' kiṃ ' iti |
na ca buddhipūrva- kārī puruṣaḥ puruṣārtharahitaṃ vyāpāraṃ vacanaśatenāpyuktaḥ anutiṣṭhati |
tatra yadi asyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ apuruṣārthaḥ sādhyaḥ syāt tataḥ puruṣeṣu apravartamāneṣu pratyayasya prayojakaśaktiḥ bādhyate |
tena yadyapi samānapado- pādānapratyayasattve dhātvarthaḥ sādhyātparāya upalabhyate tathāpi ayogyatāvaccirākriyate |
nahi prayāsacirevakā saṃbandhakāraṇaṃ (kintu ) yogyatvāpi |
sādhyaṃ punaḥ svargaputragrāmādi prāgeva śāstrāt sarve puruṣāḥ pratipadyante |
tataśca ' bhāvayet, kiṃ ' ityapekṣitāmātre
vinaiva śāstreṇa etāvadavagatam, puruṣārthaḥ kaścit iti |
tatra viśeṣamātramavagatatvādepakṣyate |
tadapi na sādhyātmanā, kiṃ tarhi etadbhāvanāviṣayatvena |
tataśca dūrasthasyāpi svargādereva kṛtāspadasya saṃgatiḥ |
tataḥ avabhṛtasādhyāṃśā bhāvanā ' kena bhāvayet ' ityevaṃ karaṇa- mapekṣate |
tatra ca śākhādhīnapravṛttitvāt tatsaṃnikarṣapādau āśrīyamāṇe pramāṇāntarācca yogyāyogyetyorjñānāt vidhyavirodhāya atyantaprayāsatyupasthita-dhātvarthātikrama- kāraṇābhāvāt sarvaphalabhāvanānāṃ ca kenacit dhātvartha- viśeṣeṇa vinā anupapatteḥ yāgena ityevaṃ vijñāyate |
seyaṃ bhāvanā aṃśadvayaparipūrṇā satī sarvakaraṇānāṃ upāyā- nanugṛhītānāṃ karaṇatvānupapatteḥ ' kathaṃ bhāvayet ' iti itikartavyatāmapekṣate |
sā ca pratyakṣādīnāṃ anugrāhakadarśana- śakyatvāt atyantaśālagamyā iti yathāsaṃnikarṣe tada- saṃbhavādyathā yathākathañcit upasthāpyāmānā śāstrānusāreṇa śrutyupadeśena codanāsāmānyāccātideśena vā atyantā- dṛṣṭopakāradvāreṇa anyathā'nupapatyā kalpyate |
tataḥ pari- pūrṇatvādupāyāt yogyā iti vidhīyate, tadvidhānācca arthāpatyā yāgādividhānam |

yathā caivaṃ sati bhāvanāyā: taṃ prati mukhya- viśeṣaṇatvaṃ tathā agre nirūpayiṣyāma: |
kiñca, bhavanmate kālatrayatiriktākhyātārthaniṣṭhaprakāratā- nirūpitaviśeṣatāsambandhena ākhyātapadajanya-śabda- buddhitvāvacchinnaṃ prati viśeṣyatāsambandhena prathamāntāmapada- janya-anyāviśeṣaṇībhūtārthaviśeṣyopasthititvena kāraṇa- tetyevaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāva: paryavatsacanna: |
na cāsau saṃbhavati |
‘ na pacati caitra: ’, pacatyeva caitra:, pacatyapi caitra: ’ ityādau ākhyātārthabhāvanāyā: caitre eva anvayaprasaṅgena natrarthe abhāve evakārārthānvayagovyāvṛttyā ekadeśabhede apiśabdārthabhūte samuccaye vā anvayānāpatte: |
tatra caitre saṃkhyānvayena ‘ bhāvanāviśeṣye saṃkhyā'nvaya: ’ iti niyamasyāpi vyabhicārāpatteśca |
ata eva nipātāsamabhi- vyāhṛtatvaṃ nākhyātetyasya viśeṣaṇam, saṃkhyāyā: caitre anyānāpatte: |
na ca uktakāryakāraṇabhāve tena viśeṣaṇe- 'pi nipātāsamabhivyāhṛtasthale saṃkhyābhāvanayo: pṛthak kāryakāraṇabhāvamaṅgīkṛtya svasvaviśeṣye anvayopapatti: |
anekakāryakāraṇabhāvakalpanā''spatte: |
asammate tu eka- kāryakāraṇabhāvenaiva vakṣyamāṇarītyā sarveṣāṃ bhāvanānvayena mukhyaviśeṣyatve tadanāpatti: |
kiñca, sarvanipātasādhāraṇayenāpi naikarūpyam |
‘ caitra eva pacati, ghaṭa eva dṛśyate ’ ityādau nipātasamabhi- vyāhāre'pi ubhayorapi saṃkhyābhāvanayo: caitrānvayapratīte: |
na ca kriyāsamabhivyāhṛtasthale evaṃ saṃkhyābhāvanayo- rvairūpyaṃ nānyatra iti niyamo'pi saṃbhavati, ‘ pacati na caitra:, caitro na pacati ’ ityādau ubhayathā'pi vairūpyāt |
ato bhavanmate kāryakāraṇabhāvānvayāt vyabhicārācca na prathamāntapadasthāpatyā bhāvanāviśeṣyatvam |
api ca ‘ odanaṃ pacati ’ ityatra prathamāntapadābhāve kāraṇābhāvādeva bhāvanāprakāratvabodhanānupapatte: itarasāmagrī- vaśāt bhāvanā mukhyaviśeṣyatve bādhakābhāva: |
na ca anubhavānurodhena bhāvanāprakāratvavacchinnaṃ pratyeva ākhyātapadajanya kāraṇatvaṃ kalpayitvā tādṛśa- bodhārthaṃ prathamāntapadādhyāhāra iti vācyam |
anubhavasa- śapathanirṇayatvena tatkāryakāraṇabhāvakalpane gauravāt |
na ca tatrāpi ‘ paṇihataścaitra: ’ ityādau ākhyāta- padābhāve prathamāntasya mukhyaviśeṣyatvavatpatti:, suvartha- prakārakabodhatvāvacchinnaṃ pratyeva suvvyañjanasya kāraṇatvāt, vakṣyamāṇarītyā prathamāyā api saṃkhyātiriktārthasadbhāvācca |
atiriktatve'pi prathamāntāmapadoṣasthāpyaprakārakabodha- tvāvacchinnaṃ prati prathamāntapadajanyasya kāraṇatvakalpanena tādṛśasthale ākhyātapadādhyāhāropapatte: |
na ca vini- gamanāviraha: ‘ astibhavantīpara: prathamapuruṣe aprayujya- māno'pyasti ’ ( bhavantīpara: laṭpara: ) iti smṛtyanu- matatvena tasya adoṣātvāt, tādṛśānuśāsananābhāve niruktabodhasya ittvāt |
kiñca, bhāvanāprakārakabodhatvāvacchinnaṃ prati ākhyāta- padajñānatvena kāraṇatve ‘ caitreṇa supyate, gagane sthīyate ’ ityādibhāvākhyātasthale prathamāntapadādhyāhārāpatti: |
atha tatra ākhyātārthaviśeṣabodhameva aṅgīkṛtya kāraṇatā- vacchedake bhāvamijatvaṃ nivedyate, tadā tadapi gauravam |
asmanmate tu sarvatra ākhyātārthaviśeṣyakatvāt bhāvā- khyātāsthale ca kartṛrnabhidhānena prathamāntasya aprasakti: |
kiñca, yadi anyāviśeṣaṇībhūtaprathamāntatve bhāvanāsaṃkhyāyo- ranvaya: tadā ‘ caitra eva pacati, ghaṭa eva dṛśyate ’ ityādau kutra bhāvanāsaṃkhyāyo: anvaya: kathaṃ vā śābdabodha: ? na tāvat caitrādau, tasya evakārārthānvayayogyāvyayeka- deśe mede pratiyogitātvasaṃsargeṇa viśeṣaṇatvāt |
nāpi evakārārthabhūtāyāṃ vyāvṛttau pratiyogitātvasaṃsargeṇa bhāvanāyā:; āśrayatāsaṃsargeṇa ca evakārārthabhūte anya- smin saṃkhyāyā anvaya:, tayo: prathamāntapadasthāpatvā- bhāvāt |
na ca avyayopari upalepana ‘ dadhi tiṣṭhati ’ ititvat prathamāntatvāvirahe: |
tātve'pi caitre pāka- bhāvanānvayānupapatte: |
caitrasyeva bahuṣvapi ‘ caitra eva pacati ’ iti ekavacanaprayogāt |
ata eva -pacatipadasya vyutpattivaicitryeṇa dvayorapyanvayamaṅgīkṛtya ‘ pākānukūla- kṛtimaitrabhinna: pākānukūlakṛtvābhāvaśca: ’ ityevaṃ kāryathadeśaviśeṣakaśābdabodha: -ityapāstām, tadahatvena ekavacanasya tatrānvayānupapatte: |
caitrasya anyaviśeṣaṇatayā tatrāpi anyānupapatteśca |
na ca caitrapadasya viśeṣyatayā
viśeṣaṇatayā ca vāradvayaṃ arthabodhakatvam, tataśca pākānukūlakṛtimātraiya:, pākānukūlakṛtyabhāvaśca caitanya: iti śābdabodha:; itaraviśeṣaṇatvaṃ ca viśeṣyatvābhāva: |
viśiṣṭaṃ yat viśeṣaṇatvaṃ tadabhāva: iti vācyam |
tathā'pi ‘ caitro maitraśca gacchata: ’ iti ‘ caitro maitrādyaśca gacchanti ’ itivat dvivacanabahuvacanayoreva āpatte: |
na ca ‘ caitro gacchati na maitra: ’ itivat bhinnavākyatvavat ihāpi mukhyaviśeṣyabhedena bhinna- vākyatvāpatte: |
asamyate tu caitravṛtti: caitrānyavṛttiśca ekakartṛkā bhāvanā iti bodha: |
mede ca caitrapratiyogi- katvaṃ pākṣikaṃ evakārasyaiva vā tatra lakṣaṇā iti na virodha: |
vastutastu pacati caitre, maitre cāpacati ‘ kīdṛśo caitramaitrau ’ iti praśne ‘ caitra eva pacati ’ ityuttarā- patti: |
ata eva ‘ kīdṛśaścaitra: ’ iti praśne ‘ pacati ’ ityuttarāpatte: |
na prathamāntaviśeṣyako bodha ityuktam |
‘ kīdṛśī kṛti: ’ iti praśnottaraṃ tu na lakṣaṇāskandi- tatvāt ityuktam |
ata: anubhavasiddhameva bhāvanā- mukhyaviśeṣyakatvam |
rahasya. pṛ. 25-30. tadapi ca ( ākhyāte'pi kartṛtvādi lakṣaṇam iti pūrvamuktam |
tadapi kartṛtvādimapi ) na bhāvanāṃ prati viśeṣyam, kintu bhāvanaiva tadviśeṣyā |
itarathā ‘ pacati brūte ’ iti prayogāpatti: |
‘ paktā brūte ’ itivat, tasya yogyatvāt |
‘ pacati bhavati ’ iti bhāṣyodāhṛtaprayogā- nāpatteśca |
yattu ‘ apākṣīt bhavati, pacati bhavati ’ iti tadudāhṛtaprayoga: sa ca bhūdhātunā yuktatvalakṣaṇayā bhūta-bhāvipākabhāvanāvṛtti-vartamānayuktatvāt iti śābdabodhāṅgīkārāt nāyukta: |
ityevaṃ ca yujyate ityarthe loke bhavati iti prayoga: |
evaṃ ‘ pacati bhavati ’ iti prayogo'pi kartṛviśeṣaṇatvapade nopapadyate |
tathātve ‘ pacanti bhavanti ’ iti prayogāpatteśca |
‘ bhāvapradhāna- mākhyātām ’ iti niruktasmṛtyā ‘ bhāvanātiriktākhyā- tārthamātraṃ prati bhāvadavācyabhāvanāyā: viśeṣyatvokteśca |
atra hi na prakṛtyarthaṃ prati bhāvanāyā: prādhānyaṃ bodhyate |
‘ prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthe saha brūta: tayostu pratyaya: prādhānyena ’ iti smṛtaiva prakṛtyarthanirūpitapratyayārtha- prādhānyasya suvarthasādhāraṇyena siddhe: |
na ca ‘ dhātyartha: kevala: śuddho bhāva ityamidhīyate ’ iti vaiyākaraṇasmṛtyānurodhena bhāvaśabdasya dhātyarthaparatvāva- sāyāt tasyaiva ākhyātārthāpekṣayā prādhānyaṃ anayā smṛtyā ( ‘ bhāvapradhānamākhyātām ’ ityanayā ) niyamyate, pratyayārthaprādhānyasmṛtistu sāmānyaviṣayatvāt suvarthābhi- prāyeṇa vyākhyeyā iti vaiyākaraṇamatameva yuktaṃ iti vācyam |
etasya paribhāṣārūpatvena nadīdvadvādidavat anyatrāpatte: |
ata eva vyākaraṇaśāstre eva tasya ‘ bhāve ghañ ’ ( pā0 3|3|18 ) ityādau pravṛtti: |
sā'pi na sarvatra ‘ bhāve kvalata: ’ ityādau apravṛtte: |
ataśca niruktabhāvaśabdena ṇijantabhūtāto: atrapratyayāntatvatulyatvā bhāvanākulyāpārarūpa bhāvaneva ucyate |
na dhātyartha: |
ata eva - ‘ sarvamākhyātaṃ nāma ’ iti smṛtyā ākhyātaśabdasya dhātuparatvāsāyāt anayā'pi smṛtyā dhātoreva bhāvaprādhānyanyāt dhātyarthamukhyaviśeṣyakatvopa- patti: - ityapyapāstam |
kṛdante pācakapadādau ākhyāta- śabdaprayogābhāvena tatratyākhyātaśabdasya dhātviākṣaṇika- tvasya kaustubhe vyutpāditatvāt |
ataśca ākhyātārthā- tvasya kasya prādhānyam, kasya vā guṇatvaṃ ityepiṣṭe ‘ bhāvapradhānamākhyātām ’ ( nirukta 1|1 ) iti smṛtyā bhāvanātiriktākhyātārthe prati bhāvanāyā eva prādhānyaṃ iti niyamyate |
ata eva kālādisādhāraṇyena eṣa: kārya- kāraṇabhāva: ityapi lāghavam |
rahasya. pṛ. 38-39, bhāvanāyā: mukhyaviśeṣyatvam |
bhāvanātiriktākhyātā- rthasya sarvasya bhāvanāyāmeva prakāratā iti tasyā mukhyaviśeṣa- ṣyatvaṃ siddham |
pṛ. 46. bhāvanāyā: vākyārthatvam |
su. pṛ. 683, bhāvanāyā: saṃnipyopakārītikarta- vyatānvayamātreṇa itikartavyatākāṅkṣā nivṛtte: ārādupa- kārītikartavyatākāṅkṣā''tmakatvam |
( pūrvapakṣe ) |
pṛ. 1193, bhāvanāyā: sādhyasādhanatikartavyatārūpatāyākāṅkṣa- tvam |
pṛ. 449, dhātyarthavibhāne'pi pratyayārtha- bhūtāyā: bhāvanāyā: viśeṣaṇapare'pi vici vidhiriṣyapa-
gamyate|
pṛ. 1132, śuddhabhāvanāyāḥ vidhiviṣayatvā- yogaḥ|
pṛ. 154. bhāvanāyāṃ iṣṭaphalaṃ phalaṃ asti na vā iti vicāraḥ 'svargakāmādhikaraṇam' iti vindau bhāṭṭa- granthe draṣṭavyaḥ|
bhāvanāyāṃ dhātvarthasya karmatvakaraṇatvā- nyatarasaṃsargeṇa prakāratā|
rahasya. pṛ. 57. bhāvanāyāṃ prāśastyādīni ārādhyaprakārakāṇi ajñāni|
yathā bhojane odanaḥ karaṇaṃ śākasūpadādyaḥ saṃnipatyopakāriṇaḥ|
pīṭhadīpādayaḥ ārādupakāriṇaḥ tadvat|
vi. 8|13 varṇakaṃ 2. brāhmaṇe agnihotrādivākyaiḥ sādhyasādhaneti- kartavyatāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ puruṣā niyuktāḥ|
vā.2|1| 14|46 pṛ. 444 paṃ. 8. vastutastu yasmāt pratyayaḥ kṛtadhātvarthavicchedameva svārthe vadati tasmāt phalavākye'pi śuddhabhāvanāgataiḥ naikasyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ anekadhātvarthavi- cchedaḥ saṃbhavati|
su. pṛ. 707. āsittikṣayādiṣu karaṇanapekṣaṇāt calanapatanādiṣu ca
viśeṣāmidhānonayanamevetyam, iti cet, na, tasyā- pratyayārthatvenābhyupagamāt |
pratyayasya naikatve vācakabhedā- ddhe vācyanānātvāyogāt |
dhātavastu nānātmānaḥ karotisamānādhikaraṇatayā tadartha- bhedābhidhāyina iti sāṃpratam |
api ca-- bhāvābhāve prayogasya dvidhā'pi khalu darśanāt |
dhātvarthavarti sāmānyaṃ karotyarthamupāgamat |
'kiṃ karoti, ghaṇṭā dhvanati' iti na dhvaninajanya- manyat |
sadapi vā na vivakṣitaṃ dhātavarthamātrajijñāsanāt |
tathā ca nābhūtaprādurbhāvanam |
ato vastutastadabhāve'pi prayujyamānasya karoterahaṃ kṛtasārthe'ti ? |
tathā 'kā kriyā ? pākaḥ' iti dhātvarthamātrasyātra jijñāsātaḥ bhāvanāyāstatsvarūpamāśritya bhāvanāviśeṣanimitta- maikādhikaraṇyam |
gamyamānāpekṣamiti cet, na, tiṅante- ṣvapi prakṣayāt |
prādhānyācchiṅanteṣvabhidheyatvamiti cet |
na, ihāpi tadviśeṣapratathā dhātvarthasya
‘ kāṣṭhai: pacati ’ itiśabdāt karaṇatvabuddherdravyāṇāṃ kathaṃ- bhāvanāgrahaṇāt |
ata: ‘ kāṣṭhai: pacati ’ iti samabhi- vyāhāro na syāditi ślokārtha: |
1 ] na tāvaddhātvarthasaṃvandhatā kāṣṭhānām, kārakāṇāṃ kriyā- pekṣāṇāmatadātmanā kārakāntareṇa saṃgamāyogāt |
nāpi bhāvanāsaṃvandhatā, tasyā: kārakāntarāvalubdhatvāt |
nāpyaṃ- śāntaratayā saṃvandha:, śābdatvāt karaṇatvasya |
tadevaṃ yatra karaṇabhāva: kriyāyāṃ tasyā avaruddhatvāddhatvarthe cākriyā- tmani akaraṇatvāt ‘ kāṣṭhai: pacati ’ iti saṃvandhabhāva: |
aryākṣitabhāvanādvāra: saṃvandha iti cet, na, avayava- dhānena saṃvandhoghāt |
na hi ‘ mṛdā ghaṭam ’, ‘ kāṣṭhai: pacati ’ iti sama: saṃvandhāvagama: |
ekatra tairākāṅkṣayā- danyatrānyasyekṣaṇāt |
[ umbeka:-- arthākṣitabhāvanādvārasaṃvandhābhyupagame vyavahitasaṃvandhābhyupagama: prāpnoti, apekṣitāśrutakriyādhyā- hārapūrva katvāt, mṛdā ghaṭamitivat |
na ceha tathā, aśrutakriyānapekṣaṇāt |
yathā ‘ ghaṭam ’ ityukte karoti- tyuktā kriyāpadetyeva naivametyartha: |
] vicchiyanti pacantīti na viśeṣa: prakalpyate |
ka: pratyayārtho dhātūrūvyāpāre yadi kartṛtā |
[ umbeka:--- ubhayatra prayojakavyāpāravacanatvāt pratyayasya dhātoliṅgistvamityāditye: |
] api ca, vicchiyanti pacantītyubhayatra prayojaka- vyāpārasya pratyayenābhidhānāt dhātubhyāṃ va viklitteriti nārthabheda: syāt |
nanvasti tāvatkartṛbhedaṃ vyāpārabheda:, tadabhidhānānna doṣa: |
tathāhi, vicchiyantīti taṇḍulā: kartāra:, pacantīti devadattādaya: |
punarbhavān kartṛlakṣaṇaṃ matvevāha, yadi sādhananiyogādikam, kathaṃ taṇḍulānāṃ kartṛtvam, devadattādaya eva kartāra iti avaśeṣaprasaṅga: |
athāguṇatayā dhātunā abhidhīyamānavyāpārata idānīṃ pratyayārtha:, kartṛvyāpārasya bhāvanāyā dhātunevābhidhānāt |
phaladhātvarthābhyabhāvanātvāvyāpāro dhātu- vācya: |
phalārthastu dhātvarthakaraṇaka: pratyayavācya: |
naitatsāram |
na hi dhātvarthakaraṇa: phalabhedaprabhāvaṃ: |
[ umbeka:-‘ dhātyarthaṃ phalabhedaṃ ca vyāpāro dṛśyate'- ntarā ’ iti pāṭhāntaram |
] yo'pi vyavahitaphaleṣu dṛśyate, so'pi hantyādi- dhātvarthāntarātmakaṃ na pratyayārtha: |
prayatnāntarajananā na prācīnadhātugocaraprabhāvanīya iti |
[ umbeka:-- ato yathaiva pākāde: pacatyādi- dhātvarthasya prayatnāntarajanmano na pratyayārthatvaṃ tathātrāpi- tyartha: |
... ‘ sa prāyo dhātugocaraprabhāvanīya: ’ iti kacitpāṭha: |
tatrāpyayamartha:— yadyapi vyavahitaphaleṣu śyenādiṣu vyāpārāntaraṃ pratyayavācyamasti tathāpi sa kartṛvyāpāra: pacatyādidhātugocaraprabhāvanīya eva |
na hi dvitīya: phalakarmo'sti, yata: pratyayavācya: syāt |
ata- stadavayavameva pratyayārthakathyam |
dhātugocara: prabhāvanīyo yasyeti vigraha: |
pākādidhātvarthakarmaka iti yāvat |
] karmaṇā ca karotyartho vyāmo'tastadayogata: |
tadabhāva: pratyayārthasādhane'pi vibhaktya: |
[ umbeka:- itthaṃ na kriyantaraṃ pratyayavācyamastī- tyāha— karmeṇeti |
kriyamāṇaniṣṭhatvāt kriyāstadabhāve kriyābhāva ityartha: |
yathoktam— ‘ karoti: kriyamāṇe na kaścitkarmaṇā vinā ’ iti |
na ca ‘ yajeta svargakāma: ’ ityādāvastyeva svargādi karma |
yattu tatra karmatvabuddhir jāyate, tat dvitīyā'bhāvāt |
tadabhāvastu dhātvarthakārakaviṣaya- tvāt kārakavibhaktīnām |
tathā ca ‘ ubhayāmodanaṃ kāṣṭhairdevadatta: pacat ’ iti dhātvarthakārakeṣu kārakavibhaktayo dṛśyante, na bhāvanākārakeṣu svargagādāviti śaṅkāha —pratyayārthe |
asyāyamartha:— pratyayārthabhāvanākārake'pi vibhaktirvibhaktivyam |
‘ karmaṇi dvitīyā ’, ‘ kartṛ- karaṇayostṛtīyā ’ ityevamādibhirvibhaktiviśeṣe vidhā- nupādānāt |
na ca svarge dvitīyāṃ paśyāma:, ata: karma nāstītyavagamyate |
karote: sadā sakarmakatvāccogaviraheṇa karotyarthābhāvaṃ pratīma: |
vahniviraheṇeva dhūmābhāvam |
tathāhi, na jātu ‘ yajeta svargam ’, ‘ śayīta svāsthyam ’, ‘ āsīta sukham ’ iti dṛṣṭacara: saṃsarga: |
[ umbeka:- sakarmakatvāt kriyāyā: kriyamāṇābhāve tadabhāva:, yathā vyāpakānyabhāve dhūmābhāva ityāha- karoteriti |
] yadi manvīta saṃgatisamarthavibhaktimedābhāvādevam |
tathāhi, dhātvarthabhāvanāgāhinya: suvibhaktaya: pratyayārtha- niyogakarmaṇi svargakāmādau taddarśanāt |
[ umbeka:- asyāyamartha:— pratyayārthabhāvanākarmaṇi svargādau tatkaraṇe vidhiparyāyaniyogakarmaṇi ca yāgādau dvitīyātutīye karmakaraṇavibhaktī na dṛśyate |
niyoga- karmatvaṃ yāgāderviṣayatvena |
pratyayārthaniyogakarmaṇi svarga- kāmādauti vyadhikaraṇe saptamī |
svargakāmādau śabde pratyayārthaniyogakarmaṇi viṣaye kārakavibhaktir dṛśyate ityartha: |
yadvā sāmānādhikaraṇyam |
siddhāntavādinā svargakāmādiśabdasya phalaparatvenābhyupagamyamānatvāt |
tataścāyamartho bhavati |
svargādau bhāvanāyā viśeṣe karmaṇi kārakavibhaktyadarśanāditi |
] tacca vārtam |
evaṃ sati śeṣatve saṃvandhaheto: paṣṭhyā avyāhataprasaratvāt |
[ umbeka:- vārtāṃta idamagataṃ na prāmāṇikamiti |
yadi svargasya dvitīyā'bhāvānmanvyakte: karmatvaṃ na vivakṣitaṃ tata: ‘ kārakāṇāmavivakṣā śeṣa: ’ iti nyāyāttatra śeṣalakṣaṇaṃ paṣṭhī syāt svargasya yajeteti svarga- bhāvanayo: saṃvandhapratipāditā |
na ca tāmupalamāmahe |
tena na kaściddudūta: karmasaṃvandha ityartha: |
] apica pratyayārthabhāvanākaraṇatvārthanāmadheyebhyo viśva- jidādibhya: karaṇavibhaktīkṣamāṇānedamadhyavasātumahati |
astyeva karmasaṃvandha: ‘ yajeta svargakāma: ’ iti cet |
[ umbeka:- nanu ‘ svargakāma: ’ ityatra pade svarga: śrūyate |
sa tu puruṣārthatvena sādhyatvayogya:, bhāvanā ca bhāpyāpekṣāṇī, ato'styeva karmasaṃvandho dvitīyāntareṇā- pīti codayati— astyeveti |
] na, puruṣaviśeṣatvena sākṣātsaṃvandhatvāt |
‘ svargārtha yajeta ’ iti sākṣātsaṃvandhiriti cet |
na, akarmarūpatvāt karmarūpasaṃvandhābhāvaśca bhāvanābhidhānābhāvetutvāt |
akarmatā ca caturthīnirdeśāt |
[ umbeka:- nanu sāmarthyātphalārthitvāvagataniyojya- puruṣapratipatteravivakṣitavādamvītasvargamātrāpratipādanaparatvaṃ svargakāmapadasya tataśca puruṣāntarayogo nāsti |
evaṃ cāyamartho bhavati— svargāya yajeteti, tadetaccodayati— svargeyeti |
] svargāya yāga iti ca dhātvarthenāpi saṃvandhanāt |
[ umbeka:- na caturthīnirdiṣṭasya karmatvaṃ gamyate |
‘ bhukte pacati ’, ‘ tṛptaye bhuṅkte ’ ityādau satyapi tṛptyāde: caturthīnirdiṣṭe odanādikarmike kriyā pratīyate na tṛptyādikarmiketyartha: |
na ca karmaṇi caturthī sthayate |
yadi caturthīnirdeśāt karmasaṃvandho'bhyupagamyeta tatastadaviśeṣādāvye pratyapi svargāde: karmatvasaṃvandha- prasaṅga ityāha— svargāyeti |
tasātkarmābhāvāt kriyāntarā- bhāva iti siddham |
] tulyārthatvaṃ bhāvayati bhavatīti prasajyate |
ka: pratyayārtho dhātūkvyāpāre khalu kartari |
bhāvayati ghaṭaṃ ( kumbhakāra: ), bhavati ghaṭamityapi prasajyate |
tulyārthatvāt |
tathāhi ekatra kartu: ) kumbha- kārasya vyāpāraṃ jijñāsācche, anyatrākhyātātpratyaya iti na midyate'rtha: |
prayojakavyāpāreṇa nijartha: |
kartṛvyāpāra ākhyātāthaṃ iti nānārthatvaṃ yo'pi manyate, vaktavyasteneha kartṛprayojakabheda: |
yadi sādhanānāṃ pravartayitā nivartayitā ca kartā sa caika: kumbhakāra eveti tadyāpārābhidhānā- tulyārthatvam |
ghaṭa: kartā, prayojaka: kumbhakāra iti cet, kathamaniśita: sādhanamadhikṛtyavicchayotpannasya kartṛtvaṃ tādṛśaṃ kulālamatikramya ? athāguṇato dhātu'bhidhīya- mānavyāpāratvam |
kustarhīdānīmākhyātāthaṃ: ? dhātunā'- mihitatvāvyāpārasya |
na ca vyāpārabhedadarśanam, yena dhātupratyayayorvibhāga: syāt |
karaṇatvaṃ ca śabdato'nyato vā dhātvarthasyobhayatrāpi viśiṣṭamiti duvāraṃ tulyārthatvam |
ato na pratyayo bhāvanācacana iti sukam |
ṇyantasya bhavaterartha: kenāśenābhidhīyate |
kiñca- kartṛvyāpāradṛṣṭaśca pacyādādī yadi bhāvanā |
dhātvarthāntararūpa: syāt so'pyadhiśrayaṇadādika: |
yadi ca kartṛvyāpāro bhāvanā, sa ca panthādiṣva- |
mandaṃ karotīti śīghrandayo viśeṣā ityapekṣite citrayaṇādikaḥ, taṃ pavirevopadatte |
anyathā sidhyati- |
satyāha—śīghrandaneti |
] viklayatibhābhyāviśeṣaḥ syāt |
[ umbekaḥ--asyāyamarthaḥ- yadi sidhyativikla- yatītivat pacirāpi prayojyavyāpāravacanaḥ syāt tattatā- viva devadattaḥ pacatīti kartṛbhedena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na lameteti |
athāpi nopādīta tathāpyadhiśrayaṇādidhātvantarārtha iti nānyathā dhātvarthādanvanāpavādaḥ |
atha matam- karotītyanvitāvabhāsasya pratyayasya viṣayatā'nuddhatātmā vyāvṛttāvagrahaṇagocaramebhyo dhātvartho'nyo bhāvanāpadārtha iti, tadasat |
evaṃ hi sāmānyalakṣaṇapātitā dhātvarthasāmānyarūpa eva syāt |
na padārthāntaraṃ bhāvanā- padārthaḥ |
atha matam, satyaṃ sādhyatayā sāmānyaṃ na gotvādi- vattvarūpatayā |
tasyāḥ pratipuruṣaṃ śīghraṃ karoti mandaṃ karotīti svasāmānyaviśeṣābhyāṃ yogāt |
dhātvarthavati tu karaṇasāmānyameva |
uktaṃ ca- anyadeva hi dhātvarthasāmanyakaraṇālakam |
anyaśca bhāvanā nāma sādhyatvena vyavasthitam ||
tadetadapeśālam |
tathāhi- na kriyākaraṇādre jñāne anuyāyinī |
yataḥ pratīmaḥ sāmānye dve sādhyasamāyinī ||
nahi karaṇaṃ karaṇamiti kriyākārakavyatireke'thaṃ panthādiṣu pratyayaḥ, yataḥ kriyārūpavyatirekaṃ karaṇātmakaṃ dhātvarthasāmānyaṃ kalpyeta |
śīghrandāiśca dhātvarthasāmanyasyaiva karotivavyākhyā- vāntarasāmanyabhedaḥ |
śoṇakarṇādirāvāśvasya |
uktaṃ ca- na hi dhātvarthakaraṇaḥ phalabhedaprabhāvataḥ |
dhātvartha phalabhedaṃ ca vyāpāro dṛśyate'ntarā ||
[ umbekaḥ-- yadi kriyārūpā pratyayavācyā anyā bhāvanā bhavatā nābhyupagamyate kasya tarhi śīghraṃ karoti
vācyo lakṣaṇabhedaśca tatra dhātvarthabhāvayoḥ |
bhāvaḥ parispanda iti yajalādāvasambhavaḥ ||
[ umbekaḥ-- yadi ca dhātvarthabhāvanayorbhedaḥ syāttato ghaṭapaṭayoriva rūpabhedo'pi darśayitavyaḥ |
na cāsau darśayituṃ śakyate ityabhiprāyeṇāha- vācya iti |
nanu śakyate eva rūpabhedo darśayituṃ spandātmā bhāvaḥ aspandātmā dhātvarthaḥ iti, ityāśaṅkayāha- bhāva iti |
] avaśyaṃ ca bhāvanādhātvarthabhedavādinā tayoḥ spaṣṭo rūpabhedo darśayitavyaḥ |
aspandātmā dhātvarthaḥ spandātmako bhāvaḥ iti cet, evamaspandātmātmakartṛkeṣu yajate jānātītyādyasatyārtheṣu tadabhāvaprasaṅgaḥ |
gacchatyādau ca dhātvarthasya bhāvanāprasaṅgaḥ |
cetanavyāpārastu purastāt prayuktaḥ |
kaścaiṣa parispandaḥ ? na khalvayamāśrayāmimatānbhedena gamyate |
[ umbekaḥ-- spanda iti vibhāgābhiprāyametat deva- dattādeḥ saṃyogavibhāgalakṣaṇabhāvo'nyaḥ parispando na gamyate ityarthaḥ |
] kathaṃ na gamyate ? yadā satyapyāśraye pratyakṣe kadā- ciccalatīti pratyayaḥ prādurbhavaṃstadatiriktaṃmarthamālambate |
naitatsāram |
kāryaṃ vibhāgasaṃyogalakṣaṇaṃ calatīti dhīḥ |
ālambatāṃ tato nānye viśeṣo lakṣyate sthitāt ||
[ umbekaḥ-- calatīti pratyayasya devadattakārya- saṃyogavibhāgālambanatvācca |
saṃyogavibhāgalakṣaṇabhāvo- 'nyaḥ spando devadattāt gamyate ityarthaḥ |
kāryamityā- lambanagatakādācitkatvena pratyayakādācitkatāṃ darśayati- tata iti |
sthitāt niścalāt calato devadattasya saṃyoga- vibhāgāveva viśeṣo na tadatiriktaṃ bhavadabhimattaḥ spanda ityarthaḥ |
] sa khalu parispando'kṣagocaraḥ |
pūrvottaradeśasaṃyoga- vibhāgaphale'bhyupeyate |
tathā ca tāveva gocaratvetya pratyayaḥ |
na khalu pūrvottaradeśahānopādāne apratipadya-
mānaścalatīti budhyate |
na ca sthitāt nipuṇato'pi |
pratipadyanti laukikāḥ |
ākāśa eva tu sakaladeśi- nirupayandriyasya vyāpāraścalatīti lakṣyate |
padārthānāṃ deśa iti pratīmaḥ |
atastaddeśasaṃyogavibhāgau nanu calitvā sthito'pi saṃyogavibhāgavān calatīti |
eva tadālambanamiti sthitāau na prasaṅgaḥ |
gamyate |
[ umbekaḥ-- calitvā sthita iti tatkāryasaṃyoga- vibhāgavacca darśayati |
tatra sthita iti saṃyogavacca calitveti vibhāgavattvam |
] anyatarakarmajanmanośca saṃyogavibhāgayordvidhātvenobhaya- kriyāpratyayaprasaṅgaḥ |
sthāṇusyenayorvibhāgamātreṇa sam- ditayostadatvamiti cet, anyatarakarmajanmanorubho- prasaṅgaḥ |
yadā sthāṇurekena śyenena saṃyujyate'nyataśca viyujyate |
[ umbekaḥ-- yadaikedyenakriyājanyaḥ saṃyogo bhavatya- paradyenakriyājanyo vibhāgaḥ |
tasminneva kāle, tadā saṃyoga- vibhāgasamudāyasaṃbhavāt sthāṇāvapi calatīti pratyayaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ |
] na ca kramaviśeṣavantau tadālambanam, puraḥsaṃyukta- dyenavibhāgapuraḥsare'pi śyenāntarayoge'bhāvāt |
[ umbekaḥ-- akiñcitkarametatkalopādānaṃ saṃyukta- dyenavibhāgapuraḥsare'pi saṃyoge calatīti pratyayābhāvā- dityarthaḥ |
] ucyate- acchinnotpattayo deśaviśeṣatyāgasaṃgamāḥ |
taddecarapadārthānāmākāśo deśa iṣyate ||
[ umbekaḥ-- tatra accheinnotpattaya ityanena yaḥ sthite pratyayaprasaṅgo darśitaḥ sa parihṛtaḥ, deśaviśeṣa- grahaṇena ca sthāṇau |
etaduktaṃ bhavati |
aviraladeśa- viśeṣavibhāgāsaṃyogaścalatītipratyayasyālambanam |
na ca sthite pṛthivyādāvaviralatvaṃ saṃyogadādeḥ saṃbhavati |
nāpi sthāṇau deśaviśeṣanibandhanatvam, śyenasyātaddeśatvāt |
ākāśa eva hi sarvapadārthānāṃ deśatveneṣyate |
] na khalu saṃyogavibhāgamātre calatīti pratyayaḥ, api tu avicchinnotpādasaṃyogavibhāgaprabandhe, sthite ca tada- bhāvaḥ |
na ca sthāṇau deśaviśeṣaviṣayau saṃyogavibhāgau, saṃyogimātrādeśatvāt |
na hi śyeno sthāṇordeśa iti
nanu vyomno'pratyakṣatvāt vāyuvanaspatiyogā (vibhāga)- vattarasaṃyogavibhāgānāṃ pratyakṣāvṛttitvena anaindriyakatvāt indriyajanmanaḥ pratyayasya viṣayatā na yuktā |
[ umbekaḥ-- vāyuvanaspatiyogavibhāgāmiti kvaci- tpāṭhaḥ, kvacca vāyuvanaspatiyogavaditi, sa sādhureva |
kevalaṃ dārśanikānupādānaṃ doṣa iti |
prakṛte tvetatpari- hāryaṃ parihārāntaropapatteśca pakṣinomasaṃyoge draṣṭavyā |
pratyakṣāpratyakṣavṛttitvāt ākāśadeśasaṃyogasya pakṣinoma- saṃyogasya cetyarthaḥ |
] nanu yuktā |
anyathā- kathaṃ gamyeta vayaso niyatā'paradeśatā |
calato'kṣābhivyaktādvaidhāvibhāgodeśasaṃgamāḥ ||
[ umbekaḥ-- ākāśe pakṣiṇa gacchati iha ayaṃ vartate neheti vā cākṣuṣaḥ pratyayo bhavati |
sa kathamiva vyomasaṃyogāpratyakṣatāyāmavakalpeta |
sa hi saṃyogapratyakṣa- tāyāṃ bhavati |
tathā ca vyomāpi pratyakṣam |
asti ca vistāritadeheḥ pṛthivyādyātmakanīlarūpadādhairpratyayaḥ; tadā- lambanamākāśam |
anyathā nirālambanataiva syāt |
na ca pṛthivyādyābhava evālambanaḥ bhāvākārapratyayateḥ aindriya- katvāt tasya, na caindriyako'bhāvapratyayaḥ |
yadi cāprati- bhāsamāno'pyabhāvo'sya ālambanaṃ ityucyate |
tato gobuddhiḥ |
atrādyālambanetyapi prāpnoti |
kintvāvaṃ tadākāśamiti ? amūrtaṃmapi sarvagatatvāttvāt svatantra- miti |
] apratyakṣatve hi nabhovibhāgasaṃyogādīnāṃ kathaṃ patati patatriṇo deśabhedādhikaraṇakaṇam |
kriyā kāraṇe kāryānumānāditi cet |
[ umbekaḥ-- nanu apratyakṣatve'pi nabhodeśasya iha prāpta iti deśabhedādhikaraṇapuṇapatte eva jñānam |
kathaṃ pratyakṣagrāhyakriyākāraṇajaṃ saṃyogavibhāgakāryaviṣaya- metadanumānaṃ bhaviṣyatīti nāsti kaścit doṣa iti codayati- kriyeti |
bhāvanāvivekaḥ
yadyapyanumānaṃ yatsarveṣu sādhaneṣu saṃnihiteṣu satsu |
nanu puruṣaviśeṣaṇameva na saṃbhavati |
ayogānya- |
kadācit pacatīti pratyayo bhavati iti |
yogātyantāyogānāṃ anyatamasyāpi vyavacchedasaṃbhavāt |
[ ummeka:- yatpunaḥ kārakavyatiriktāgrāhī |
jātyā ca tasyābhāvāt |
kaiścidanumānamupyatam- uktākāṣṭhataṇḍuladevadattādikāraka- |
[ ummeka:- nanu svargaḥ puruṣaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvaṃ na |
grāmartanidhāne kadācit pacatīti pratyayo bhavati |
kadā- |
yuktam |
trividhaṃ hi viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati |
kiñcidyoga- |
cinna bhavati |
sa yadi kārakakāraṇaka eva syāt tadā |
vyavacchedena yathā 'pīno devadattaḥ' iti |
na tvatrānya- |
sarvadā pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, na caivam |
ato'nyahetuka iti |
yogavyavacchedaḥ saṃbhavati, anyasyāpi yaśdattādeḥ pīnatvāt |
niścīyate |
tena kāryabhūtāt pacatīti pratyayāt kāraṇa
atrocyate- anekārthatvamanyāthyaṃ tainnaikādhikaraṇyataḥ |
karotinā tiṅanteṣu bhāvābhedo'numīyate ||
‘ghaṭaṃ karoti’ iti tāvajjananotpādanādiśrutiviṣayāṃ bhāvanāṃ karotirācaṣṭe |
sa ca patyādisamānādhikaraṇo- 'pi nānyatra vartitumarhati anekārthatve tvanaikāntikatvāt tato'bhidheyanirṇayāyogāt avyavahārāṅgataḥpateḥ |
avagata- sāmarthyānusāreṇa ca prayogopapattau sāmarthyāntarakalpanā- yogāt pratītatvācca apratītakalpanācca prayogāntare'pi prayogāntaranirṇitasyaiva pratyayāt kiṃ karotīti cotpā- danāthā evādhigamāt |
evaṃ bhāvanābhidhānena karotinā samānādhikaraṇatayā ākhyātapadānāṃ tadviśeṣābhidhāyitva- manumīyate |
[ umbekaḥ-- ślokārthaṃ vivṛṇoti- ghaṭaṃ karotīti |
anekārthatve hi karotestaduccāraṇe sati aśābdisan- devārye saṃdehaḥ prāpnoti anekāntikatvāt |
evaṃ ca vyava- hāro nāvakalpate |
dṛśyate cāsau niścitārthanibandhanaḥ prakaraṇādiparāmarśanirapekṣaḥ |
tasmāt bhāvanārtha eva karotiriti |
yadyapi pratyayo medācca viśeṣāvagamālayam, padaṃ tu prakṛtibhedādvinaprakṛtyarthanurūpapratyayārthapradhānam, pratyayo- 'pi paurvāparyaniyāmāt na padatvat svatantraḥ sāmānyamātre dhigamādādhati, api tu prakṛtyarthapekṣayā vilakṣaṇaḥ svārtha- viśeṣameva samarpayati |
sarvathā padaṃ tāvadviśeṣe vartate |
tena tāvastato'bhedayatvāt dhātvarthavidhānavyañjanasphuṭa- viśeṣāyāstatra viśeṣābhidhānānumānamivaruddham |
nanu pratyayasya sāmānyamabhidheyamimaṃ tatkathamubhayoḥ sāmānyābhidhāyinoraikādhikaraṇyam |
[ umbekaḥ-- pratyayo bhāvanāsāmānyāvacanaḥ, karoti- rapi bhāvanāsāmānyāvacana eva, na ca dvayoḥ sāmānya- vacanayoḥ samānādhikaraṇyam |
ucyate- bhedopahitasāmānyavacane'pyapṛthak śrutiḥ |
ko rājā yāti ? pāñcālarāja ityabhidhīyate ||
[ umbekaḥ-- etaduktaṃ bhavati, yathā pāñcālarāja ityatra
saṃnidhānādibhirabhidhānādvā pāñcālaviśeṣopahite rājārthe gamyamāne ‘ko rājā’ ityanupahitasāmānyavacanaśca śabdaśca upahitasāmānyābhidhayeottaravartinā rājaśabdena samānādhikaraṇyam, tathātrāpīti na anvitābhidhāna- codyam, nāpyasamānādhikaraṇyam |
praśnavartanā hi sāmānyaśabdena vyavacchinnasāmānya- viṣayāḥ śrutayaḥ parigrahasamānādhikaraṇyaprayogāḥ, ko rājā yāti ? pāñcālarājaḥ iti yathā |
yukta eva cottare sāmānyanirdeśaḥ, anyathā praśnagataṃ tadapekṣaṇīyaṃ syāt |
viśeṣataśca bhāvanāyā asaṃvittāpadamedatvāt paropadhānavyajyamānaviśeṣāyāḥ |
tasmācca siddhasādhanaṃ viparyayasādhanaṃ nāpyadṛṣṭāntam |
[ umbekaḥ-- tasmāt pākādiśabdoccāraṇe pratyaya- saṃnidhānādibhirviśiṣṭe bhāve gamyamāne na karotiśabda- sādhitasya sādhanam, yenānarthakyāt sahaprayogānupapattiḥ syāt |
nāpi viparyayasādhanam |
samānādhikaraṇyadarśanāt |
yathā, ‘ko rājā yāti ? pāñcālarājaḥ’ iti |
nādṛṣṭānta- tetyasya ayamarthaḥ- na cāyamasatpoṣavidyamānadṛṣṭāntaḥ, asyaiva dṛṣṭāntasya vidyamānatvāt |
tena sati dṛṣṭānte na viruddhe heturiti |
athavā vṛkṣaḥ śikṣā ityasyāsa- tyeṣe'pi nādṛṣṭāntatā |
yathaiva chātra sāmānyaviśeṣaniyataṃ samānādhikaraṇyaṃ tathaiva ‘kiṃ karoti ? pacati’ ityatra karotipratyayayoḥ |
bhāvābhāve prayogastu na dvidhā'pi nirīkṣitaḥ |
antataḥ so'pi dhātvarthagocaro lakṣyate tathā ||
[ umbekaḥ-- ākhyātasamānādhikaraṇasya nāmasamānā- dhikaraṇasyaiva karoteḥ bhāvanābhāve na prayogo dṛṣṭaḥ, yena dhātvarthasāmānyāvacanatvamavasīyate |
tathāhi, ‘ghaṇṭā dhvanati’ ityatra bhāgyābhāvena bhāvārtha ucyate |
sa cāyuktaḥ, sarvasya dhātvarthasya anyotpādakasvabhāvatvena bhāgyānvitatvāt |
asti cātrāpi mṛdutīvradhvaniniṣpanne sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā |
yadi tyakarmakatvāttoḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā dhvanītyevaṃ saṃvacanavagamāt bhāvyatvaṃ nāmyupagamyate tato'ntato dhātvarthameva bhāvyaṃ brūmo dhvananaṃ karotīti saṃyogavibhāgau tajjanitaḥ śabdo vā dhvananam |
parispandaśca
karotyartha iti |
yadapi ‘kā kriyā ? pākaḥ’ ityādyudghṛtaṃ tatrāpi bhāvāviśeṣanibandhanaṃ samānādhikaraṇyam, na śrutāpakinibandham, yena dhātvarthavacanatā karoteḥ syāt |
tadetadāha- lakṣyate tatheti |
‘ghaṇṭā dhvanati’ iti hi bhāgyābhāvena bhāvanābhāva ucyate |
sarvasya dhātvarthaḥ kiñcidasadutpādayati dhvananamapi sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā''nanto dhātvartha eva bhāvyaḥ |
[ umbekaḥ-- tatra ākhyātasamānādhikaraṇasya karoteḥ yathā bhāvanābhāve na prayogastathā darśayati- ghaṇṭeti |
na hi sarvatra dhātvarthasya karaṇataiva karmatā'pi tu kaścitmātranirvṛtticittavikṣayām |
[ umbekaḥ-- nanu dhātvarthasya karaṇatvābhyupagamāt katha- miva karmatvamucyate ityāśaṅkayāha- neti |
yadyapi karaṇaṃ dhātvarthasya vyāpārasādhyatvāt karma- tā'pi |
tena yadā dhātvarthamātranirvṛttirvivakṣitā bhavati nānyasya phalasya tadā karmanirdeśo na virudhyate |
‘kā kriyā ? pākaḥ’ iti cehāpi dvividhatvāt śabdādyasya śrautalakṣyabhedena nāmāvo bhāvanāyāḥ śabdata- staddeśalakṣaṇapramāṇatvāt pākaśabdasya |
[ umbekaḥ-- lakṣyate tatheti yaduktaṃ tat vivṛṇoti- kā kriyate |
yadbhāvanāpratipādakaśabdābhāve bhāvanābhāve sati ‘kā kriyā ? pākaḥ’ iti samānādhikaraṇyaṃ karoterudā- hṛtaṃ tadayuktam |
pākaśabda eva hi bhāvanāpratipādakaḥ |
na hyabhidheya eva śabdārtha iti vyavasthā |
kiṃ tarhi ? yat śabdaḥ sa śabdārtha iti pacinā lakṣitabhāvanāviśeṣa- nibandhanamapi aikādhikaraṇyameveti na doṣaḥ |
tiṅante'pi tarhi lakṣya eva bhāvo'stu |
naitatsāram, yataḥ sarvatra kaḥ pāko buddhimadepahute na bhāvanāparāmarśa- mantareṇa ca bhāvyametat |
[ umbekaḥ-- yataḥ ‘kaḥ pākaḥ ? ’ ‘pacati’ ityatra buddhimado na syāt, asti cāsau |
tathāhi pāka ityatra siddharūpo dhātvartho gamyate, pacatītyatra sādhyarūpaḥ |
tacca sādhyatvaṃ bhāvanāsparśakṛtam, tatsaṃsparśaśca syādyadi sā pratyayenābhidhīyeta |
tato'trābhidheyabhāvanānibandhanamaikā- dhikaraṇyam, na pākavat gamyamānāpekṣamityarthaḥ |
idaṃ bhavān pṛṣṭo vyācakṣvām ‘pākaḥ pacati, ityatra dhātvartho bhidyate na vā’ iti |
ko hi sphuṭaṃ pratyayabheda- mavajānīte ? tathāhi, tiṅante bhāvaḥ sa gamyate, na tathābhūto ghajante, bhāve tadvijñānāt, śuddhaśca dhātva- rthasya tattvavyākhyānāt |
‘dhātvarthaḥ kevalaḥ śuddho bhāva ityabhidhīyate’ iti |
tarhihi bhāgyatvaṃ bhāvanāsaṃsparśakṛta- miti tiṅantānāṃ so'rthaḥ |
gamyamānatve hi tiṅanta- ghajantyordhina bhidyeta, aviśeṣāt |
na ca sādhanasādhyasaṃbandhadvedāvagamaḥ, ‘sthīyate’ ityatrāprasaṅgāt |
[ umbekaḥ-- yatra sādhyatvāvagamaḥ, hanta tarhi bhāvotpalakārānte sthīyate ityevamādau śabda kāraka- saṃbandhabhāvāt dhātvarthasya sādhyatvāvagamo na prāpnoti |
asti cāsau |
devadatte sthīyate ityatra sthitiḥ kriyate ityartho'gamyate |
tena bhāvanāsaṃsparśakṛtameva sādhyatvaṃ na kārakasaṃbandhakṛtamityarthaḥ |
kiñca-- pākaṃ karoti pacatītyālyātārtho na dṛśyate |
bhedena śabdatastvaiḥ pākādau na tvayaṃ kramaḥ ||
[ umbekaḥ-- pacatītyasya pākaṃ karoti, itīmamarthaṃ nidarśayati, na pākaśabdasya |
tena tiṅante kenacicchabda- bhāgena pāko'bhidhīyate kenacitkarotyartha iti gamyate |
gamyamāne bhāve pākādau tathā nidarśanaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ |
pacati pākaṃ karotīti tiṅantapadārtha medena nidarśa- yati nāprātipadya medam, pākādiṣu tu na tathā meda- pratipayabhāvāditi gamyate |
[ umbekaḥ-- nanu tiṅante'pi na pṛthakkarotyartho- 'bhidhīyate, abhidhāne pramāṇābhāvāt |
yattu nidarśanaṃ tada- śabdameva medaṃ parikalpya, yathā kasyāminivartanaṃ karo- tīti |
na tāvat pākādinivartanaviśeṣo'paraḥ karotyartho- 'bhihitaḥ |
karotyartha evābhinivartanam, na ca tatrāpi aparaḥ karotyarthaḥ saṃbhavati yo'bhidhīyate |
parikalpya medaṃ tathopadarśanaṃ pākābhinivartanaṃ karoti yatheti cet |
[ thattu dhātvarthe sādhyatvaṃ tadvāvasyaiva svābhāvika- mityabhiprāyeṇa codayati- parikalpyate |
] na, pākādāvapi bhedapratipādanaprasaṅgāt |
[ umbeka:- yatra aśabdameva bhedaṃ parikalpya nidarśayanti, kā vyavasthā yatsiddhante- na pākādāviti |
] śabdopakalpitasiddhanteṣvapi bheda iti cet |
astu tāvacchabdārthabhedo vastunyapi upapādayiṣyāmaḥ |
[ umbeka:- tiḍantasya tāvadartharūpaṃ bhavatā'ṅgī- kṛtam, tattu tāttvikamityanantarameva vakṣyāmaḥ |
] nanvevaṃ bhāvanāyā api sādhyarūpā bhāvanāntarā- pātastadapi tathyenāvasthā |
yadi mataṃ vyāpāro hi sā svarūpameva tasyāstadāhaṃ parādhīnoṣajananam |
ataḥ svarūpā- tathyātsiddheḥ nānyasaṃsparśopyapekṣate |
dhātvartho'pi tarhi tathā'stu |
tathāhi- vastutaḥ so'pi tathā atathā vā bhavanāpāditatvābhāvaḥ svaśabdavyāpārātparāmapīti |
ghajantādiṣvāpi kārakasaṃśrayopapatteḥ anyathāvyāpāre kārakasaṃśrayogādavyāpārasaṃnyavantiḥ kārakatvānupapatteḥ |
kriyāsaṃśrayaprabhāvi tattvāt kārakabhāvaḥ |
buddhibhedastu pākādiṣu pratyayopādānena siddhabhāvanānu- bhavāt |
anabhibhavataḥ cetyādau na cānabhibhūta rūpamanya- thāśakyaṃ pradarśanaṃ vyāpārāntaranidarśanena nidarśayati bhāva- nāyā iva |
na ca siddhasādhyoraikyadvayaṃ viruddhaṃ bhedā- medayoriva gotvādiṣu bhinnaprakṛtipratyayopādānatvāt |
sādhyabhāvarūpapratītinidarśanābhyāṃ ca dhātvarthasya tiḍanteṣu bhāvanāmicchato dhātvarthasya karmatvaprasaṅgo na kathañcana syāt |
tasmāddhātvartha eva vyāpārātmā dhātuśabdāpādānaḥ phala- bhavanasamarthā bhāvanākriyā ceti sāṃpratam |
[ umbeka:- tasmāt alaṃ dhātvarthātiriktabhāvanayā, dhātvarthaḥ eva vyāpārātmā dhātunopādīyamānaḥ pratyayaśca phalabhavanasamarthatayā gamyamānaḥ phalabhavanasamarthavyāpāra- vacanabhāvanākriyāśabdāt ityāha- tasmāditi |
] tadetadasamañjasam |
tathāhi-- dṛśyamāne vastubhede neṣṭā śabdārthamātratā |
pratyayārthenābhibhavaḥ siddhe tadvāvaviniścayaḥ ||
[ umbeka:- yadi dhātvarthabhāvanāyostattviko medo na syāt tataḥ śabdopakalpita evāyaṃ bheda ityabhyupagamyeta, na tvetadasti, prayatnaparisandayoḥ dhātuvācyasaṃyogavibhāgā- tiriktyoḥ pratyakṣasiddhatvāt |
yattu pākādau sādhyatvaṃ na gamyate tat pratyayārthena siddhatvenābhibhūtatvādi ti tatrāpyāha- pratyayārtheneti |
] darśayiṣyate hyanyāpārātmano dhātvarthādbhedavataḥ kriyā- 'to na śabdasāmarthyavilasitamiti yuktam |
asati hi vastuni tathā nāma bhedavadapi |
saṃgrahagrahaṇāpekṣatvācca śabdasya na vasturūpakalpito vibhavaḥ |
niścitte tu dhātubhirbhāvyatetyādinā'bhibhavā- bhidhānaṃ yuktam |
na ceha tathā pramāṇābhāvāt |
sādhana- saṃbandhasya gamyamānabhāvanāviṣayatvāt |
[ umbeka:- yadi dhātvarthātiriktā bhāvanā nāmyu- pagamyeta tataḥ saṃbandhagṛhīte sati agṛhītasaṃbandhaḥ pratyayaḥ kathamiva bhāvanābuddhiṃ kuryāccena śabdopakalpito bheda ityucyate, ityāha- saṃbandha iti |
vibhavaḥ sāmarthya- mityarthaḥ |
] uttarārdhaṃ vivṛṇoti- niścita iti |
sādhana- saṃbandhasyeti |
'devadattena pākaḥ' iti dhātvarthena lakṣya- māṇādhyāhiyamāṇakriyateḥ śabdavācyabhāvanāviṣayatvādi- tyarthaḥ |
] tathādarśanāttu śaṅkulayā khaṇḍa iti |
[ umbeka:- dṛśyate ca gamyamānabhāvanāviṣayaḥ kārakasaṃbandha ityāha- tatheti |
etāvatyukte śaṅkulayā khaṇḍaḥ kriyate ityetāvatarthe vākyaṃ samāpyate iti |
] kiñca-- viklidyanti pacantīti na viśeṣaḥ prakalpyate |
ṛte vyāpāranātvāt kartṛbhedo'pi vā kutaḥ ||
[ umbeka:- ittha dhātvarthātiriktā bhāvanā astītyāha- kiñceti |
yadi dhātvarthātiriktā bhāvanā abhyupagamyate tadā viklidyanti pacantītyorapi śabdayo- stulyārthatvaṃ prāpnoti |
ubhayorapi viklittyātmakapāka-
viṣayatvāt |
nanu pacatītipratyayopāttadevadattādikartṛkaḥ pāko'bhidhīyate, viklidyantīti ca taṇḍulakartṛkaḥ, ataḥ kathamekārthami tyāśaṅkāyāha- ṛte vyāpāreti |
satyaṃ kartṛbhede sati arthabhedo bhavati |
sa eva dhātvarthātirikta- vyāpārānabhyupagame na yuktaḥ |
] na tāvaccitteṣu dhātvartha eva vyāpārātmopādīyate viklidyanti pacantīti dhātvarthabhedāt pratyayābhedaprasaṅgāt |
kartṛbhedāccaivamiti cet, na, vyāpāramedamantareṇa tadanu- papatteḥ |
tathāhi, sādhanānāṃ niyoktṛtve kartṛlakṣaṇe deva- dattādyeva kartā na taṇḍulāḥ |
aguṇatayā dhātu- nābhidhīyamānavyāpāratve tu taṇḍulā eva kartāraḥ |
etena bhinatti vidalati chinatti dvedhābhavati ityādidyo vyākhyātāḥ |
tasmāt dhātvarthātirikto vyāpāra upeyaḥ yatkṛto'rthabhedaḥ kartṛbhedaśca |
[ umbeka:- bhinattīti prayojakadevadattādikartṛko vyāpāro'bhidhīyate |
vidalatīti tu prayojyakāṣṭhādikartṛko dhātvarthaḥ |
tathā chinattīti devadattādikartṛka eva, dvedhā- bhavatīti prayojyakāṣṭhādikartṛkaḥ |
ityeteṣāṃ caiṣāṃ śabdānāṃ dhātvarthātiriktyavyāpārānabhyupagame tulyārthatvaṃ syāt |
] aparaḥ kalpaḥ |
syānmatam, karmasamāyādhikriyeṣveva dhātvarthātirikto vyāpāro'bhyupagamyate |
kartṛkriyeṣu kathamiti |
[ umbeka:- anena śaṅkāṃ darśayati |
ayaṃ cāśaṅkārthaḥ: karmasamāyādhikriyeṣu viklidyanti pacantītyevamādiprakriyeṇa prakāreṇa dhātvarthātiriktaḥ kartṛvyāpāre yo'nuṃ śakyate |
tadanabhyupagame'bhidhīyamānavyāpāratve ca kartṛlakṣaṇe sati taṇḍulā eva sarvatrābhidhīyamānavyāpāratvena kartāraḥ prāpnu- vanti |
na hi taṇḍulādikarmasabhabhāvanā pākena prayojya- vyāpāreṇābhidhīyamānenābhidhīyamānavyāpārā devadattādyo bhavanti |
tena avaśyaṃ karmasamāyādhikriyeṣu devadattādyo- nāmabhidhīyamānavyāpāratvasiddhayarthaṃ prayojyavyāpārātirikto vyāpāro'bhyupagantuṃ śakyaḥ |
kartṛkriyeṣu tu yajate yajantītyevādiṣu śabdeṣu yāgadhātvarthasya yajamāna- tviñcastyādubhayorapi abhidhīyamānavyāpāratvena kartṛlo- papatteḥ |
asatyapi vyāpārāntare bhavati kartṛbhedo'rtha- bhedaścetyanyathāpakimidaṃ kartṛbhedakāraṇamiti |
] ucyate-- ṛte vyāpāranānātvāt kartṛbhedo'pi vā kutaḥ |
'ṛtvijo yajanti' 'yajate yajamānaḥ' ityaguṇato dhātunā'bhidhīyamānavyāpārasya kartṛtvāt saṃkalpaviśeṣaśca ca yajyābhidheyasya yajamānavyāpāratvāt |
'yajanti yājakāḥ' ityanupapattiḥ |
dhātvarthātiriktavyāpāraprādhānya- vivakṣāyāṃ tupapatte |
nanvanabhidhāne'pi vyāpārabhedasya svātanyavivakṣābhedāt kartṛbhedaḥ karabheda ivātiśaya- vivakṣābhedādupapadyate |
[ umbeka:- yadyapi dhātvarthāt vyāpārāntaraṃ nābhi- dhīyate iti tathāpi dhātvartha eva svātantryavivakṣābhedāt kartṛbhedo bhavati |
tasminneva yajarthe yaditvijāṃ svātantryaṃ vivakṣyate tadā 'yajanti yājakāḥ' iti prayujyate |
yajamāne tu svātantryaṃ vivakṣyate (yajate) yajamāna iti |
vivakṣāto hi kārakāṇi bhavanti, yathā 'pradīpena paśyāmi' iti vyavahitamapi dīpaṃ karaṇatvenopadiśanti, darśanakriyāyāṃ svātantryadyo vivakṣita iti |
] kimidaṃ svātantryam ? sādhanānāṃ niyoktṛtvam |
kāṣṭhādīni pacantīti katham ? niyojyāntarābhāvāt niyoktṛtvavivakṣā prayojye na syāt |
tasmāt prādhānyena pratīpāyamānavyāpāratā svātantryam |
[ umbeka:- yasya vyāpāraṃ prādhānyenākhyātaṃ bravīti tat svatantram |
kāṣṭhādīni pacantīti kāṣṭhādīnāṃ vyāpāraḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyate |
tasmāttāni svatantrāṇi |
] tathā coktam- sthālīsthe prayatne kathyamāne sthālī svatantreti |
[ umbeka:- prayatna itīha sthālīvyāpāraḥ kathyate yathā pacyamānamodanaṃ bibharti |
sthālyā hi dhāryamāṇa odano nirvartyate, nānyathā |
tadanena vartmanā sthālī odanapāke svatantretyucyate |
athavā prayatna iti puruṣa- prayatno'bhidhīyate tasminnodanabhāvanāparanāmni anugrāha- tvena sthālīsthe vivakṣyamāna ityarthaḥ |
na khalu vinā sthāllyā odanena bhāvayituṃ prabhavati |
bhavatu vyāpārabhedaḥ, dhātūpādāna eva tu saḥ |
tathāhi, pacinā devadattavyāpāreāpādānāt viklidinā cānupādānāt viklidyanti pacantītyarthabhedabhedau |
yajatinā carvvigvyāpārasya tādarthyābhidhānāt kvacit kartṛtvopapattiḥ |
tathā coktam—tadabhisaṃdhipūrvakaṃ preṣaṇa- madhyekṣaṇaṃ vā yatsattvaṃ pacyateḥ iti |
naitatsāram— vijñaptimātrasaṃkalpaviśeṣaikavalambanau |
jñāyamānatadarthatvānneṣṭavyānimidhāvati ||
[ umbeka: — bhāve ghañādayo vidhīyante |
dhātva- yaiśca kevalo bhāva ityabhidhīyate iti pākaśśabdā- viklidenaṃ pratīyate, na tu devadattavyāpāraḥ |
tasmādvi- kledanamevāsyārthaḥ |
yāgaśabdācca saṃkalpaviśeṣo'vagamyate |
yo'yaṃ devatāmuddiśya puroḍāśāderutsargastasya saṃkalpa- viśeṣa evārthaḥ , nādanādayaḥ ṛtvijāṃ vyāpārāḥ iti |
] bhāvābhidhāyino pāko yāga iti viklittimātraṃ saṃkalpamātraṃ cācakṣāte pacatiyajatī, na tadatirikta kartṛvyāpārau |
pākasya kriyā siddhetyanidarśanāt |
tathā ‘ pacyante taṇḍulāḥ svayameva ’ ‘ yajate yajamānaḥ ’ iti tanmātratveva tadvāpāratve'bhyupagamāt |
[ umbeka: — ghañantena siddhavattvārtho'bhidhīyate |
tadyadi viklidenārthakartṛvyāpāraḥ pacyarthaḥ syāt tataḥ pāka ityasyārtha pākaḥ kriyā siddheti vyācakṣīran, na tvetadasti |
tathāhi pākaḥ siddha iti vadanti, na tu pākasya kriyā siddheti |
evaṃ tāvatkandau vyākhyau |
] tathā ‘ pacati devadattaḥ ’ ‘ yajanti yājakāḥ ’ iti prajñāyamānatadarthasya nārthāntaraviṣayatvaṃ yuktam |
abhyabhicārāddhi tanmātrameva tadartho nādhikam, vyabhicārāt śabdāntaranibandhanatvāt |
pratyayāgame hi pratīyamānastadartha eva kartṛvyāpāraḥ |
[ umbeka: — satyeva viklidena kartṛvyāpāre cākhyapi paciḥ prayujyate |
tasmādvyabhicārādviklidenameva tasyārtho na kartṛvyāpāra iti |
yo'yaṃ paceḥ paraḥ pratyayaḥ so'syābhidhāyaka iti |
] yathoktam— tathā kramavatorniyaṃ prakṛtipratyayāṃśayoḥ |
pratyayaśrutivelāyāṃ bhāvanātmā pratīyate ||
pradhānānāṃ ca prāyeṇa pratyayārthatvāt prādhānyādapi pratyayārthatvam |
[ umbeka: — api ca pacatiyatra prādhānyena kartṛ- vyāpāreā'vasīyate |
pradhānasya ca pratyayārthatvaṃ ‘ vaiśvataḥ ’ ityādiṣu prasiddham |
tasmāt pratyayārtho bhāvanetyāha- pradhānānāṃ ceti |
] asyādiṣu vyabhicāra iti cet |
[ umbeka: — astīti na vyāpārāviṣṭe vastuni prayujyate |
kiṃ tarhi ? sattāyām |
na ca sattā vyāpāra iti |
] na, vastuto bhāve'pi śabdasattā''pratīteḥ |
anyathā asti bhāvaḥ sattā ityemedeḥ prasajyate |
sattāyā eva vyāpārātmanā pratītebheda iti cet, na, vyāpārāntarasaṃsparśakṛtasya sādhyatvasya pacyādiṣu niścayāt |
ihaiva tarhi vyabhicāraḥ ‘ yajate yajamānaḥ ’ ‘ pacyante taṇḍulāḥ svayameva ’ iti |
vyāpārāntaropagame vā dhātoravyabhicāraḥ |
na, anujñapyamāt |
tiṅa'bhi- dhānasya tannibandhanatvāt, tasyāyāsiddheḥ |
pākādiṣu vyabhicārāt, medenānidarśanārtha apratīteḥ |
itaratrākhyāte bhedena niṣkarṣāt |
anyathā tulyatvādiniṣkarṣaṇaṃ syāt |
sāmānyaviśeṣayośca sādhyasādhanabhāvādyogāt, sāmānyasya asādhyatvāt anabhidheyatvāt anupāpatteśca |
[ umbeka: — tasyeti |
asya dhātūvyabhicārasya anyathāsiddharabhyupagatamasmābhira vyāpārāntaram |
mede- neti |
pākasya kriyā siddheti na pākādidhātvarthabhedena karotyarthe nidarśayati |
nāpi niṣkarṣaṇaṃ pratīyeti |
yadi vyāpārāntaraṃ syāt tataḥ pacyādiśabdatulyatvāt pratīti- nidarśane syāt |
‘ nānabhyupagamāt ’ iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ |
tatrāpyamarthaḥ- na pratyayasya vyabhicāro nāpi dhātoravya- bhicāra iti pratiṣṭhātam |
tatrottaramatiśayāṃ tāvatkāraṇa- māha— anabhyupagamāditi |
vyāpārāntarasya bhavatā- 'nabhyupagamāt bhavati bhavadabhiprāyeṇa dhātuvyabhicārā-
haraṇametat |
sarvvaṃ vyāpārāntaraṃ nihuvānena bhavatā yatrā- smābhivyāpārāntaramāpāditaṃ vikliyanti pacantītyanena tatrāvajñīkṛto vyāpārabhedaḥ |
asyāmiṣva.yajati pacatītyatra vyāpārāntaramāpāditam |
tena vinā devadattādīnāṃ kvacit ca kartṛtvānupapatteḥ, na tu ‘ yajate yajamānaḥ ’ ‘ pacyante taṇḍulāḥ svayameva ’ ityatra |
yāgapākramātraṃ abhihita- vyāpāratvāt yajamānataṇḍulānām |
tiṅabhidhānasyeti |
atra hetuḥ : tannibandhanatvāditi |
vyāpārāntaranibandhana- tvādityarthaḥ |
ataścibhvanatavāditi kvacitpāṭhaḥ |
atrā- rthyamarthaḥ— athātarthanibandhanatvāt, vyāpārāntaranibandhana- tvāditi yāvat |
atraiva kāraṇamāha— tasyānyathā- siddheriti |
] kiñca— tadeva tasya karaṇaṃ na caikamavakalpate |
bhāvanāṃ saṃgirante'to dhātvarthavyatirekiṇīm ||
[ umbeka: — na ca bhāvanā eva bhāvanāyāṃ karmatvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ ca ghaṭate |
ubhayorapi kriyātvena tulya- rūpatvāt |
dhātvarthavyatirekiṇītyanena dhātavyebhyo vyatireko dhātvanabhidheyatvaṃ ca bhāvanāyāḥ pratipāditaṃ yadi dhātugno- vyeta tato yāgādiyatiriktā'pi satī dhātyarthatvāt dhātvarthavyatirekiṇī syāt tena prasiddhayāgādidhātvartha- vyatiriktatvamapātādyavacatraṃ ca pratipāditam |
tadeva tasya karaṇamityanena ca vyatireke dhātvabhidheyatve ca kāraṇa- muktam |
yadi dhātvabhidheyā syāt bhāvanā''khyāte pade tato yajñapade'pi bhāvanāyā dhātvabhidheyatvāt bhāvanā bhāvanāyāḥ karaṇaṃ cetyabhyupagataṃ syāt, na caitadyuktam |
na hi tadeva karma karaṇaṃ vā bhavati |
yadyapi ca sāmānya- viśeṣayorbhedo'sti, sāmānyasya viśeṣaṇātmakatvātpa- bhāvanāsāmānyābhiprāyeṇa tadeveti vyapadeśaḥ |
] yajetāśvamedhena, iṣṭavān bahubhirityaiḥ, sarvvaṃ yaṃ yajati, iti yakte kriyākārakabhāvamupapādayati |
sāmānyaviśeṣa- bhedo'pi na kriyākārakasaṃbandhamupa kalpayituṃ kṣamaḥ |
sāmānyasyāsādhyatvenākiyātmakatvāt |
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyasaṃbandhe tu kārakavibhaktivirodhāt |
[ umbeka: — viśeṣaṇeti |
ayukto'yaṃ pakṣa iti vākyaṃ samāpanīyam |
] nāpyekadeśayoḥ kriyākārakabhāvaḥ, ubhayatra samudāyasya śabdopāttatvāt |
[ umbeka: — ubhayatreti |
kriyāpade kārakapade ca samastasya yāgasya śabdenopāttatvātnāyaṃ vibhāgaḥ kartuṃ śakyate ityarthaḥ |
] nāpi dhātūpāttāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ antarbhūtasāmānyakarma- karaṇikāyāṃ viśeṣakarmakaraṇasaṃbandho yathā muṇḍayati māṇa- vakam, upaślokyati mālinyā iti |
‘ svaṃ yajaṃ bahu- bhiyajñaiḥ ’ ityatrāpi dhātunā bhāvanopādānāt viśeṣa- bhāvanā'bhyupagamāt viśeṣaviśeṣasaṃbandhaprasaṅgāt |
anupādāne vā siddhayabhicāro'sau na tiṅante'pi tāmupādātumarhati |
[ umbeka: — yuktaṃ tatra muṇḍaśabdena ślokaśabdena ca sāmānyato'bhihite karmakaraṇe paścāttyuktā kriyā tiṅocyate iti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ |
iha tu bhāvaneva dhātvarthaḥ, na karmakaraṇasāmānyam |
na cānupātte viśeṣye viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati |
dhātusāmānyādhikaraṇyena hyaśvamedhādi- śabdānāṃ dhātvarthanāmadheyatvaṃ vakṣyate |
tadyadi bhāvaneva dhātvarthastadā tasyāḥ tannāmadheyaṃ syāt, na tu tatkaraṇasya dhātunā'bhihitasya |
tasmāttanmuṇḍayatītyādinā tulya- miti |
] etenatadanapākaṃ pacatītyādyo'pi vyākhyātāḥ |
tasmācca kārakabhāvo nāma padopapāttadhātvarthasya vibhaktibhyajyate, tadatirekī tiṅanteṣu pratyayopādānaḥ karolyarthaḥ pratijñāyate buddheḥ |
] [ umbeka: — kārakabhāva ityadhātvarthatvaṃ vyatirekīti ca vyatirekamupasaṃharati |
‘ svaṃ yajaṃ aśvamedhena ’ ityatra yajñāśvamedhanāmadopāttasya dhātvarthasya ākhyātapratyayo- pāttāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ dvitīyātṛtīyayā karmatvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ ca vyajyate, ākhyātādeva dhātvarthasya karaṇatvamavadhāritaṃ karmatvaṃ ca |
anyathā bhāvanāyānupapatterato'''bhivyajyate ityāha |
yata eva dhātvarthasya kārakatvaṃ vyajyate ata eva dhātvarthātirekī bhāvo dhātvarthānnāmāve tu dhātvarthasya
kārakatvābhivyaktiṃ prāpnoti akārasyāpi bhāvasya dhātunopāttatvāditi |
' na cāpi vyabhicārasya sākṣā- dvāmāvyaghātitā |
kacid dṛṣṭā bhrāntibodhe bādhadhīupa- ghāttikā |
' naiva hi vyabhicārasya kacitsākṣādvāghātakatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yena tādrūpyasya vyabhicāritve gamyamāne tena prāmāṇyaṃ vyāha- nyeta |
nanu bhrāntibodhe dṛṣṭaṃ vyabhicārasya vyāghātakatvam |
atrāha- bhrāntibodhe dṛṣṭaṃ bādhadhīupaghāttikā |
bhrāntibodhe'pi bādhadhiyo vyāghātakatvaṃ na vyabhicārasya |
vārtikakārastu liṅādipārāṃ preraṇamāha- iha liṅādiyuktebhyo vākyebhyo dve bhāvane avagamyate śabdā- tmikā cārthātmikā ceti |
prayojyavyāpāraśca bhāvanā |
uktaṃ ca bhaṭṭapādaiḥ- ' svādhyāyādhyayanavidhinā sarve vidhāyakāḥ svādhyāyapadopāttaśrutā niyujyate bhāvayediti' iti |
etadanena nidarśitaṃ vidhiniyujyamānaliṅādi- prayojyavyāpāre bhāvaneti |
] ihavān yairityatrāpi dravyapradhānabhāvanābhyupagamāt niṣṭhādiṣu tathāpratīteravirodhaḥ |
[ umbekaḥ- nanu ihavān yairityatra satyapi phavatu- pratyayaprayoge bhāvanāyā apratīterna bhāvanāyāṃ yāgasya karaṇatvam |
ato'tra yā gatiḥ sā''nyatrāpi bhaviṣyatī- tyāśaṅkyāha- ihavān yairiti |
kiṃ kṛtavān ? ihavāniti karotisāmānādhikaraṇyāt dravyapradhānabhāvanābhidhānamiti bhāvanāmeva yāgasya karaṇa- tvamityarthaḥ |
tathā kikriyo devadattaḥ ? paktā, pācaka iti karotisāmānādhikaraṇyād astyatrāpi dravyaniṣṭha- bhāvanāpratipattiriti ādigrahaṇam |
] yattaktaṃ bhāvanāviṣayatvapratīteḥ karaṇatvahāniḥ, tat anisarpitakaraṇatvasya |
[ umbekaḥ- yattaktamiti |
tat anirūpitakaraṇa- tattvasya vacanamityarthaḥ |
] tathāhi-- karaṇaṃ khalu sarvatra kartṛvyāpāragocaraḥ |
tirodadhāti kartāraṃ pradhānaṃ tannibandhanam |
[ umbekaḥ- tirodadhātīti |
pradhānaṃ kartāraṃ tiro- dadhāti kartuḥ prādhānyādityarthaḥ |
athavā tirodadhāti kartāramiti pratijñāyate |
tatra hetuḥ pradhānaṃ tannibandhana- miti |
yassātpradhānaṃ karananibandhanaṃ na sākṣātkartṛnibandhanaṃ tena kartā karaṇena phalāttirodhīyate |
' prādhānyaṃ tanni- bandhanāt ' iti tu samīcīnaḥ pāṭhaḥ |
] na khalu kartṛvyāpāralakṣaṇāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ dhātvarthasya karmatvaprasaṅgaḥ akaraṇatvaṃ vā paraśyādāvapi tathāprasaṅgāt |
tathāhi- chidādiṣu na sākṣād vyāpriyate kartā, api tu paraśvādhikaraṇe |
taddhyavyāpārastu udyamananipatanādilakṣaṇaḥ paraśugocara eva |
[ umbekaḥ- tathāhitīti |
vegavatā hi paraśunā tīkṣṇa- dhāreṇa saṃyujyamānaṃ dāru chidyate |
chedane paraśuranantarāt sādhakatvatvena karaṇaṃ bhavati |
kartṛvyāpārastu kuṭhāre vartate na dāruṇi iti |
] ata eva karaṇasyāvyavahitavyāpāratayā kriyāsiddheḥ sādhakatamatvam |
taddyāpārapakṣapravṛttitayā ca karaṇasya kartuḥ svātantryamārādupakāriṇo'pi |
[ umbekaḥ- kartṛvyāpārāyattā hi karaṇasya pravṛttiḥ |
yadi punarhastasyodyamane nipātane ca paraśunā dāru chidyate |
tadevaṃ karaṇavyacacānādareṇāpi phalasyopakurvataḥ svātantryaṃ bhavati, kartṛtvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ |
] anyathā karaṇameva syāt |
[ umbekaḥ- anyatheti |
akāro vā prādiśyate |
tasyāyamarthaḥ- asati kartṛvyāpāre paraśoḥ karaṇatvaiva na syāditi |
] api ca- sādhanānāmabhāvaḥ syātkartṛmārekiṇām |
sādhanānāṃ niyogo hi kartṛvyāpāra iṣyate |
pralīnedānīṃ kartṛmārekitāsādhanāntarakathā sādhanā- ntaraniyogaḥ kartṛvyāpāra iti niyogaviṣayatātipattyā sarvatra karmatvāpātāt |
kathaṃ tarhi karmatarasaṃvibhāgaḥ ? kathaṃ ca karaṇaparīkṣaṇe kartṛvyāpāre tadātirihaṇaḥ phalasya karmatā |
ucyate-- anyārthātivivakṣāyāmakarmatātiśayādinā |
uddeśādanyayuktā''pi phalameveṣyatetarām |
[ umbekaḥ- na vayaṃ paraśvāderapi kartṛvyāpāraviṣaya- tvena karmatvaṃ syāt kartakarmātiriktakāraṇābhāvādityetā- vanmātrameva vadāmaḥ |
kiṃ tarhi ? yāgādiṣvapyasyāpi kartṛvyāpārasya svargādiphalakatvaṃ yāgakaraṇakatvaṃ ca prati- pādyāmaḥ |
tathāhi svargaṃ prāptuṃ yāgaṃ karoti, na yāgaṃ prāptum |
tenoddiśyamānatvena svargasyaiva karmatvam, na yāgādeḥ |
' karturīpsitatamaṃ karma ' ityāha ācāryaḥ |
tasmādicchatiśayābhāvāt kartṛvyāpārasyāpi yāgādya- karmaṃ yāgādigrantha''pi tu kriyāphalameva āpnumiṣyate |
tasmāttasyaiva karmatvamiti ślokārthaḥ |
] yatkhalu upadiṣṭavastvantarāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ nāntarīya- katvena vipayatāmupayadbhirvihitaṃ nedaṃ karma, icchāviṣayā- bhāvāt |
uddeśyaṃ tu kamanyagocarayā''pi kriyayā tasyai- vāpnumiṣyamāṇatvāttadabhidhāya pravartitāyā itarasaṃbandhasya nāntarīyakatayā |
] [ umbekaḥ- ' nedaṃ karma ' iti pratijñā |
' icchā- tiśayābhāvāt ' ityuttaram |
] ataḥ karaṇasyāpi dhātvarthasya sādhyatvapratītinidarśane acchide |
yathā paraśunā chinattīti paraśorudyamanāt- nipātyamānatvapratītiḥ |
] [ umbekaḥ- anena karaṇasya paraśoḥ sādhyarūpapratīti- nidarśitā |
] paraśumuccāṃta nipātayati dvidhābhavanāyeti nidarśanaṃ prayuktaṃ ceti |
yat kartṛvyāpāro'cchidrayaṇādirdhātvarthā- tmaka iti, tatrocyate-- kathyamānādrūpabhedāddinnā dhātvantarādate |
anyotpādanānukūlātmā bhāvanā kiṃ praduṣyati |
[ umbekaḥ- pacatipaṭhatigacchyādiṣu tāvat pratyaya- kathyamānayordhātvarthabhāvanāyoḥ bhinnarūpatvāt na dhātvartho bhāvanā, api tu bhāvanāyāṃ dhātvarthasya karaṇatvena karma- tvena ca saṃgatiḥ |
sādhyatvapratītinirdeśābhyāṃ ca bhāva- nāyāṃ vyatiriktāyāṃ pratyayopāttāyāṃ dhātvarthasaṃgatiḥ |
yattu ' adhiśrayati ', ' āvapati ' ityākhyāyate kartṛ- vyāpārasyādhiśrayaṇāderbhāvanāyā dhātvarthatvam, na tadasmākaṃ kaṃcana dopamāvahati |
' kathyamānādrūpabhedāddinnā ' iti kacipāṭhaḥ |
tatrāpi ayamarrthaḥ- adhiśrayaṇādau dhātupratyayayathyamānadhātvartha- bhāvanārūpabhedāddinnā bhavet dhātvarthena saha saṃgatiḥ |
tatra na kiñcit praduṣyati |
] sarvathā pacatītyeti prākaprayujyamānadhātugocaro na bhavatīti pratipāditam |
dhātvantarairabhidhānaṃ karoti- bhāvayatibhyāmiha na naḥ pakṣakṣatimāvahati |
athavā-- dhātūnāmabhidhānīyāt kartṛkarmasamāśrayān |
lavdhavātmanaḥ kriyārūpān viśeṣān pratijānate |
[ umbekaḥ- atha ca ' adhiśrayati ' ' āsiñcati ' ityatrāpi anyo dhātvarthaḥ, anyā ca bhāvanā pratipādye- tyāha- athaveti |
' adhiśrayati ' ityatra svarūpeṇa ghaṭādivat asādhyātmakaḥ pratyayopāttābhyāsaṃsaṃskṛta- sādhyatvaḥ sthālīcullīsaṃyogo dhātvarthaḥ, tatkāraṇabhūtastu kartṛvyāpāraḥ pratyayārtha iti na dhātvarthatvaṃ bhāvanāyāḥ |
evaṃ ' āsiñcati ' ityatrāpi sthālyudakasaṃyogo dhātvarthaḥ, pratyayārthastu sa eva |
pacatītyatra taṇḍulavayavavibhāgaḥ saṃyogaśaithilyaṃ vā dhātvarthaḥ |
yadyapi cātra prayojya- vyāpāraḥ taṇḍulaparispando vidyate, tathāpi ' pacyante taṇḍulāḥ ' svayameva ' ityatra parispandasya pratyayārthatvasaṃyoga- vibhāgavacanatvameva pacernirdiśyamiti atrāpyavyabhicārāt sa evārthaḥ |
pratyayārthastu kartṛvyāpāra ubhayatra |
mukte yajati juhoti ityatra bhojyantenādyavayavasaṃyogavibhāga- sthalaviyoga-āhavanīyaprakṣipyamāṇadravyasaṃyogā dhātvarthāḥ, tatkāraṇabhūtastu kartṛvyāpāraḥ pratyayārthaḥ |
evamanyatrāpi darśitavyam |
yadyapi ca dantasya api saṃyogavibhāgā- vubhayasaṃsthau, svatvaviyogāramakaḥ svasvāmibhāgaśca, tathāpi gacchati ityatra gamanādeḥ saṃyoga- vibhāgātmano gantavyamānāttvena śabdāt pratīteḥ
adhiśrayaṇasya ādhārakarmāśritasyāpi adhiśrīyamāṇa- syātmakamakarmaśritatvena śabdadeva avagamāt karmakartṛ- samāśrayān ityuktam |
evamapyatrāpi kartṛkarmasādhyatvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgayoryathāpratīti vācyam |
saṃyogavibhāgākṣaite labdhātmāno na kriyāvat sādhyasvabhāvāḥ, niṣpadyamānā- muttarakālaṃ ghaṭādivadupalabhyamāna |
tena pratyeyopāttakriyā- saṃsparśakṛtasādhyatvābhiprāyeṇa kriyārūpān sādhyarūpā- nityāha |
kaścitkriyārūpāditi pāṭhaḥ, sa śobhana eva |
viśeṣāniti |
saṃyogavibhāgarūpatvena viśeṣānityarthaḥ |
[ ] yathā'dhiśrayateścullīsryālīsayogaviśeṣaḥ āsiñyate- rāsicyamānajalādhārasaṃyogamedeḥ |
evaṃ sarvatra |
yāvatpaceḥ taṇḍulāvayavānāṃ vibhāgaḥ prasitilāvayavasaṃyogo vā |
[ umbekaḥ -- āsiñyamānamudakaṃ ādhārasya sthālīti vigrahaḥ |
etaduktaṃ bhavati - karoti utpādati bhāvayati ityādivispaṣṭabhāvanā vacanatitapayathādyuttarikā ye dhāta- vaste saṃyogavibhāgāthī iti nādhiśrayatyādiśabde dhāta- vitvaṃ bhāvanāyā iti |
udāsīnatvavicchedalakṣyaṃ dhātvarthakāraṇam |
spandavyāpāraparyāyaṃ karotyarthaṃ pracakṣate ||
[ umbekaḥ -- yatpunarityuktaṃ ' vācyo lakṣaṇabhedaśca nanu dhātvarthabhāvayoḥ ' iti, tatrāpyāha- udāsīnateti |
dhātvarthastāvat saṃyogavibhāgamako darśitaḥ |
bhāvastu parisandanātmaka dhātvākhyasaṃyogavibhāgakāraṇaṃ yasmin satyaudāsīnyapratyucyatiriti |
tathāhi -- adhiśrayati, udakaṃ āsiñyati pacati ca ityadhiśrayaṇādisaṃyogamede'vyāpārārambhekyo medena karoti spandate cedyate nyāyyate iti vyāpārarūpamevetyate |
na caiṣa tajjanyābhimatasaṃyogavibhāgamvana eva pratyayaḥ |
yataḥ --
vyāpārabuddhayupajano na saṃyogavibhāgayoḥ |
satorapi hi ceṣṭitvā virāmaṃ samupagāte ||
na hi calitvā sthitasya kriyāprabhavapūrvadeśa- saṃyogavibhāgabhāvaḥ |
atastadātmano vyāpārapratyayo na jātu viramet |
vibhāgena samucchedotsayogapracayo na hi |
bhaviṣyadvṛttasaṃyogavibhāgādhyakṣatā katham ||
yadapyavicchinnotpādadeśasaṃyogavibhāgapracaya ālambana- miti |
tadapi na samyak |
na hyuttaradeśasaṃyogaḥ pūrva- vibhāgāte, na ca vibhāgaḥ saṃyogena sahaiva vā |
tadvibhāganocchedot kutastatpratyayaḥ : avicchinnotpādaśca niyogabhānyuttarakālanāṃ sa varta- mānānām |
teṣu vartamānanāteṣu kathamindriyaṃ dhiyamupa- janayet ? mano'pi cāgāṃtukuśalasya naiva samartham |
yathaikādikrameṇa gaṇayato viśrtyādiṣu viśrtyādināṃ bhavati nāgaṇayataḥ |
tadvadiha saṃyogavibhāgānāṃ gaṇayataścalatīti buddhiḥ syāt, nāgaṇayataḥ |
[ umbekaḥ -- yathaiketi |
agaṇitacakṣurādīndriyasyā- gaṇitavastutvābhāvasya cetyarthaḥ |
api ca, sthāṇau pūrvottarayaneninanghanāyāṃ saṃyoga- vibhāgābhyāṃ vyāpāradhīḥ syāt |
ādhāradeśasaṃyogavibhā- gābhyāṃ seti cet, tadyuktam |
tathāhi --
jalādhravayavasaṃyogavibhāgau sthiramūrtiṣu |
jalādhāreṣu matyeṣu vyāpārapratyayādvinā ||
[ umbekaḥ -- tathāhitī |
jalavatinaḥ sthiramūrteḥ matsyasya avicchinnotpatyā eva jaladeśena saṃyoga- vibhāgāḥ saṃbhavanti |
na ca tatra calatīti pratyayo jāyate |
tasmātkāraṇametadityarthaḥ |
pratītaṃ hi jale matsyānāṃ deśaḥ, na sthāṇoriva śyeno na deśaḥ |
tadavayavānāṃ ca saṃyogavibhāgasade'pi teṣu mahattvādakampanīyeṣu balavadvidhāraprayatnena viṣṭātamasu na kriyāvagamaḥ |
tasmāttatra taccinnacanaḥ |
nabhaso'pyapratyakṣatvāttaduccayoḥ saṃyogavibhāgayordulrbhā pratyakṣatā |
na ca viyadritatālokayavayanivandhanatvam |
saṃtamase jhaṭiti vidyuti kriyāpratyayāt |
[ umbekaḥ -- saṃtamase iti |
rātryandhakāre vidyuti calatīti pratyayo bhavati, na tatra vyatiriktaṃ tejo'ntara- masti yannivandhanau saṃyogavibhāgau vidyutaḥ syātām |
tamasastu bhāvatve'pi tejasā'pasāritatvāt tadavayava-
saṃyogastejasaḥ saṃbhavati |
anyāvayavasaṃyoge'pi ca sarvatra calatīti pratyayo na syāt |
saṃsargidravyasya ca tejaḥ- salilāderhetavadakāryasyāvayavasaṃghātamātrarūpatvāna tadavayavī vidyate, caikadeśasaṃyoge'pi sarvatra calanapratyayaḥ syādi- tyarthaḥ |
] tasmādasti dhātūpāttadāhitaviśeṣatirivyamānātmā kriyāpadārtho bhāvanāparyāyaḥ |
[ umbekaḥ -- tasmāditi |
dhātūpāttaścāsau tadā- hitaviśeṣaśca vigrahaḥ |
tadāhita iti vyāpārahitaḥ |
gacchatyādipade pratyayapratipādyabhāvanākṛta ityarthaḥ |
viśeṣa iti guṇaviśeṣaḥ saṃyogavibhāgamātmakaḥ |
nanvevaṃ bhāvanāto dhātvarthasya niṣpattistataśca phalasyeti kathaṃ tanniṣṭhādho dhātvarthastasya karaṇam, svargādi ca anyasādhyaṃ kathaṃ karma ? tasmāt dhātvartha eva bhāvanā'stu |
svarge dhātvarthe cāntaravyāpārāntarānu- palambhādityuktam |
[ umbekaḥ -- svargamiti |
asyāyamarthaḥ - yadi dhātvarthakarmakāt vyāpārāt vyāpārāntaraṃ syāt tatastasya svargādeḥ karmatvaṃ bhavet, vyāpārāntaraniṣpāditasya dhātva- rthasya karaṇatvam, na tu tadupalabhyate ityuktam |
uktottarametat |
tathāhi --
phalena sākṣātkaraṇe kartṛṣṭhāphalārthitaḥ |
karaṇatvaṃ pradhānāṃte tādrūpyaṃ vā yatastataḥ ||
[ umbekaḥ -- tādrūpyamiti |
tādrūpyaṃ chedanarūpatvaṃ parisandasya |
tataḥ iti dvidhābhavanāt |
yasmāt dvidhā- bhavanāvacchinnaḥ paraspadaḥ chinattītyucyate tasmāt tatra parayoḥ karaṇatvamiti |
na ime anyakarmakaraṇavilakṣaṇe phaladhātvarthayoḥ karma- karaṇatve |
darśitaṃ hi ' paraśunā chinatti ' iti na hi dvidhābhāve kartṛvyāpārātirapi tu karaṇe sādhanamigodi- lakṣaṇatvāt kartuḥ |
tatraiva phale vyāpārastadabhisaṃdhānā- danyaprakāratvāt |
iyāṃstu bhedaḥ -- dhātvarthasyotpādanaṃ niyogaḥ, paraśvādestu siddhasyocyamānatvādiḥ |
vṛkṣā- deśca karmatvaṃ dvidhābhavane kartṛtvāt |
tadyai paraśuniṣṭhaṃ nipātodyamanādilakṣaṇaṃ dvidhā- bhavanaṃ prati karaṇatvam |
[ umbekaḥ -- ' karaṇatvaṃ pradhānāṃśe ' iti yaduktaṃ tadviguṇoti - tadarthamiti |
tadarthamiti tatkāraṇakaṃ vṛkṣādi- karmatvakāraṇakamityarthaḥ |
tadarthamityatra arthaśabdaḥ kāraṇa- vācī |
nipātodyamanādilakṣaṇamiti |
nipātodyamana- nimittakamityarthaḥ |
yadvā tadarthamiti vṛkṣādikarmaprayojanaṃ taccheṣabhūtaṃ tadvidhābhavanaṃ prati karaṇatvamiti |
tacca paraśoḥ karaṇatvaṃ chinattīti pradhānāpekṣākam |
tādrūpyasya tadhīnatvāt |
na hyudyamananipātanānmātra- masaṃbhavadadvidhābhavanaṃ chinattīti nirūpyate |
[ umbekaḥ -- ' tādrūpyaṃ vā yatastataḥ ' iti yaduktam, tadviguṇoti - tādrūpyasyeti |
tasmādihāpi dhātvarthasyotpādaka'nugrāhako vā kartṛ- vyāpāraḥ samuddiṣṭaphalabhavatatayā pratilavdhabhāvanāvyapadeśo dhātvarthopanibaddhapradhānāṃśatādrūpyaphalakarmako dhātvarthakaraṇaśca iti na doṣaḥ |
na hi dvidhā bhāvayati paraśuneti paraśu dvidhābhavanaṃ cāntareṇa kartṛvyāpāra eko'pyasādhyo'para- sādhana upalabhyate |
na ca karaṇatvaṃ viddham |
pradhānāṃśa- niṣpattestadadhīnatvāt |
tathaivāpi phalabhūteḥ pradhānakriyā- pekṣatvātkārakavibhaktiḥ vibhāgavyavasthāyām |
[ umbekaḥ -- evaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ vyākhyāyādhunā dārṣṭāntikaṃ yojayati - tasmādiheti |
dhātvarthopanibaddhapradhānāṃśatādrūpya iti dhātvarthakaraṇakaḥ pradhānāṃśaḥ phalabhavanaṃ tādrūpyaṃ bhāvanā- rūpatvaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ |
pradhānaṃśanimittakamapi tādrūpyaṃ pradhānāṃśa ityamedenopacaritam |
yadvā, pradhānāṃśe tādrūpyaṃ yasyeti gamakatvāt vyadhikaraṇo'pi samāsaḥ |
athavā, dhātvarthopanibaddhadhātvau tādrūpyāt : pradhānāṃśatādrūpyaśreti vigrahaḥ |
anena granthena ' tādrūpyaṃ vā ' ityayaṃ pakṣo darśitaḥ |
etaduktaṃ bhavati - yadyekaḥ kartṛvyāpāraḥ, sa ca dhātvarthagocaraḥ, tathāpi dhātvarthakaraṇakatvaṃ svargādiphalakarmakatvaṃ cāvicchinne kriyārūpatvāditi |
amumevārthe dṛṣṭāntena darśayati - nehiti |
na hi paraśu- dvidhābhavanagocarāt vyatirikto'pyasādhyaḥ aparasādhanaśca vyāpāra upalabhyate |
aparaṃ sādhyaṃ aparaṃ sādhanaṃ yasyeti
bhāvanāvivekaḥ
vyāpārasya jvalanābhighātajanmano'vayavāśritasya sthālya- dikādhikaraṇatvalambhamanātmano vā pradhānabhūtasyābhidhānāt pacantīti devadattavyāpārābhidhānāt arthabhedaḥ |
kartṛbhedaśca sidhyatīti na pratyayārtharyyanuyogātkāśaḥ |
kathaṃ punaḥ pacinā tulyārthā viklideḥ pareṇa pratyayena taṇḍula- vyāpāra eva vivakṣyate, na devadattavyāpāraḥ |
prakṛtīnāṃ rūpabhedāttulyārthatve'pi pratyayasya svārthe śaktibhedāt |
bhāryā dvārā jalanyāpa ekārthatve'pi dṛśyate |
prakṛte rūpabhedena pratyayārtho viśeṣavān |
[ umbekaḥ- bhāryādāraśabdayorjalāpaśabdayostulyā- rthatve'pi sati tatparaṃ bahuvacanamekaṃ vicitramartha ati- dadhad dṛśyate ityarthaḥ |
etadeva vivṛṇoti- jalanīti |
] jalanīti prakṛtyasamavāyi tadekārthasamavāyi vā bahutvaṃ bahuvacanasyārthaḥ |
tathā bhāryā iti |
āpo dārā iti prakṛtyavayavasamavāyi tadāśrayaikārthasamavāyi |
prakṛtīnāṃ rūpabhedāt tadapekṣatvāt pratyayāsyābhidhānaśakteḥ |
tathaivāpi paciparo dhātvarthārthasamavāyinaṃ vyāpāraṃ karma- kartṛviṣayaḥ pratyaya āha |
bhinnārthaṃ vā'nyatra |
viklidi- parastu prakṛtyarthasamavāyinamityanyavam |
[ umbekaḥ- prakṛtyarthasamavāyi iti vyaktivācya- svābhiprāyeṇa |
yatparaḥ śabdaḥ sa śabdārthaḥ ityevaṃ voktam |
‘tadekārthasamavāyi vā’ ityākṛtvāvyākhyābhiprāyeṇa |
yathoktam-- ‘kapiñjālādijātestu pratītitryaṃnisaṃkhyayā’ iti |
yeṣāṃ jalastrīvyacya evādāraprātipadikārtha iti darśanaṃ teṣāṃ prakṛtyarthavayavasamavāyitvaṃ draṣṭavyam |
