§ bhūyastvenobhayaśruti |
yajurvede jyotiṣṭomaṃ samāmananti— 'jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
tathā sāmavede'pyeṣa samā- mnātam— 'jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
sakṛcca kṛtāyāṃ kriyābuddhau dvitīyaṃ guṇārthe śravaṇaṃ bhavati |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ yājurvedikaṃ guṇārtham, uta viparītaṃ iti |
pūrvamantreṇotpattiko vedadhamau viniyoga- vidhivaśenāpyate iti pratipādya idānīṃ pradhānameva yatro- bhayatvena śrūyate, tatra katarasya vedasya saṃbandha uccaiṣṭvādi- dharmā'nuṣṭhātavya iti saṃdehe sati adhikāravākyasya ubhayatrāviśeṣāt yatrotpattistatraivānuṣṭhātavya iti sthite utpattividhiraiva kutreti vicāryate |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo- 'bhisaṃdhiḥ |
na tāvat ekato'nyasya anyatra aṅga- saṅgradhārthaṃ śravaṇam, ubhayatraivāśravaṇāviśeṣatvāt |
nāpi phale viniyogārtham, phalasyāpyubhayatra śravaṇāviśeṣāt |
ato'dhyetubhedena vikalpamevopapādakam |
yataḥ ekasya nāma vedādhyayanasaṃbhave sati svaśākhā tāvatprathamamadhyā- dhyetavyā |
tena yadetadvā śākhā yena prathamamadhītā sa eva vedastvatto'pyadhika iti śākhā'ntaravedasamuccayo'pi vyavasthaye vikalpa eveti |
evaṃ prāpte, abhīdhīyate |
bhavedevaṃ yadyabhayastvaśravaṇeṇa viśeṣāpagatirna syāt |
yajurvede hi jyotiṣṭomasya dīkṣaṇīyādiketikartavyatā bhūyasī śrūyate, na tathā vedāntare |
itikartavyatāyāḥ prakaraṇādvādyavetikartavyatā tatraiva prakaraṇam |
yatra ca prakaraṇaṃ tatraiva kartavyatāgamyatvāt |
itaratra ca guṇārthaṃ śravaṇamiti |
taduktam— 'guṇānāṃ yatra bhūya- stvamitikartavyatātmakam |
tatra tenaiva liṅgena tasya kartavyateṣyate ||

tathāhi, arthaprāpte abhyādāne vikalpena natūṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ liṅgena prāptyamānānāṃ prāpakapramāṇāt pūrvameva pravṛttena 'tāṃ caturbhirmādatte' iti vacanena mantrasaṃkhyamayaviśiṣṭā- dānabhāvanāyāṃ vihitāyāṃ etadvacanabhāve'pi mantrāṇāṃ ādānasya ca prāptisaṃbhave etadvacanapravṛttilakṣaṇajijñāsāyāṃ samuccayaphalakatvataḥ saṃkhyārūpaguṇātiriti niścīyate |
tathā liṅgādevābhidhāyanāṅgabhūtāśrvaradāne prāptamānasya mantrasya tataḥ pūrvapravṛttena 'imāmagniṃ raśanāmatyasya- śrābhidhānīmādatte' ityanena vacanena mantraviśiṣṭādāne aśrvaradājñātvena vihite pūrvavat phalajijñāsāyāṃ gardabha- raśanāniṣṭitsutpariśeṣaparisaṃkhyā phalam |
na ca phalataḥ parisaṃkhyāyāṃ svārthahāniḥ parārthakalpanaṃ prāptabādha iti traidoṣyam |
aśrvābhidhānīsaṃśrvarapurasvārthasya vidheyatvāt, anyaniṣṭitsuparārthasya arthasiddhatvena akalpanīyatvāt, prāpakapramāṇasyāpravṛttatvā prāptabādhābhāva iti |
eta eva yatra prāpakapramāṇapravṛttattvameva parisaṃkhyāśāstrasya pravṛttiḥ yathā- 'pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ' ityādī ragataḥ prāpta- pañcanakhabhakṣaṇe pañcātiriktparisaṃkhyākaraṇaṃ tatraiva tat |
yatrāpi ca śrautau parisaṃkhyā yathā 'nācṛtaṃ vadet' ityādau tatrāpi na tat |
tadevaṃ mantrāṇāmarthasmārakatve'pi na kaccidviniyogavaiyarthyam |

bhāṭṭa-- ' agnerahaṃ devayajyayā ' ' brīhīṇāṃ medha ' ityādimantreṣu samavetārthatvādityuktena agnīṣomādi- padānāṃ sauryādītyādi dvārā'ntarasaṃbandhanimittayābhāvā- tmakaḥ ūhaḥ siddha eva prokṣaṇādivat |
taddeśena padāntara- kṣepaṇāyamko bhākta ūhaḥ |
paramārthasiddho'pi ākṣipya samādhīyate |
prakṛtau hi agnīṣomādipadena agnīṣomādīnāṃ lakṣaṇayaiva apūrvasādhanatvena rūpeṇa pratipādanāt sūrya- nīvārādīnāmapi tenaiva rūpeṇa prakāśanopapatteḥ |
na padāntara- prakṣepo yuktaḥ |
ata eva ' pāśān ' iti bahuvacanānta- mantrasya prakṛtāviba ekaprāśikāyāṃ vikṛtāvāpi lakṣaṇayaiva ekatvaprakāśakatvāt nohaḥ |
nahi agnīṣomādipadaṃ śaktyā apūrvasādhanībhūtadravyadevatādiparam, api tu lakṣaṇayaiva ' śakyādanyena rūpeṇa jñāte bhavati lakṣaṇā ' iti nyāyāt |
viśeṣataśca śabdasya devatātvāt, tasya cāmipadena lakṣaṇayaiva pratīteḥ sūryasyaiva pratītisiddhau nohasiddhiḥ |
iti prāpte, satyāpi apūrvasādhanatvasya prakṛtau uddeśyatāvacchedakatve agnīṣomādipadena svaśakti- janyabodhadvārā apūrvasādhanībhūtadravyadevateti saṃskṛtāt ityartho'vagamyate |
ata eva śaklijanyabodho'pi brīhi- tyāgilādiprakāraka eva, na tu apūrvasādhanatvaprakārakaḥ |
liṅgakalpaśrutivākyena tadavacchinnasya uddeśyatve'pi mantrāntargatabrīhyādipade lakṣaṇayā pramāṇābhāvāt |
ata eva tādṛśabodhenāpi prokṣaṇajyādahavat viśeṣya eva dravyadevatādau saṃskāro janyate, na tu uddeśyatāvaccheda- dake'pi apūrvasādhanatve |
ataśca upakārakaprabhāvena dvārasya śaktijanyabodhasya vikṛtau atideśe tatprabhāvena prāpyamāṇasya anyādipadasya sauryādau dvāramidaṃyarthe padāntarakṣepo yukta eva |
ata eva agnīṣomādipadānāṃ aghavātādivat tathaiva rūpeṇa prakṛtau niruktakāryajana- katvena vidhāne'pi tatkāryābhāve iva tatkāryasya tena kartu- maśakyatve'pi yukta eva tasya vikṛtau lopaḥ |
tatra tu etāvān viśeṣaḥ |
kāryābhāve lopa eva, aśakyatve tu tajanakopāyāntarā'nuṣṭhānamiti |
yattu mkale prakṛtāveva nāvaghātasya tattvena vidheyatā, api tu apūrvasādhanatvāviśeṣopāyatvena, itarathā adṛṣṭā- rthatvāpatteḥ |
ataśca agnyādipadasya svarūpeṇa avivakṣita- tattvāt yukta eva padāntarakṣepa iti, tanna, tathātve prakṛtāveva brīhiparyāyāṇāṃ vidalanādeśa anuṣṭhāne vaiguṇyā- nāpatteḥ, yenaiva rūpeṇa mukhyakāryaṃ prati janakatā, tenaiva rūpeṇa niyamādṛṣṭaṃ pratyapi janakatvaucityācca |
yattu agni- padena śabdarūpadevatāprakāśanārthaṃ lakṣaṇavadyamabhāva iti,

asata'pi guṇena asato'pi guṇinaḥ stuti- buddhayutpattisaṃbhavāt |
ata eva arthavādādhikaraṇe eva 'prajāpatirātmano vapāmudakhidat' ityatra mahābhūta- viṣayatvena bhāṣyoktāṃ vyākhyāṃ 'evaṃ tu (kintu) stutitvameva hīyate' iti dūṣayitvā arthavādādimūlikāṃ sṛṣṭilayapravītimātreṇa asato'pi prajāpateḥ asataḥ'pi guṇena stutīraṅgīkṛtā (vārtike), tasmāt stotramantreṣu yāthārthyena abhyāsameva, mantrārthānusaṃdhānaviṣayaṃ tu prāmāṇyaṃ saṃbhavati iti tadeva yuktaṃ iti siddham |

bahu- yajamāneṣu ekavacanadaḥ uhyate |
evaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prayogo bhaviṣyati |
svāmino vaikaśyādutkarṣo devatāyāṃ syāt patnyā dvitīyaśabdaḥ syāt |

yadā svāminaḥ, tadā medhapataye yo meghaḥ, taṃ medhyā dura upanayata iti saṃbandhaḥ |
yadā devatāvacanaḥ, tadā medha- pataye upanayata medhyā duraḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ |
sa eṣa sakṛ- duccaritaḥ ubhābhyāṃ padābhyāṃ na saṃbandhamutsahate |
vacana- vyaktibhedād vākyabhedaḥ prasajyate |
tasmāt svāmino vācaka iti adhyavasīyate |
atha kimarthaṃ na devatā- vacanaḥ kalpyate ? tathāhi kalpyamāne ekavacanada utkarṣeta ekadevatve kṛtau |
tatra prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate |
yajamānavacane punaḥ kalpyamāne na dvivacanada utkarṣeta |

devatā tu tadāśīṣṭvāt saṃtrāptatvāt svāminya- narthikā syāt |
bhāṣyam-- tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati |
na svāmi- vacanaḥ, devatāparo bhaviṣyati |
kutaḥ ? tadāśīṣṭvāt |
' āśāsānā medhapataye megham ' iti devatāyāṃ haviśa- śāstre, medhapatibhyāṃ medhamāśāsānā upanayata tābhyāṃ iti |
yajamānaṃ prati āśāsānākīrtanamarthakaṃ arthatvaṃ ca |
sa prāpta eva svāminaṃ meghaḥ kimarthamāśāsyate |
na ca tena nityameva svāmisaṃbandhena prayojanam |
yāga eva hi na saṃvataṃta |
tasmāt devatāvacano medhapatiśabda iti |
dup-- siddhāntastu devatādipakṣaḥ |
svāmipakṣe vākyārtha eva tāvanna ghaṭate, āśāsānapadānarthakyāt |
api ca yajamānāya medhapataye yo meghaḥ, taṃ medhyā duraḥ yajadvāra upanayata |
kimarthaṃ iti prayojanārthatvāt asamartho vākyārthaḥ |
na ca medhamanūya kiṃcit vidhīyate iti |
itarāthā (devatāpakṣe) medhyā dura upanayata medhapataye medhaṃ kartuṃ ityevamāśāsānāḥ ityupapanno vākyārthaḥ |
na ca parakīyo devatāyai kartuṃ śakyate ityarthāt yo'yaṃ yajamāna- sveti |
utsargācca bhaktyā tariman patitvaṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- utsṛṣṭaṃ ca yajamānena nāyaṃ mameti |
kevalaṃ parakīyo rakṣyate |
kālena devatā saṃbhanyate iti |
kaḥ punarasya devatā saṃbandhaḥ, yat tāsuddiśya parigraho'sya tyajyate |
sa ca yāgaḥ prāk kṛtaḥ |
tasmāt yāgāt parārtha dravyaṃ nālītyam, parityajya āste |
ātmapradhānaṃ yat tadātmīyam, na yaṃ prati ātmā guṇabhūtaḥ |
tādṛśo tu bhaktyā patitvaṃ bhavati |
tasmādeva- tayoreva tatra meghaṃ medhapatitvam, bhaktaṃ svāmina iti |
utkarṣasyaikasaṃyukte dvivacanate'saṃbhavāt |
bhāṣyam-- iti yaduktam, tat parihartavyam |
ekastu samavāyāt tasya tallakṣaṇatvāt |
bhāṣyam-- atrocyate |
yau hi tau dvau amīpamau tayoragaṇe medhapatiśabdaḥ |
sa cātra devatāsameveta |
tasmin karmaṇi ekasmai gaṇāya meghamupanayata ityucyate |
tasmāt ekavacanānto gaṇavācī medhapatiśabdo noṣkṛṣyate iti |
saṃsargācca tasmāt tena vikalpaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- ayaṃ cānyaḥ parihāraḥ |
saṃsargī aya- maryā devatā nāma |
dvāvarthau saṃsṛṣṭau ekatvā devatā bhavati |
yadi dvayāya parikalpitaṃ kiṃcid dravyam, tatra dvayaṃ devatā bhavati |
dvāvarthau saṃsṛṣṭau ekatāṃ yātaḥ |
tasmāt ekavacanānto'pi prakaraṇamabhiniviśate, pūrveṇa ca saha vikalpyate iti |
ekatve'pi guṇānāpāyāt |
bhāṣyam-- anvārabdha vacanamidam |
mā tāvat bhūt ihekatvamarthaḥ |
tathāpi prakaraṇaṃ anupraviśetaiva eka- vacanāntaḥ |
prātipadikaṃ hi tasya vidyamānārthyam |
eka- vacanaṃ ca upanayanasaṃbandhāthyam |
ekatvaṃ vā avivakṣitam |
tasmāt na prakaraṇadutkṛṣyate |
ayocyate, ekatva- viśiṣṭasya vibhaktiḥ saṃbandhaṃ bravīti iti |
tathāpi asattapakṣa upapadyatetarām |
sarvo'pi hi ekatvasaṃbaddha iti |
atha saṃbandhaṃ karoti ekatvaṃ ca bravīti, na tena viśinaṣṭi, avivakṣitatvāt atiruddhaṃ bhaviṣyati |
athocyate avivakṣita'pi vacane ekatvasaṃbandhe ekavacanaṃ bhavati nānyatreti, tathā medhapatitaṃ ekatvaṃ asya bhaviṣyati, tataḥ so'nuvadiyate |
tassādadoṣa iti |

atra ' paśurye medho yajamāno medhapatiryajamānameva tat svena medhena samarpayati ' (aitrā. 6|16) iti pūrvapakṣaprati- pādanapūrvakam ' atho tvalpāhurvaisya vāca kathyaṃ devatāyai

sa yathaikadevatyaḥ paśuḥ syāt medhapataya iti brūyāt, yadi dvidevatyo medha- patibhyāmiti, yadi bahudevatyo medhapatibhyaḥ ' (aitrā. 6|16-6) ityetareyāmnānaṃ nāstīti kṛtvācintyaṃ ityuktaṃ tantraratne-- medhapatitvaṃ svāmino devatāyāstrayāṇāmapi medhasamavāyāt, sarvatra cādhipatye patiśabdaprayogān triṣu caikavacanasyāyyanigadatvāt sarvāsu vikṛtiṣu avikāra iti |
vi-- ' avikāro vikāro vā syānmedhapatiśabdayoḥ |
vikāre svāmidevārthe ekārtho vā'ntima'pi kim |
svāmyau devatā vā, syādanyatve'to''grimaḥ |
atha- medād vikāro'tra dvāvarthau śabdayordvayoḥ |
mantraikyādatha eko'tra svāminman jāyayā dvitā |
devārthādatha eko'dhiṣṭhāne dve dvicoraṇam |
bhā-- tatraiva praiṣe (agnipraiṣe) ' upanayata medhyā dura āśāsānā medhapatiyāṃ megham ' iti śrutam |
keṣāṃ- cit śāstriṇāṃ ' medhapataye megham ' iti |
tatra na tāvat śālābhedana atra mantrabhedaḥ, ekadeśavailakṣaṇyā'pi śāstrā- ntarādhikaraṇanyāyena (2|4|28-33) pratyabhijñānabalena tadekatvāvagateḥ |
tataśca tadartho'pi eka eva vācyaḥ |
tena medhasya patoḥ patiḥ yajamāno devatā vā arthyaḥ ; na tubhayam |
na ca medhapatitvasya śakyatāvacchedakasya ekatvāt tadavacchidyobhayābhidhāne'pi na doṣa iti vācyam |
tathā'pi iha itarapadānāṃ tattadarthaghaṭitata- dvākyārthaviṣayakakṣaṇobhayajanyatvakatvānupapatteḥ |
tathāhi, yajamānaparatve yajamānāya yo meghaḥ patyuḥ bhogasādhanatvena āsīt taṃ medhyā bhavantaḥ ṛtvijaḥ duraḥ yajadvāraṃ cātvā- lokatarthyam upanayata svakīyadakṣiṇāyajamānasya phalaṃ vā āśāsānāḥ : santaḥ ityarthaḥ |
devatāpakṣe devatāyai medhaṃ patyuṃ āśāsānā medhyā bhavantaḥ taṃ duraḥ prati upanayata ityarthaḥ |
sarvathā vilakṣaṇabodhajanaka- tyānupapatteḥ ekarūpa evārtho vācyaḥ |
na ca bodhadvaya- janakatve sakṛduccaritasya sakṛdarthapratyāyakatvaṃ iti niyama-

māsārthe ca sāṅgaṃ phale vidhīyate |
tasmānna sāṅgami- hotrapadavācyaṃ darśapūrṇamāsapadavācyam ( ca ) |
yadyagni- hotraṃ tadiha cocyate kartavyatayā, yau ca darśapūrṇamāsau |
tasmādviguṇamapi kartavyameva agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau ca |
yathā kratvantareṣu - prakṛtivikṛtiṣu parasya dharmaḥ parasya na bhavanti, evaṃ na kāmasaṃyuktasya dharmā nityasya bhavitu- marhanti |
vidhyaparādhe ca darśanāt samāpteḥ |
bhāṣyam - vidhyaparādhe ca samāptiṃ darśayati |
‘ tadeva yādṛk tādṛk hotavyam ’ iti viguṇasya samāptiṃ darśayati |
prāyaścittavidhānācca |
bhāṣyam - vidhyaparādhe ca prāyaścittāni vidhī- yante, nimitte karmāṅgabhūtāni |
yathā, bhinne juhoti |
viguṇe niṣphale sati kasyāṅgabhūtaḥ ? prayojanaṃ syāt |
tasmāt viguṇānāmapi prayogaḥ kartavya iti |

tatrāpi tasya sāmarthyamanādyeva pratīyate ||

na prayogāvidyastasya mleccheṣvapi dṛśyate |

samā vipratipattiḥ syādāryamlecchaprayogataḥ ||

samā viprati- pattiḥ syānmūlasāmyād dvayorapi ||

ācārāṇāṃ tathaiveti na viśeṣo balāvale ||
yadvā''sscārabalīyastvaṃ phala- śrutvāt pratīyate |
phalādavijuyyamānaṃ hi pramāṇaṃ durbalyībhavet ||
śrutirācāramūlaṃ yā phalasthā sopa- labhyate |
yāvaddidaṃ smaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrutiranumā- syate ||
tāvattvadāmntaḥ pūrvamācāraḥ pratitiṣṭhati |
pratiṣṭhitasya bādhāya kīdṛśaḥ parikalpyatām ||
tenā''sscārabalīyastvaṃ samatvaṃ veha yujyate |
smṛtīnāṃ vā balīyastvaṃ śāstrasthā veti varṇyate ||
( ubhayoḥ śrutimūlatvaṃ na smṛtyācārayoḥ samam ||
) sapralayapraṇītā hi smṛtiḥ sopanibandhanā |
tathā śrutilanumānaṃ hi nirvinnamupajāyate ||
ācārāt smṛtiṃ jñātvā śrutirvijñāyate tataḥ |
tena dṛṣṭanta- ritaṃ tasya prāmāṇyaṃ viprakṛṣyate ||
na hyekaiva śrutiḥ kācidācārāṇāṃ pravartikā |
minnābhiviprakīrṇa- tvānāmasmābhiḥ pravartanam ||
naikaprapāṭhakena hyācā- rāṇāṃ viddhisithatiḥ |
kvacitprakaraṇe kaścit kathaṃ cidupalabhyate ||

na caitanniyato'rthataḥ prāptam, yena ' tasmātprajā daśa māsān garbhe dhṛtvā, ekādaśa- manu prajāyante, tasmādaśvatthaḥ prajāḥ ' itivat svabhāva- prāptatvārthāstvena vā ' tasmādaśvatthe vayasi putrā pitopajīvati ' itivadanuyeta ityato nyāyāt puruṣadharma- vidhiḥ |
evam ' annameva tadkṣiṇato dadhāti, tassā- jñiṇena hastena puruṣo'nnamatti ' iti |
' dīkṣito nayanaṃ dakṣiṇa prathamamannute, savyaṃ hi manuṣyaḥ pūrvamanne dyite ' iti |

dīrghaśūkapriyaṅgvādyā dvye'pyarthā vikalpitāḥ |
, yatrānyā iti śāstrasthā prasiddhastu balīyasī |
śāstrīyadharmaṃ tenātra priyaṅgvādi na gṛhyate |
gurumatamāha— 'yavādyarthanirṇayena tadvākyaṃ na prameti cet |
na śāstrasya batvitvena tatsiddhyā'rthanirṇa- yāt |
vātikamatena varṇāntaramāha— 'yo mātula- vivāhādau śiṣṭācāraḥ sa mā na vā |
, itarācāravat mātya- mamālaṃ smārtatvāt |
, smṛtisūle hi sarvatra śiṣṭā- cārastato'tra ca |

tathā prāpte, brūmaḥ |
vikṛtau abhyadhikaṃ yat, tat pratikṛṣyamāṇaṃ tato'rvācīnānyapi agnīṣomapraṇayanādīni na pratikarṣamahati |

tasmin apakṛṣṭe prayājanyāyena (5|1|12) tadantāhasamūhasya apakarṣaṇāt, praṇayanamapi apakṛṣyatāṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |

prāyājavat tadantatvādyanyaṃ cāpakṛṣyatām |

prayājādhāravattvebhyaḥ śrutamātrāpa- karṣaṇam |
bhāṭṭa-- saumikāgnīṣomapraṇayananantaraṃ 'paścahṛtyā yūpaṃ chinatti' ityutpannaṃ yūpacchedanaṃ 'dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti' ityanenāpakṛṣṭaṃ prayājanyāyena (5|1|12) prāco'pi padārthānāṃ agnīṣomapraṇayanādīn apakarṣati |
iti prāpte, bhinnaprayogavidhiparigṛhītatvena atra pāṭhasya kramāniṣṭhāmāstatvāt mahāprayogavidheśce'pi vā utpatti- vidhivelāyāṃ prayogatvyānatvena kramākāṅkṣātvāt pāṭhasya kramātpatvatvena baddhakramatvābhāvāt dīkṣākāla- vidhivākye ca prayojyatvāgamane tatraiva kramāpekṣatayā bhinnaprayogavidhiparigṛhītairapi somāgnīkṣākālīnapadārthaiḥ pāṭhena kramaklṛpnāt tatraiva samahotṛhomānantaraṃ yūpacchedana- mātraṃ yūpotyādakadharmamātraṃ vā apakṛṣya kāryam |
na tu tadantākapathaṃ |

paśau yūpanikhanane ardhamanta- rvedi ardhe bahirvedi iti upalakṣitadeśaviśeṣasya tridhānam |
tathā yūpasya vediḥ |
bhāṣyam -- asti jyotiṣṭome paśurdīkṣaṇīyo : 'yo dīkṣito yadīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tatra yūpaṃ prakṛtya śrūyate 'vajro vai yūpo yadantarvedi mino- tyet, yadvahirvedi anavaruddhaḥ syāt ardhamantarvedi mino- tyet tadarthaṃ bahirvedi anavaruddha bhavati na nirdahati' iti |
tatra sandehaḥ, kimantarvedi iti yūpasyābhyantena vedi- rūpadiśyate, uta ardhamantarvedi, ardhaṃ bahirvedi iti deśalakṣaṇārthamucyate iti |
kathaṃ yūpasyābhāvena, kathaṃ vā deśalakṣaṇeti |
yadi yūpasyārdhasya vedyantarasya ca saṃbandho vivakṣitaḥ, evaṃ vedirdvayoḥ kartavyaḥ, tato yūpasyābhāvena |
atha yasmin deśe mīyamānasyādhaṃ vedyabhyantare, ardhaṃ ca bahiḥ; sa deśa upadiśyate, tato deśalakṣaṇa |
kiṃ prāptam ? yathā yūpasya vediḥ |
yathā dīkṣādakṣiṇa pradhānasya, tathā yūpasya vediḥ |
tathā yūpo mātavyaḥ, tathā mīyamānasyārdhaṃ vedyabhyantare bhavati |
evaṃ vedisthitirapyanugṛhīṣyate, itarā vediśchedo lakṣyadeśam |
śrutilakṣaṇaviśeṣye śrutinyāyyā, na lakṣaṇā |
tasmāt yūpasyābhāvena vedirniradiśyate |
vā -- 'ardhamantarvedi minotyardhaṃ bahirvedi' iti kimanrtarvededyo yūpasyāntena vidhīyate, atha bahirvedi- deśamiśraṃśadeśamātraṃ lakṣyati |
nanu ca purastāt (cikīrṣayā ca saṃyogān ityasminnadhikaraṇe 3|7|17) sarvārthatvamavasthāya idānīmukte vicāraḥ |
sthite etasminnadhikaraṇe tadadvayam |
yadi hi vākyasaṃyogāt yūpārthatā bhavet kutastadā kaimadhyavicārāvasare |
sthite punardeśalakṣaṇārthatve tadarthyatadarthatve yujyate |
kiṃ prāptam ? prakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā yūpasya vākyasaṃyogādvidhumahati |
lakṣaṇā hītarathā syāt |
na cāntarvedideśasya śrauto'rthaṃ na samavaiti yato lakṣaṇā prapadyate |
tasmāt 'iti śakyāmaha' ityapi sāmānyaśāstraṃ yūpaviṣayamevopasaṃhṛtya vedeḥ vyāptatvaṃ pratipadyama|
athavā pūrvvādhikaraṇena sthite sāṅgatyotiṣṭomārthatve kiṃ yūpārthatvamapyasti nāstīti vicāryate|
na tena siddhaṃ yūpārthatvamiti na vicāraṇīyama|
na tena siddhaṃ yūpasya paśvaṅgatvāt|
jyotiṣṭomasya hi sāṅgatya vediṃ paśoḥ|
nanu ca paśurapi svāṅgabhūtāṅgebhyo dāsyati|
dadyāt yadi tasya svamahimnā vedirbhavet|
pradhānadvāreṇa tatvatarantī tatsvarūpamātre evāvatiṣṭhate|
prāpte ca vedi kāryye atideśena prāpnuvatī darśapūrṇamāsikī vediṃ nirā- kṛtya paśvādiṣu saumikī niviśate|
sā prākṛtebhya vedikāryeṣu viniyoktavyā|
na cedaṃ yūpamānaṃ prākṛtaṃ yato vediṃ lemeta|
tasmātprāpteryūpasya laukikyatha deśabuddhyā antarvediharvā māne prāpte anena vacanenārthasyāntarvedi- niyamyate|
iti prāpte'bhidhīyate|

kutaḥ?|
aśiṣyeṇa vākyatvāt|
'ardha- mantarvedi minotyardhaṃ bahirvedi' ityetanevākyatayā sā, śāsitatvena yadi deśalakṣaṇā|
atha yūpasyābhāvena vedyā nirdeśaḥ, tato na śāsitavyo vahirvedideśo bhavati|
vedyāṃ yūpasyābhāvena upadiśyamānāyāma, ardhaṃ bahirvediteya|
duccāryyamāṇaṃ na kaścicchidrūpate vartate|
atha bahirvedi- deśamapi yūpasyābhāvenopadiśeta, vākyaṃ bhidyeta|
tasmā- dyūpasyābhāvena vedyā nirdeśe bahirvedideśaḥ sarvathā na śāsitavyaḥ|
yadi tu deśalakṣaṇā, tato viśiṣṭe deśe lakṣamāṇe avaśyavaktavyo bahirvedideśo bhavati|
anucyamāne, vedyabhyantare yasmin kasmiṃśca pradeśe yūpaḥ iti gamyate|
atha punarvahirvedideśe śrūyamāṇe, yatarasmin deśe mīyamānasyārdhamantarvedi ardhaṃ bahirvedi, sa deśo lakṣyitumiṣyate bhavati|
sa ca bahirvedideśena vinā na śakyate lakṣayitumavaśyaṃ śāsitavyo bhavati|
tasmāddeśalakṣaṇe|
vā-- ubhābhyāmanrtarvedibahirvedideśabhyāṃ madhyadeśo lakṣyate nājñādvibhāvo vidhīyate|
'kṛtaḥ?|
kṛtārtha- saṃyoge deśakālopalakṣaṇam|
sarveṣṭivat, kṛtārthau ca vedimupāvihānyataḥ|
aṅgāṅgibhāve hi yūpe vā vediṃ bhavedeveti yūpaṅgam, na caikamapyupapadyate, nirā- kāṅkṣatvādadahakalpanādākyabhedaprasaṅgācca|
na tāvat paśu- bandhadhāpūtasya yūpasya vediṃ prati apekṣā'sti|
nāpi kartṛhavistadupakaraṇadhāraṇavyāptāyā vedeḥ sahasrabhāgāṃśa- saṃbandhināpi yūpe apekṣā|
na cānyatarasya dṛṣṭopakāritva mavakalpate|
kiṃ cārthe bahirvedītyaśiṣyam, vidhinuvādatvā- sambhavāt tvatpakṣe|
matpakṣe tu dvābhyāṃ vinā deśaviśeṣo- palakṣaṇāsaṃbhavatvāddeśyaṃ śāsitavyametat|
kathaṃ samastasya yūpasyāntarvediharvā māne prāpte 'ardhamantarvedi' iti niya- myate, dvitīyasya arthasya punarapyaniyamaprasaktau|
'ardhaṃ bahirvedi' ityapi cintāyyam|
tataścānekārthatvādvākya- bhedaḥ, minotyākhyātānupaśleṣaśca prasajyate|
pākṣi- kasya ca nityadanuvādo'narthakaḥ kalpayitavyaḥ|
nanu cārdhasyāntarvedideśaṃmye vihite vidhabhāvādardhāntaraṃ bahirvedi bhaviṣyati|
bhavedevama, yadi nityamantarvedi bahirvedicaiva vā yūpamāne prasakte syāt|
samastantarvedideśe hi sati ardhapunarvacanasāmarthyāt parisaṃkhyāyatesya vahirmāṇaṃ gamyate|
samastasya vā bahireva prasakte ardhasyāvihitamiti tadavasthamardhāntaramantarvedītyeva|
na tvetadubhayamapyasti|
ataścedśamavadhāraṇamardhamantarvedicaiva na tvardhamevāntarvedi|
tathā sati cārdhāntaramaniyatatvāt kadācidantarapi prāpno- tīti na vahirbhātaḥ sidhyatīti|
nanu yadi samasta- mantarvedi minoti, tato'rdhamantarvedītyeva vidhinaiva kuryāt|
kathaṃ na karoti, yadyarthaṃ tatrāvattu niyamato'ntarminoti etatrca vihitaṃ netarat pratiṣiddham|
tasmādubhābhyāṃ viśiṣṭa eva deśo'bhidhīyate ityevamavākyabhedaḥ|

śa--‘kavatīṣu rayaṃtaraṃ gāyati’ ityanena rayaṃtaraśabdena kiṃ kavatīṣu atidiśyate iti parijñānārthaṃ rayaṃtarādiśabdāḥ kiṃ gītiviśiṣṭāṇāṃ ‘abhi tvā śūra notumaḥ’ ityādīnāṃ vācakāḥ uta gītimātrasya iti cintyate |

'ṛtāpāḍ ṛtadhāmāgnirgandharvastasyauṣadhayo'psarasa ūrjo nāma sa idaṃ brahmakṣatraṃ pātu tā idaṃ brahmakṣatraṃ pāntu tasmai svāhā tābhyaḥ svāhā' iti mantre 'pi saliṅka-kapadānāṃ vyatiṣaktānāṃ yathārthaṃ vinikṣiṣya mantradvayīkṛtya ('ṛtāpāḍ ṛtadhāmā gandharvastasyauṣadhayo'psarasa ūrjo nāma sa idaṃ brahmakṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā' iti prathamo mantraḥ |

nanu evamapi bahudo'rthā revatyo vāravantīyaṃ tatsaṃbandho yāga: paśukāmaśceti |
naiṣa doṣa: |
bahava: śrūyante |
eko'tra vidhīyate yāgo viśiṣṭa: |
na nanu revatyo'pi vidhīyante vāravantīyamapi |
yadi na vidhī- yeran naiva tadviśiṣṭo yāga: pratīyeta |
na hyavidhāya viśeṣaṇaṃ śakyate viśiṣṭe vidhātum |
tasmāt bahuṣu vidhīyamāneṣu naikārtham |
atrocyate |
atha iti prayojana- janamabhidhīyate |
yāvanti padānyekāṃ prayojanamabhinirvarta- yanti, tāvantyekaṃ vākyam |
na cātra bahūni prayojanāni |
na hyatra anekasya abhipretasya anekaṃ padaṃ vidhāyakam |
revatīṣviti naitadevaṃ revatīnāṃ vidhāyakam |
revatīṣu vāravantīyamityātrāpi padadvaye vāravantīyaśabde dvitīyānta: |
nāsmāt saṃbandho'bhipreto gamyate |
prātipadikārthasya vyatirekāt |
kṛtvetyapi karotinaṃ saṃbandhamātre paryava- sita: |
paraprayojanasaṃbandhamāha |
evaṃ viśiṣṭasya yajatinaṃ parārtha: |
tadekamevā padārthānyāṃ prayojanam |
tasmāt ekavākyatvam |
guṇe puna: phale prakalpyamāne'gniṣṭoma- sāmna: kāryaṃ vāravantīyam |
etasya ca yadagniṣṭomasāmeti vākyabheda: syāt |
athocyeta, revatyādisarvaviśeṣaṇa- viśiṣṭo yāga etasyāgniṣṭomato vidhīyate |

atha evamucyate |

naivaṃ śakyam |
naḍantarapramāṇādidoṣeṇāhatairaguṇai: syāt |
nanu idānīmevoktaṃ śakyate hi revatīṣu vāravantīyaṃ kartu- miti |
sati vacane śakyam |
asati vacane na vāra- vantīyagrahaṇe gṛhyante |
vacanaṃ tarhi bhaviṣyati |
paśu- kāmo revatīṣu vāravantīyamabhinivartayet |
tato yajeteti yajatinuvāda: |
yadi vacanaṃ revatīṣu vāravantīya- saṃbandhasya, siddhaṃ karmāntaram, nāmiṣṭhato guṇavidhi: |
nanu tato yajeteti yāgānuvādāt yāgenāsyā- jñamyojanasaṃbandho bhaviṣyati |
naivaṃ śakyam |
yāgaṃ prayojanabhāve vidhīyamāne paśukāmaṃ pratyasaṃbandham |
ubhaya- saṃbandhe vākyaṃ bhidyeta |

revatyadhikaraṇam
syeti lakṣaṇāśabdo bhaviṣyati |
tasmāt guṇāt phalaṃ karmāntaramevaṃdharmakamiti siddhaṃ sameṣvevaṃjātīyakeṣu karma- yuktaṃ phalamiti |
dup-- idānīṃ asyāpavādārthaṃ uttaramadhikaraṇamāra- bhyate |
tatra viṣayaṃ tāvaddarśayati-- 'trivṛdagniṣṭoma- glomaḥ' |
'tasya vāyavyāśvekaraviṃśamagniṣṭoma sāmatvā brahmavarcasakāmo yajeta' ityetamiśritaṃ prakṛtya 'vāravantīya- magniṣṭoma sāmyaṃ' iti ca guṇaṃ vidhāya punarbravīti 'etasyaiva revatīṣu vāravantīyamagniṣṭoma kṛtvā paśukāmo yejeta' iti |
tatrāpi pūrvadeva saṃdehaḥ kiṃ guṇaviśiṣṭe yāgaḥ pūrvasmāt vyatiriktaḥ śrocate, kiṃ vā pūrvasyaiva guṇādindriyavat paśavaḥ phalamiti |
kiṃ tāvanmātram ? samastenaiva pūrvādhikaraṇe guṇāt phala- miti |
tathāhi-- 'revatīvāravantīyasaṃbandhanyā- pute vidhau |
śrūyate phalamaprāpi yāgo'to na vidhīyate |
revatīvāravantīyasaṃbandhaṃ ca kari- ṣyati |
vinaiva pratyāyāgutvā kṛtvāśabdaḥ pṛthak śrutiḥ |
'yastu revatīvāravantīyasaṃbandhopattividhānāt tasya ca phalaṃ prati vidhānāt pratyāyāgutvilakṣaṇo vākyabheda āśaṅkyate, so'pi na āyāṅkitavyaḥ, svayameva vedena taphalasyopāttatvāt |
revatīṣu vāravantīyaṃ kṛttveti niṣpā- dite hi
arthādakṣipyamāṇānāṃ na vidhāyakatvāt bhindanti |
kriyāntaraviśeṣaṇe punarvidhīyamāne, tayā kriyā saṃbandha- rahitayā anākṣipyamāṇe avaśyaṃ vidhāyakasya āvṛtti- revvyeti vākyabhedaḥ prāptotyeva |
naiṣa doṣaḥ |
'kṛtvā- śabdārthameva gṛhīte bhāvanottarā |
so'pi sva- gocaraprāptaṃ mahīṣyati viśeṣaṇam |
nacena kratunā paścātsāhagrahaṇe kṛte |
kalpasthānena sāmnaiva revatīsyākalanapalā |
'revatīsyākalanapalā saṃbandhaṃ niṣpā- yottarabhāvanāpekṣo'vasthitaḥ |
svaviśeṣaṇākṣepa eva śabdārthaḥ |
kratunā gṛhyate |
ataśca svaviśeṣaṇākṣepa eva kratoḥ |
sa tu tatsaṃbandhaṃ sākṣādanujīvanaṃ guṇabhūtatvā- dajñeṣu nikṣipan atideśaviśātasvānavārantīyaśabdena revatīrapi tadviṣayāḥ kalpayati |
tena yadyapya vākye agniṣṭomasāma na vidhīyate tathāpi kratuviśeṣaṇamapi tatra saṃkrāmatīyadoṣaḥ |
ataśca prakṛtayāgasaṃbandhavastvapekṣa vāgantīyasya nāsti |
padya |
'ātmanā hakriyārūpai- guṇairāśrayate kriyā |
vārantīyagītestu kriyāyā kiṃ prayojanam |
' dadhigodanādīni kriyayā vinā karaṇa- tvamalamabhānāni tāmepekṣante |
vārantīyaṃ punargayatidhātu- vācyakriyātmakatvāt vinaiva kriyāntareṇa yāgavatphalamatrana- samarthamityanenapakṣatvāt yāgenāsaṃyamānaṃ svatantrameva revatīṣu gīyamānamagniṣṭomaprayogahetave phalaṃ sādhayet |
tataśca etasyaiveti na agniṣṭomāseti ca kṛtvā- śabdaśca yajeteti ca sarvamasaṃbaddhaṃ syāt |
tasmāt yāgāt phalam |
sa ca pūrvavilakṣaṇaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭa- tvāt karmāntaram |
'sameṣviti' ayogyatvāt yāga- guṇayorāśrayāśrayasaṃbandhapekṣābhiprāyam |
kriyātmaka- tvādvā kriyāntarānapekṣatvamucyate |
'bhikṣāvatyeviti' |
pakṣadvaye'pi guṇaphalasaṃbandhasya yāgāntaraviṣayasya vā arthāntaratvāt setsyatyeva lakṣaṇato vākyabhede pūrva- kratusaṃbandhe bhavatyeva kiṃcideva vākyarūpam |
kratvantara- saṃbandhe tu atyantabheda ityabhiprāyaḥ |
'na hyetasya revatyaḥ santi' — ānantyāttvādeṣā vacanavyaktiḥ pratibhāti, etasya yā revatyastāsu vārantīyaṃ kṛteti |
tatra yadyapi prakaraṇalabhyatvāt etasyeti viśeṣaṇavādo na vākyaṃ bhinatti, tathā''pi revatīsvarūpakartavyaiva tāvada- pratīte nānyacūte |
tatra revatyaḥ prayoktavyāḥ; tāsu ca vārantīyamityetasmin vākyabhedaḥ, etacchabdavaiyarthyaṃ ca |
atha tu etacchandānugrahāthametasya revatyaḥ kartavyāḥ; tāsu ca vārantīyamityayam, tacca phalyateti vīkīyate yajjijñāsanūyate iti, tathā''pi arthayatranimittatvākyabhedamāpyagamanena agni- ṣṭomasāmasaṃbandho vidhātumamudradituṃ vā aśakyatvāt uma- yathā'pi nāvakalpate |
atha so''pi vidhīyate, tathā sati pūrvasmāt vidhyapagamāt agniṣṭomasāmamātraprasaṅgā- detasyaivetyanarthakam, vidhīyamāne vākyabheda ityekā grantha- yojanā |
athavā- yathākramāvasthita evaitacchabdo revatī- viśeṣaṇaṃ sa tathābhūta evābhyupagamyate |
tataścaiva vacanaṃ dhyajyate- etasya yā revatyastāsu vārantīyamagniṣṭomasāma kṛteti |
tat kasya kratorityaviśeṣaṇādetacchabdasya ca revatīviśeṣaṇatvena upakṣīṇatvādetasya agniṣṭomasāmeti na labhyate |
tadviṣayāyāṃ vā punarapi vākyabhedaḥ |
ihaiva sarvāḥ pūrvapakṣavacanavyaktīḥ nirākṛtya, siddhānte kathamākyabheda iti praṣṭavye pūrvapakṣavādī vismitaḥ pṛcchati |
tathā nāma saṃprati vihite sati anena ākāṅkṣā eveyanto vākyabhedā indrajālavadeva darśitāḥ |
tataḥ pṛcchāmi tāvadetasya kathamavākyabheda iti |
siddhānta- vādī tvaprāptakarma vidhīyate |
viśiṣṭavidhānopapattau satyāmekākāryatvāttvāt |
nacyaṃyabheda iti—kṛttvāttvā- topāttabhāvanādvaidhakyavākyatvāsaṃbhavābhiprāyeṇa |
'neti brūmaḥ' iti-- guṇabhūtaiḥkabhāvanāviśiṣṭhapradhānabhūtabhāvanā- ntaravidhānābhiprāyam |
revatīnāṃ vārantīyasya ca saṃbandho na vihitaḥ syāditi'-- viśeṣaṇaviśe- ṇaiva vidhīyatetyādiṣvā tāvan vidhīyate |
kṛtvāśabdaśca naiva vidhī smaryate |
tena yadyapi bhāvanā''bhi- dhīyate, tathāpi vidhyadhīnapravṛttitvāt puruṣaḥ satīmapi tāmasamīya pratipadyate |
tena yāgabhāvanāmātraviśeṣaṇa- tvāt revatīvārantīyayostadavihabhāvāmātreṇa prayoktavyora- nyonyaniyamapramāṇābhāvāt ekastatraviṣayatve tadekadeśa- niyame nāsati revatīṣu ṛśvanayāpi gāyatrāmahīyavā- dīni sāmāni prāpnuvanti |
sāmāpi vārantīyamayā-
svāvāpabhūtāsu gāyatrīvṛtyutnuṣṭup prāpnoti |
tatra revatīṣu 'nanvevamapīti' |
yāvadamidheyaṃ vidhikalpanādanekāryatvāt vārantīyamiti saṃbandhapratītyarthaṃ syāt |
ato vāra- naikākyatvamiti manyate |
naiṣa doṣaḥ iti |
na tāvada- ntīyameveya yathāvatsthānamuddiśya revalo vihitā iti |
bhidheyanātvāttvenānekāryatvaṃ bhavatītyuktam |
atha prayo- naiṣa doṣaḥ |
'vidhitaṃ yadyapi śrutvā na kṛteveti janabhūtavidheyanātvāttvameva manyethāḥ |

' sarvatra yatredaṃ kṛtedaṃ kuryāditi śrūyate tatra yadi bhāvanā sā ca yāga ityupalakṣitaḥ |
' 'nanu tāvatsāntadhātuvācyā kriyā''nyata eva prāptā tato nimi- revatyo'pi vidhīyante' iti |
yadi śrutamātrānupālyate- tārthe śravaṇaṃ bhavati |

ete tu sarve karaṇaṃ pūrvarnivṛttyuttarakālatvena vihitaṃ tāmanujñāya yathā vidhīyamānatvādyojanabhūtāstasmādekārthatvamastyeveti |

dijñāyate |

' kṛtaśriṣāt, yena nimittatayā āśriyeta |
tasmāt anu- tadāha- 'na hyatrānaikasya' prayojanatvena 'abhipretasyāne- jñeya eva vijñāyate |
yadi tarhi anujñeyatvena saṃbandha upa- padaṃ' |
vidhāyakam |
tathā hyavāntarakarmatvātkriyāṇāṃ pannaḥ kathamucyatvā''nujñeyatvāttvaiva saha saṃbadhyate |
tadartha- na prāgyajibhāvanātaḥ paryavasānam |
viśiṣṭavidhiyuttarakālaṃ māha- drāpyetayārthau kuletyeṣa śabdaḥ śaknoti vaditu- tu kiṃcidepyate |
tasmātsiddhamekaikāryatvādekavākyatvam |
miti |
kathamekenānekārthagatiriti cedatta āha-dṛṣṭā guṇavicitte cokkā vākyabhedāḥ |
'athocyeta' iti |
hi kaścidamapi gatiḥ |
yathā śoṇamānayeti |
pramāṇā- etacchabdasamarthanārtham |
siddhe'pi karmāntaratve karmayukta- ntaraprāpte'pyānayato rakto'kṣaḥ coyamāno na raktā- phalapakṣāntaramiti nirākriyate |
tatraiva vacanavyaktiḥ- śraśabdavyāmivābhihito vākyabhedaṃ janayati |
tathā revatīṣu vārantīyamagniṣṭomasāma kṛtvā, etasyā''nvena 'tra tvāśadopāttā nirvṛttiḥ pūrvakālatvaṃ ceti |
athavā |
yajeteti |
kimevaṃ bhaviṣyati ? prakaraṇaṃ tāvanna bādhiṣyate |
'tatraiva na vidhīyate viśeṣaṇaviśeṣaṇam |
yatra dravyā- etasyaiveti ca prakṛtagrāhi samīpasthitasaṃbandhamanugrahī- jñabhūtaṃ tanna karmāṅgaṃ pratīyate |
' tatraitanmayajñajñā- vyate |
tatrocyate |
na, paśukāmapadānarthakyaprasaṅgāt |
bhūtamatyeṣa guṇabhūtatvāt ' iti dravyaviśeṣaṇānāṃ vidhya- tatparityāge vākyabhedaprasaṅgaḥ |
na hyekasya kratuṃ phalaṃ ca saṃsarpo vakṣyate |
revatīvārantīyasaṃbandhaṃ karoteviśeṣa- prati yugapadvidhānamavakalpate |
'athaivaṃmucyeta revatīṣu kṛte- ṣaṇam |
sāmānyabhūtatvāt karotyarthastatrahito nānujñeyatvaṃ neti' |
prathamametasyaiva pakṣaṃ doṣāntarābhidhitsayā puna- pratipadyate |
tena mṛṣyāmahai haviṣā viśeṣaṇamitivyaji- rūpanyasyatīti kecit |
athavā naivam |
kathaṃ tarhi, bhāvanāviśeṣaṇasya karotyarthasya revatīvārantīya- guṇakāmeṣu yājñikānāṃ dvayī pratipattiḥ ? keṣāṃ- saṃbandhaviśiṣṭā''bhyupagamyate |
tathā ca kriyāviśeṣaṇānā- cinmīmāṃsakadeva guṇaphalam |
apareṣāṃ tu guṇaḥ |
mapi prajādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇāni dravyadevatādīni darśapūrṇa- kattvaṃ ca tadattastu kratoḥ phalāntarasaṃbandhaḥ |
atraiṣā māsādipayokṣyante |
tasmāt niṣyasaṃbandhaviśepitāyāṃ vacanavyaktiḥ |
nityaṃ tāvadanena brahmavarcasakāmo yajeta |
bhāvanāyāṃ ṛtvasāmayoniyamaḥ |
satyatvācchradātra yadi tu paśukāmaḥ : syāttato'nenaiva devividhiśiṣyeteti |
pratipsikramanirvṛttyartha eva dravyayo nānujñānanivṛttyarthaḥ |
tathā sati 'na' pratyayaḥ saṃnikṛṣṭārthavidhiṃ tāvatkari- agniṣṭomasāmnaḥ prāgyāgādaprayogatvāt |
ato naivaṃ citrā- ṣyati |
na cānyapara utpatti vidhānācca viśi- yate revatīṣu vārantīyaṃ prayujya yadyamīti |
kiṃ tarhi ? ṣṭā |
' yāgaṃ hi phale vidhadatyalpayo na viprakṛṣyate |
evaṃ kariṣyāmīti parikalpya yāgaḥ prakramitavya iti |
na cānyutpattiḥ san utpattimapi kalpayati |

revatyadhikaraṇam
anekārthavidhānaṃ ca yathaivottaravidhau karmavidhānanimittaṃ labhyate, tathā phalavidhāvapi phaladeśena karmavidhānādityevaṃ manyamāno vadati- 'atha revatīṣu kṛtena vāravantīyena paśukāmo yajeteti' |
stotrādareṇa yāgasādhanatvopapatteḥ karaṇatvīyavaivā |
athavā itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇa |
anenaiva itthaṃbhūtena paśukāmo yajeteti |
tatrottaram |
naivaṃ śakyam |
ṛgantarayagāṇādiśeṣahānādvaiguṇyamiti |
yadi tadevedaṃ karma tatastasya vāvyatvāstredhomesāma vihitaṃ tada- gantare revatyākhye gīyamānaṃ pūrvavihitavāvyatvāviśeṣa- hānādvaiguṇyaṃ bhavet |
nanvidānīmevā'''smīye pakṣe bhavatyaiva tatra revatīṣu ṛśvanyānipi sāmāni prāpnuvantyevaṃ pūrvatupe nāmihitam |
naiṣa doṣaḥ |
kṛteti nirvṛttaḥ saṃbandho- yāgāyocyate |
dvāvetāvarthau kṛtetyeṣa śabdaḥ śaknoti vaditumiti |
siddhāntādī tvapūrvakarbhavivo anekārtha- vidhānaṃ śakyaṃ nānyeti manyamāna āha-'sati vacane' matpakṣe śakyam, bhavatpakṣe tvasati vāravantīyagrahaṇamātreṇa labhyamānāsu revatīṣvaśakyamiti |
paraḥ punarāha-'vacanaṃ tarhi bhaviṣyati' |
tenaivābhiprāyeṇa |
phale viśiṣṭakarma- vidhānāt kṛtvāvādasya cāvidhāyakatvāt |
yajeranu- vādaḥ-iti ca satyapi phale prati vidhāna uttapyavidhānā- bhiprā yeṇa |
siddhāntavādī svābhipratānāṃrthavidhivyathā- nupapattiphalaṃ kathayati-'yadi vacanaṃ' siddhaṃ tarhi karmāttaraṃ na pūrvasthaivā'''miṣṭo guṇavidhānamiti |
'nanu tato yajeteti yāgānuvādāt' iti vacanenānirākṛtatvāt adyāpi svapakṣa- meva balīyāsaṃ manyate |
'naivaṃ śakyamiti' siddhāntā- vivaraṇam |
yadi hi revatīguṇakaṃ vāravantīyaṃ yāgaṃ prati guṇatvena vidhīyate, tato'sya sa uddeśyaḥ |
tataśca uddiśyamānatvādeva phalapadaṃ na tena guṇena vā saṃbadhyate ityanarthakameva syātsaṃbaṃdhamānaṃ vā vākyaṃ bhindyāt |
guṇaviśiṣṭakarmavidhāne vā agryabhiprāyamānatvādekāntena karmāttaratvam |
na ca yatpaśukāmo yajetetyāpratavādanu- vādaḥ saṃbhavati |
etena revatīvāravantīyavidhi pratyasya nimittatvaṃ prayuktam |
ataśca na vāravantīyaṃ kenacit balavattveṇa pramāṇena revatībhiḥ saṃbadhyate viśiṣṭahānā- dviguṇaṃ bhavet |
atha 'yāgasaṃbandho'nuvādaḥ' iti |
guṇādeva phale sati prakaraṇādavagataṃ yāgāttvamasmi- nvākye'nuvadiyate iti |
kaḥ punarāśrayāśrayitvā- tpūrvainigakṛtādasya viśeṣo yenopanasyate |
sa ucyate |
tatra hi 'ānarthakyāttadaṅgeṣu' ityetannirākṛtam |
aṅga- tvasthāne tu tatsaṃbandhavādidhomasāmasaṃbandhaḥ sulabha itya- bhiprāyaḥ |
tānnirākaroti - 'prakaraṇādi vākyaṃ balavattara- miti' |
āśrayāśrayisaṃbandho hi phalasaṃbandhanānuguṇatvā- tsaṃbhavatyanyataḥ |
sa tu na saṃbhavatītyuktam |
aṅgāṅgi- saṃbandhastu kṛtakathaṃbhāvagrahaṇātsyāt |
tacca nāsti |
'ase- yuktaṃ prakaraṇāt' iti vakṣyati |
saṃyuktaṃ cataphalena |

tatra darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe asya mantrasya pāṭhāt 'darśa-
pūrṇamāsasaṃbandhi kiṃcit anena prakāśyate' ityevagate 'kiṃ tat' ityapekṣāyāṃ 'lavanaṃ' iti mantraliṅgataḥ avagamyate |
ato mantraliṅgaprameyadarśapūrṇamāsasaṃbandhi- lavanatvavyāpakadarśapūrṇamāsasaṃbandhitvāvacchinnarūpita- mantranidhasaṃbandhabodhakapramāṇasāpekṣatvāt asya liṅgasya sāmānyasaṃbandhabodhakapramāṇasāpekṣatvam |
evaṃ pūvān- mantramantre yāgānumantraṇamiti samākhyāyā 'yāgasāmānyā- pūrvasaṃbandhi kiṃcit anena prakāśyate' itya- vagate 'kiṃ tat' iti apekṣāyāṃ 'pūṣā' iti mantraliṅgā- davagamyate |
ato liṅgaprameyapūniṣṭhāvijātīyayāgāpūrva- sādhanatva-rūpoddeśyatā'vacchedakavyāpakasāmānyāpūrva- sādhanatvāvacchinnarūpitamantranidha-saṃbandhabodhakapramāṇasā- māpekṣatvāt liṅgasya niruktapramāṇāsāpekṣatvam |
yatra tu uddeśyasvarūpe ānarthakyābhāvena apūrvasādhanatvā- dinoddeśyatvaṃ na prakaraṇādyapekṣā yathā arthajñānasya sāma- rthyāt karmānuṣṭhānāttve, tatra liṅgasya sāmānyasaṃbandha- bodhakapramāṇānapekṣatvam |
liṅgasya ca aśabdatvena avidhāyakatvāt vihitatva- ghaṭitaniruktāṅgatvasāmānyasaṃbandhena vidhāyakaśruti- kalpanā'ntaritaprāmāṇyasya anantaritaprāmāṇyaśrutidorba- lyam |
ata eva 'kadācana starīrasi' iti indraprakā- śikāyāḥ ṛcaḥ tāvat liṅgāt indraprakāśanā'rthatvaṃ kalpyate, tāvat 'ainyā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' iti śrutyā gārhapatyopāsthānā'rthatvaṃ ainyādhikaraṇe (3|2|12) nirū- pitam |

tāvat pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ tato daikṣasya paśoriṣ‌ṭena svābhā- vikākāṅkṣāvirahiṇaḥ prayājādidarśanena darśapūrṇamāsa- vidhvantākāṅkṣaiva kalpyate iti na vikṛtitvaṃ siddhaṃ kṛtvā tatprakṛtiviśeṣavicāro ghaṭate |
yadā tāvat svarūpa- mātramālakṣyate tadā nirākāṅkṣatvāt na prakṛti- viśeṣacintā |
yadā tu prayājādidarśanena vikṛtitvaṃ kalpyate tadā prakṛtiviśeṣasyaiva nirṇāyakatvāt cintā- vasaraḥ |
na ca 'paśau ca liṅgadarśanāt' ityatra paśoḥ apūrvvanirākaraṇeṇa pūrvvavatmeva liṅgadarśane sādhyate kimatra kutaściddharmā atidiśyante uta netyetāvadeva vicāryate iti vācyam, adyame viśeṣātideśacintā- kāraṇāt |
na cāsau samāptā yena darvihomavat pūrvvadapūrvva- cintā kriyeta tasmāt viśeṣātideśa eva cintyate |
tathā ca bhāṣyakāro viśeṣātideśavicārameva darśayati |
paśau kiṃ darśapūrṇamāso kriyante uta saumika iti |
siddhānte'pi liṅgasya prāpakatvamākṣipya codanāsāmānyā- dityāha sa ca sāmānyena vikṛtitve siddhe'vakalpate nānyathā |
athaitadoṣaparihārāya liṅgadarśanena tāvaditi- karttavyatāmātrākāṅkṣā kalpyate tataḥ codanāsāmānyādi- deśa iti tarhi prayājādiṣu abhikramaṇaprāyaścittopadeśa- sāmarthyāt ākāṅkṣāparikalpanāt anyatvena saumika- vidhvantaprasaṅga iti samānaḥ paryyanuyogaḥ |
tadetadāvāmyevaṃ parihartavyaṃ na prayājādināma- vyaktatvaṃ yasya hi taddhitena caturthyā mantravarṇana vā devatā nāsti tadyuktam |
prayājādīnāṃ tu mantravarṇādimirdevatā- saṃgateḥ nāvyakttvamiti |
yadi tu yasyotpattivākye devatā nāsti, tadarthakaṃ tat upāṃśuyājasyāpyavyaktatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
tasya hi tadartha devatāyāḥ syāditi vicārya 'viṣṇurvā syādautrāsānāt' iti mantravarṇāt devatāsaṃgati vakṣyati |
jyotiṣṭomasyāpi 'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti taddhitenaiva devatā'bhidhānāt nāvyakttvaṃ syāt |
na yāge devatā taddhitena vidhīyate kintu grahaṇe tasmādadoṣaḥ |
kiṃca asaṃbhavādi na prayājādiṣu saumikadharmātideśaḥ, darśa- pūrṇamāsayorhi sāṅggayoḥ pūrvvapuruṣābhyāyeṣuḥ samāpanaṃ śrutaṃ tatrāpi paritaragaṇādi hastāvenajenādi ca tantraṃ apareṣu revopakramya samāpanīyam |
tatra yadi prayājādiṣu saumikavidhvanto dīkṣaṇīyādiḥ audavasāniyāntaḥ pratyekaṃ atidiśyeta tataḥ tasmin pratyekamanuṣṭhīyamāne pradhānasya kālotkarṣaḥ syāt |
na ca tantreṇa prasaṅgena vā sakṛdanu- ṣṭhānasaṃbhavaḥ |
kālabhedāt tantramadhye vidhānābhāvācca pūrvvaṃ hi prayājāḥ pradhānādadvitīyante paścādanvājāḥ |
tato'pi sūkṣmākāṅkṣādyavahitāḥ patnīsaṃyājāḥ |
na caivaṃ sati tantraṃ bhavati dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu iva aiṣṭikavidhvantasya |
na ca yāvacchakti kānicidaṅgāni vihāya kānicidanutiṣṭheteti viśeṣāparijñānāt śakyate'bhidhātum |
tasmāt anati- deśaḥ prayājādiṣu saumikavidhvantasya, tasmāt asyaivā- vāntaraprakaraṇam |
kathaṃ tarhi videvanādīnāṃ abhiṣecanī- yāṅgatvaṃ neṣyate |
codakamātairaiva dharmairākāṅkṣāparipūrṇaṇe abhiṣecanīyasya prāgeva paryyavasānāt |
vikṛtayo hi klṛptopakārākāṅkṣāḥ prathamaṃ prākṛtaireva samīpasthaṃ vidhāya saṃbadhyante iti gṛhamedhīyādhikaraṇe bhāṣyakāro vakṣyati |
evaṃ niśārtaparyyavasānasyāpi vikārasya samīpasthāṅga- vaśādaparyevasānaṃ kalpyatathyaṃ tataśca kramo bhavati |
vikṛtiṣvapi yat prākṛtāṅgamathye paṭhitaṃ yathā āmanahoma- stasya prakaraṇe grahaṇam |
videvanādīnāmapi tarhi prākṛtāṅgamathye māhendrastotrakāle anuṣṭhīyamānā prāka- raṇena abhiṣecanīyasyaprasaṅgaḥ |
na tatraipāmupapattiḥ anyatra utpannānāṃ prakaraṇāvagatarājasūyāṅgānāmapakarṣaḥ |
stotrakāle vihita iti nāmiṣecanīyasyāṅgatvam |
rājasūya- bhāvanāyāstu pavitrādārabhya kṣatrasya śrutiparyyanto yāgagaṇaḥ svavākyasthena yajinā tantreṇopādāya karaṇatvena samarpita iti yatpavitreya prākṛtamaṅgaṃ yacca kṣatrasya dhruteḥ tatsarvaṃ rājasūyasya prākṛtamaṅgaṃ tanmadhyavarttīni videvanādīni bhavanti prakaraṇasya gocaraḥ |
tasmāt avāntaraprakaraṇā- bhyupagame'pi na kaściddoṣa iti |

katham |
' ākāṅkṣati pradhānaṃ hi na pradhānāntarānvayam |
aṅgāpūrvvasya yena syātpradhānāpūrvvasaṃgatiḥ ||
na kāryyamanvaya bhavati nyāyāt prayājāpūrvvaṃ svapradhānabhūtaṃ na prayojanāntaramapekṣate |
anapekṣaṃ ca saṃhitenāpi darśa- pūrṇamāsāpūrvvaṃ saṃgataṃ nāsti |
yattvatra kenaciducyate sādhikārapūrvvasaṃnidhisamāmnā- tāni prayājādivākyāni na drāvāpūrvvāntaramavagamyanti avaghātādivat anuvādātkathaṃ saṃbhavat |
kintu yāgasvarūpa- meva svakārakaviśiṣṭamupasthāpayanti |
tata ananyaniṣṭhaṃ mantraṃ cāprayojanībhūtaṃ prayojanarūpādhikāravidhyanvayayoga- mityādhikāra
vicāraḥ saṃbhavati |
satyapi sandehe paścāt virodhanarṇayaḥ |
pratipadyada samiyāge'pi bhavati |
yadi manyeta na sami- dādiṣu prathamaṃ sandehaḥ |
kiṃ tarhi saṃnidhānāt prakṛtāpūrva- mevedamiti bhrāntirbhavati tattatrāvirodhāt grāhakagrahaṇa- miti |
tathāpi pañcādirodhadarśanena tat vyāvartyate yathā pūrvapakṣanyāyena niścita pratipadaḥ prakaraṇagrahaṇe siddhānta- nyāyena śrutivirodhapratibhāse sati tadarthyaṃ vyāvarttate |
kiñca yadi niyogāntaramavaghātādivadapratipattaṃ tataḥ tadvākyagāmi- nāmavahantyādiśabdānāṃ iva prajñājādivākyagatānāmapi yajñādiśabdānāṃ pradhānāpūrvāntasvārthābhidhāyakatvaṃ kiṃ nāmyupagamyate |
eṣā hi tatra yuktiḥ |
yatheṣāṃ pradhānāpūrvā- nvitasvārthābhidhāyitvaṃ syāt |
tathā sati utpattyāvevyānya- tiriśrītatathā'vagatasya niyogāntaraviṣayatā na syāt |
kāryadvaye saṃbandhānupapatteḥ |
na hyekaṃ vastu yugapat kārya- dvayasaṃbandhi pratyetuṃ śakyamiti |
idaṃ ca pratīyate niyogān- tare svārthamabhidhātuṃ nāprīyate |
tena yadi niyogāntara- pratipattaṃ tato virodhābhāvāccājiśabdasya samidākyagatasya pradhānāpūrvānvitasvārthābhidhāyitvaṃ ahantyāditvaṃ syāt |
atha pratipattaṃ tataḥ śrutivirodhe grāhakagrahaṇamupa- pattiriti seyaṃ ubhayataḥ pāśā rajjumiti |
atha prathamapratipattaṃ apūrvāntare yatraivādhikārāpūrvānvita- svārthābhidhāyitvamapi paścāt niyogāntarāvagatyā bādhyate tato grāhakagrahaṇamapi śrutivirodhatvāt bādhi- tavyam |
tasmāt kathaṃcidapi prajājādināmatvaṃ saṃbha- vati |
yadapi ca na cāvihitamaṅgaṃ bhavatītyetadadṛta- vadanapratiṣedhaṃ adhikṛtya abhihitam |
āradādupakāraka- viṣayakānuvādābhidhāne tu jajñyamānamantravacanādhi- kārāt saṃnipātitavidhayamiti tattvācyamātrālocanenoktam |
anyathā kathaṃ tadutsarge karmāṇītyatrādupakārakamevā- bhipretya puruṣaprayatno'nuvāda iti vadatyeva bhāṣyakāra iti naivaṃ vyākhyātuṃ śakyate |
kathaṃ tarhi vyākhyeyaṃ vini- yogābhiprāyaṃ vidhyabhidhānitaracca prayogābhiprāyaṃ ityeva- metat vyākhyeyam |
na hyasati vidhau samidādīnāṃ aṅgatvaṃ sidhyati |
nanu prakaraṇenāntareṇāpi vidhiṃ śrutyeva sami- dādīnāṃ somādīnāmāvivādyajeta |
iti yajidhvastyatirekeṇa somasya vidhyabhāve'pi tṛtīyayā viniyuktasya pradhānavidhinaiva vidhānam |
evaṃ prajājādīnāmapi prakaraṇe darśapūrṇamāsayorviniyoge sati viśiṣṭapradhānavidhaureva viśeṣabhūtānāṃ prajājādīnāṃ vidhi- siddheḥ nārthaḥ pṛthagvidhānena iti cet |
satyaṃ viśiṣṭa- vidhiḥ viśeṣaṇamāskandati viśeṣaṇatvameva tu natai vidhānāt sidhyati |
sidhyati prakaraṇeneti cet |

vaktṛjñānānumānam |
saṃprati pauruṣeyavākyānāṃ vaktṛjñānānumānavyavadhānenaiva arthapratipādakatvaṃ iti prati- pādyate |
yutyupannaśabdaśravaṇamātrāt arthapratītiḥ kimiti
vaktṛjñānānumānam |
vacasā
jāyate iti cenna, dyutyupannaśabdoccāraṇe'pi vaktṛprabhiprāya- niśraye'rthābhidhānādarthāttātparyajñānamapi sāmagrītvena kalpyate |
tātparyajñānaṃ ca imamarthamavagamyaitatapratipādanāyedaṃ vākyamuccāritaṃ ityanusaṃdhānam |
ataśca pramāṇāntarānta- rbhāvaḥ |
nanu astu vākyamātradanabhidhānam, āptavākyasya doparahitasyārthāvabodhakatvaṃ kimiti nāśrīyate ? naivam, ādhyāyādidoṣarahitamevāptatvaṃ tathābhūtasyāpi anyapara- prayoge dṛśyate, yathā- 'viṣaṃ bhuṅkṣva' ityādau bhojana- nivṛttipare vākye |
ataḥ pramāṇāntareṇāvagate tātparya'rtha- niśrayaḥ |
tātparyaniścayāt arthaniścayaḥ, tātparyaniścayaśca vaktṛjñānānumānadvāreṇa bhavatīti āptavākyasyaiva liṅgatvamupapannam, viprabhakṣaṇavākye'pi yogyadhārthajñānapūrva- katvādyabhicārāt |
nanu kathaṃ jñānamanumīyate ? na tāvat jñānamātrā- numānam, jñānamātraviśeṣaniścayābhāvādeva anumānavaiyarthya syāt, na tāvat vidhijñānamānumānam, arthenaiva jñānasya viśeṣaḥ, ato'rthaniścayena viśiṣṭajñānānumānaṃ niścaye ca anumānavaiyarthyameveti vaktṛjñānānu- nam ? naivam, vākyaśravaṇe sati abhidhānāt prāgeva padārthaḥ smaryante, smṛtānāṃ ca padārthānāṃ evama- nvetaṃ yogyaṃ naivaṃ iti vimarśaḥ saṃjāyate, ato nyāya- saṃpāditena vimarśena viśiṣṭo'rtho buddhimatthaḥ, tenaiva viśiṣṭajñānānumānam |
nanu vimarśo nāma kīdṛśaḥ ? sa ca pramāṇapramāṇaṃ veti api na vidmaḥ |
ucyate- vimarśastāvat abhidhānāt prāgeva bhavadbhirabhyupakṛtaḥ, itarathā abhihitaiḥ padārthaiḥ viśiṣṭo'rtho jñātuṃ na śakyate, padārthānāmekārthasādhāraṇatvāt kasya viśiṣṭārthasya gamakā bhaveyuḥ ? ākāṅkṣāsaṃnidhiyogyatāyuktārthasya gamakā iti cet, tarhi sa eva vimarśaśabdārtho yuṣmābhirabhya- jīkṛtaḥ |
sa ca pramāṇetikartavyatārūpaḥ na pramāṇamātram, na ca smṛtimātraṃ vā, vimarśānaṅgīkāre ca pratyakṣikaraṇaṃ pūrvapakṣasiddhāntavacanayaktivimarśo na syāt |
kecittu visaṃvādaśaṅkayā tirohitatvādardhaniścayo na jāyate |
'puṃvākye tu visaṃvādaśaṅkayā sā tirohitā' mī. ko. 425.

'varṣāsu rathakāra ādadhīta' iti kiṃ atrayaprasiddhā traivarṇike nāmyatamo rathakāraśabdeno- cyate samudāyaprasiddhā vā anyo jātiśabdaḥ iti sandehe avayavaprasiddhyā rathakāriṇi traivarṇike rathakāraśabdasaṃbha- vāt apaśūdrādhikaraṇa-(6|1|126) pratiṣiddhasya anairva- rṇikasyādhikāro na yuktaḥ |
iti prāpte, samudāya- prasiddhā avayavaprasiddhibādhāt vacanabalena anairvarṇi- kasyaivādhikāraḥ iti vakṣyate |
tatra samudāyaprasiddheḥ avayavaprasiddhito balīyastvaṃ dyutpāditam |
anyata eva tu samudāyaprasiddhivalīyastva- siddhau nyāyena pratiṣiddhasyāpi anairvarṇikasyaiva vacana- balena adhikāraniścayāt sandehābhāvena rathakārādhikaraṇā- rambho na yujyate |

satyamatra vākyadvaye'pi tvaduktarītyaiva viśiṣṭasādana- vidhānam, tasya ca tvaduktarītyaiva prākṛtakāryatvaṃ prākṛtatvameva vā tathāpi prakṛtau tadāsādanasya tadvṛtti- yāgasiddhayarthatvāt tasya vihārāntare karaṇe aprākṛtakārya- tvāpattestatparyagatyā asya yāgaprayogavidhitvameva |
āsādanatviśca nirvapattitvat tattayāgopalakṣaṇam |
evaṃ ca navānāmāpi vihāradvayavikalpo'nyantaravaiyarthya ca nāśritaṃ bhavati, anyavyavasthā prātānāṃ vyavasthāmātrakaṇāt lāghavaṃ ca |
'aṣṭau havīṣi', 'māstīm' iti na śakyārtha- karmabhūtānuvādaḥ san tattyāgagatakṣaṇātātparyagrāhakaḥ |
ataśca 'āsādayati' ityatra dvitīyāśravaṇābhāvāt 'sāyaṃ juhoti' itivat tattyāgakaraṇakasājbhāvanā- prayogasyaiva deśādiviśiṣṭasya vidheyatvāttvaiyarthyāccā- vṛttiḥ |
aṅgapradhānayorvaiderapyā'pi cātra sāṅgaprayoga- vidhivyarvabhāvaḥ |
varuṇapraghāseṣu |
varuṇapraghāseṣu
na caivamapi sakṛtkṛtavairājñeyakārasya siddhestenaiva prasaṅgāt yāgāntarasyopakāropapatterāvṛttau pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
upakāralābhe ca tadarthamajñānākṣepāt vihitadeśāve'pi prasaṅgasya vakṣyamāṇatvāditi vācyam, tantramadhyapāṭhāt- bhāvena kasya tantritvaṃ kutra prasaṅga ityatra niyāmakabhāvena prasaṅgāpatteḥ |
na ca 'bahūnāṃ syātstadharmatvam' iti nyāyenānekeṣu deśāvadha eva aśānāṃ tantritvatātparyagrāhaka iti vācyam |
tathātve'pi yatra sāmyaṃ yathā sarvatomukhādau caturdikṣu caturṣu vihāreṣu caturvihāravyadhyādibhiḥ kriyamāṇe tatra vinigamanāvireheṇa tantritvanimābhāve prasaṅgāsaṃbha- vena deśakartrādibhedenāṅgāvṛtterāvaśyakatvāt |
prakṛte tu yadyapi bahunurodhena mārutyāṃ prasaṅgaḥ prāpnoti |
tathāpi 'yadevādhvaryuḥ karoti tadeva prati- prasthātā karoti' iti vacanena prasaṅgābhāvapratīterdeśa- kartṛviśiṣṭamārutīprayogavidheḥ mārutīprakṣepādyaṅgamāne saṃko- cāccenāṅgāvṛttiriti dhyeyam |
maṇḍana-- 'vihārayostantrabhedaḥ |
' (bheda eva na tantram) |
śaṃkara-- 'vihārayoḥ ajñāvṛttiḥ |
varuṇapraghāseṣu dakṣiṇavihāre pratiprasthātrā mantrāḥ adhvaryoḥ pṛthagguṇāḥ ||
mantrāśca, saṃnipātvāt |
bhāṣyam-- varuṇapraghāseṣu vihāradvayatve sati ye mantrāḥ saṃnipātaḥ, yathā ājyagrahaṇe prokṣaṇe'mi- marśāne ! teṣāṃ kiṃ tantreṇa prayogaḥ, athavā medena iti |
tantratvāpacinteyam, na prasaṅgacintā |
tatra prayogavacanā- nugrahāya tantrabhāve prāpte, ucyate |
mantrāśca ājya- grahaṇadayo bhedena kartavyāḥ |
kutaḥ ? saṃnipātvāt |
saṃnipalopakāriṇa ete mantrā upasthite karmābhidadhati |
pṛthakkarmaṇi adhvaryupratiprasthātārī upatiṣṭhete |
tasmāt pṛthak prayoktavyāḥ |
api ca karaṇānāṃ mantrāntena karmā- disaṃpātaṃ vakṣyati, 'mantrāṇāṃ karaṇārthatvāntrāntena karmā- disaṃnipātaḥ syātsarvasya vacanāt' iti |
tathā sati
yena karmaṇā saṃnipatito mantrastadasau iti gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ |
tasmādapyāvṛttiḥ |
śā-- varuṇapraghāseṣu dakṣiṇottaravihārayoḥ nirvāpā- dimantrāḥ kiṃ tantreṇa adhvaryuṇā pratiprasthātrā vā anya- tareṇa vaktavyāḥ, uta ubhābhyāmpi bhedena iti saṃśaye anyatareṇāpi uccyamānāḥ śaknuvanti ubhayoḥ smṛtiṃ kartuṃ iti manyate |
nirvāpamītyādeḥ ātmābhivāditvāt na tantratā saṃbhavati, iti ubhayoḥ pṛthakpṛthak prayogaḥ |
sakṛdasakṛdanuṣṭhānaprasaṅgāt tantrāvāpacintā'pi iyaṃ atra kṛtā |
soma-- pūrvavadiha na kāryasiddhiḥ ityutthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- nirvāpaṇādimantrāḥ bhedena prayogavyāḥ, teṣāṃ karaṇamantratayā karmādisaṃnipātvāt, ubhayośca katroḥ prayogaśaicyātsaṃbhavena ekena prayuktesya itarakartṛkarmadisaṃnipātāsaṃbhavāt iti |
ci-- 'vihārabhede nirvāpamantradeśatantratā na vā |
tantraṃ dvayoḥ smṛteḥ siddhe, ruktamoktavyā pṛthak bhavet ||
' bhāṭṭa-- varuṇapraghāseṣu dakṣiṇottaravihārayordeśabhedāt kartṛbhedācca padārthānāṃ na tantratā iti sthitam |
tatra ca prayājādiviṣaye bhūyo'nugrahasya nyāyyatvāt mārutyāṃ nyāyaprāptaḥ prasaṅgaḥ 'yadevādhvaryuḥ karoti, tat pratiprasthātā karoti' iti vacanena bādhyate ityataste tāvat pṛthageva kartavyāḥ |
mantrāśca ye arthasamānārthāḥ te adhvaryuṇā tāvat paṭhanīyāḥ |
tataśca tena manyante padārthaṃ kṛte paścāt pratiprasthātrā svapadārtha kriyamāṇe adhvaryu-pratiprasthātṛkapadārthayoḥ kramavidhānāt prati- prasthātṛkartṛkapadārthasya adhvaryukartṛkapadārthena upasthite- siddhemantrakāryasya prasaṅgasiddhayā na mantrāṇāṃ pratiprasthātrā pṛthakpāṭhaḥ |
iti prāpte, nirvāpamītyādimantreṣu ātmā- bhivāditayā ātmakartṛkanirvāpasmṛteraiva kāryopayogitayā tādṛśyānyataḥ alābhāt na prasaṅgaḥ |
vastutastu 'yadevādhvaryuḥ karoti' ityanena na kramavidhaḥ, prasaṅga- bhāvamātraphalakatayā padārthakaraṇamātrāvidhānāt, kartṛbhedena pāṭhakramasyāpi aniyāmaphatvācca |
ato yugapadeva dvābhyāṃ samantrakāḥ padārthāḥ kartavyāḥ iti prasaṅgavakāśaḥ |
maṇḍana-- 'pāṭhaḥ pṛthak syāt khalu saṃnipāti- nām |
' śaṃkara-- 'vihārayorna mantraikyam |
' 10. varuṇapraghāseṣu 'dvayoḥ praṇayanti' iti punarvihita- madhipraṇayanaṃ apūrvam |
na prākṛtaṃ nāpi saumikaṃ paraṃtu atideśaprāptaṃ prākṛtaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ apūrve vihitaṃ adhi- praṇayanaṃ kartavyam |
vi. 7|3|9 varṇakaṃ 2 (vārtika- matam), varuṇapraghāseṣu 'dvayoḥ praṇayanti' iti punarvihitamadhipraṇayanaṃ na tu vaiśvadevaśanāsīrayoḥ |
punarvidhānaṃ ca uttaravedyāṃ agnidhānaguṇavidhānārtham |
7|3|9, varuṇapraghāseṣu nava havīṃṣi vihitāni |

itarāṇyatha ca adhvaryuttare vihāre anutiṣṭhati |

ekābhitvātpareṣu tantraṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- idamaparaṃ tatraiva cintyate |
kiṃ āparā- mikā homāstantraṃ kāryāḥ uta medeneti |
kiṃ prāptam ? tantramiti |
kutaḥ ? ekābhitvāt |
paurvāmikānāmadhi- bhedāt bheda uktaḥ |
iha sa heturnāsti |
ekābhitvādete- pām |
tasmādete tantraṃ bhaveyuḥ |
nānā vā kartṛbhedāt |
bhāṣyam-- nānā bhaveyuḥ |
kutaḥ ? kartṛbhedāt |
mārutyā yānyajñāni tāni pratiprasthātrā kāryāṇi |
itarāṇi adhvaryuṇā |
tantrabhāve'nyatareṣāṃ kartṛkṛtaṃ vaiguṇyaṃ syāt |
tasmāt bhedaḥ |
śā-- ye punaḥ āparāmikā homāḥ patnīsaṃyājādayaḥ teṣu tantraṃ āvāpo vā iti saṃdehe paurvāmikavat deśa- medābhāvāt tantratvaṃ syāt |
asatyapi deśabhede kartṛbhedāt bhedaḥ, pratiprasthātṛkartṛkā hi mārutyā upakurvanti adhvaryu- kartṛkāstvapareṣāṃ tasmādbhedaḥ |
vi-- 'tatraiva patnīsaṃyājādau tantraṃ bhinna'thavā |
tantramagnyaikyato, maivaṃ kartṛbhedānnivāraṇāt ||
varuṇapraghāseṣu |
bhāṭṭa- tatraivāprāmikā: patnīsaṃyājādyo deśā- medāttantram|
iti prāpte, deśabhedavatkartṛbhedasyāpi prayoga- bhedaprayojakatvāt tadanurodhena tatrāpyavṛtti:|
na ca deśa- medādevāṅgāvṛttau siddhāyāṃ tatra kartṛntarāpekṣaṇe pratiprasthātṛ- mātravidhānānna kartṛbhedasya svātantryeṇa prayogabhedakṣepa- katvamiti vācyam, vaiparītyasyāpi vaktuṃ śakyatvena vinigamanāviraheṇobhābhyāmpi kartṛdeśābhyāṃ svaviśiṣṭa- prayogavidhibalena prayogabhedakṣepopapatte:|
ataśca patnī- saṃyājādiṣu deśabhedāve'pi kartṛmedāvṛtti:|
vastutastu deśakartṛviśiṣṭaprayogavidhāne'pi pārśvika- parasparānvayatvena tattaddeśīyatattatkartṛpadānāmeva prayoga- vidhyāpatterhautrādikartṛkapadārthānāṃ tattaddeśaprāptimātra ata- deśīyatānāmapyaprāptikānāṃ pratiprasthātṛkartṛkatvānāpatte- nānena patnīsaṃyājādiṣu pratiprasthātṛkartṛkatvam|
na hi mārutīyāge pratiprasthātṛkartṛkatvam, yenā'trapradhānaporaka- kartṛkatvāt patnīsaṃyājādyapi tattatprāptisādhakamavet|
māstī- yāgasya yajamānakartṛkatvena pratiprasthātṛkartṛkatvābhāvāt|

ataścāprāmikānāmprāvṛtti:|

karaṇamantraprakārye phalaṃ yāja- mānam|
ṛtvikaphalaṃ karaṇe'tharvattvāt|
bhāṣyam- darśapūrṇamāsayorāmantrita 'mamāye varco vihaveṣvistviti pūrvamantraṃ parigṛhṇāti' iti tatra saṃdeha:, kiṃ ṛtvikaphalāsāśitavyam, agre varco vihaveṣva- sti, uta yajamānasyeti|
kiṃ prāptam? adhvaryo- reveti|
kuta:? evaṃ śrutirāhatā bhaviṣyati, itarathā lakṣaṇā syāt, ātmanā yajamānaṃ lakṣyeta|
tasmādahiva- kaphalamāśāsitavyamiti|
ko'rtha:? anayā samidhā dhārmamāṇe'gnī yāga: saṃbhaviṣyati, tatra vihaveṣu spardhā- sthāneṣu, ahaṃ varcasvī bhaviṣyāmītyavarcovacanam|
eva- mutsāhī bhaviṣyatīti|
vā--yathaiva akaraṇeṣu yat phalaṃ tat prakaraṇasthaṃ kīryate nānyakalpyate, tathā 'mamāye varco vihaveṣvastu' ityādiṣvapi|
te tu yajamānaineva prayujyante, tasyaiva phalamitiviruddhā:|
karaṇā: punarekāntena karmasamānakartṛ- katvādādhvaryuṇā|
tairyadi adhvaryuṇā prayujyamānai: yaja- mānasya phalamabhidhīyeta, tato mametyabhidhānaṃ nirudhyeta|
kīdṛśaṃ tvavyayo: phalamanūyate iti, tadvātrābhavitavyamātreṇa sucaritavṛttavyaya:|
tacca tasyotsāhaṃ kariṣyatīti nirū- payati|
svāmino vā tadarthatvāt|
bhāṣyam-- yajamānasya vā vacanam, tadarthatvāt karmaṇa:|
yajamānārthaṃ hīdaṃ karma sāṅgama, upagrahaviśeṣāt|
sāṅgatvasya prayojanaṃ yajamānasya phalaniṣcittirdharyo: sucariturapi yathā|
kimatau yathaivam, phalakīrtanāt aphalakartavyatā gamyate|
tadetat amyanvādhānaṃ yaja- mānasya phalasaṃkīrtane kriyamāṇe anena mantreṇa phalasaṃbha- ndhāt prakāśitaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati, nādhvaryuśa:--kīrtanena|
tasmādyajamānaphalamāśāsitavyamiti|
atha kasmānna yājamāna eṣa mantro bhavatīti? ucyate|
anvanvādhānaṃ samāptyā ādhvaryavam|
tattaccaiguṇe mantra: karotyādhva- ryava:|
sa ucyate'nena manneti|
tasmādādhvaryavo mantra:|
'mama varco'stu' ityapi, yajamānasya vaco mameti vyapadiśati lakṣaṇayā|
yathā rājani jaye vartamānaṃ sainika asmākamiti vyapadiśatyevam|
vā--naivedamanakaraṇavat ('āyurdā agne' 'agniṃ suva: suvaragama' ityādayo ye, itikaraṇādyaviniyuktā: mantrāstadvat) utsāhātheṃ phalaṃ saṃkīryate|
kiṃ tarhi? mantravarṇāt nityāśāśrayaṃ phalamavakalpate|
katham? vyati- riktakriyāsādhanatvena hi mantraśraudita: tāṃ vā tatsaṃbandhi vā kiṃcitkrayāyajñabhāvaṃ gacchati|

vaṣaṭkāraśca bhakṣaṇanimittam |
katham ? evaṃ hi śrūyate ‘vaṣaṭkartuḥ prathamabhakṣaḥ’ iti |
atra prātabhakṣaṇādeva prāthamyamātraṃ vidhīyate, athavā vaṣaṭkāranimittakaṃ prāthamyaviśiṣṭaṃ bhakṣaṇāntaramiti |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo'bhisaṃdhiḥ |
sarvatra viśiṣṭavidhaugaura- bhayenopadasaṃkrānto vidhirlārthasya vilambīmapi yathā- kathañcittyātimepekṣate |
asti ca hotṛvaṣaṭkartṛtvāt ‘praitu hotṛcamasaḥ’ iti samākhyayā svacamase bhakṣaṇaprāptiḥ |
atastatraiva samākhyāprāptabhakṣaṇānuvādena vaṣaṭkāranimittakaṃ prāthamyamātraṃ vidhīyate |
tena vaṣaṭkartṛniyamitaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ kartavyamiti |
evaṃ prāpte, abhīdhīyate |
bhavedevaṃ yatra samākhyāniṣkṛṣya ca bhakṣaṇamanuvadituṃ śakyate |
tathāhi, na tāvadatra bhakṣaṇamātrānuvādena prāthamyaṃ vidhīyate, anya- thāpi prasaṅgāt |
kiṃ tarhi ? vaṣaṭkartur bhakṣa iti vaṣaṭ- kartṛsaṃvandhibhakṣaṇānuvādena |
tathā sati vaṣaṭkartṛsaṃvandha-
sāpekṣasya bhakṣaṇasya prāthamyena saha na samāsaḥ saṃbhavati, asamarthatvāt |
atha prāthamyena bhakṣaṇasya prādhānyācca ‘bhavati vai pradhānasya sāpekṣasya samāsaḥ’ ityanuśāsanāt vaṣaṭkartṛsaṃvandhasāpekṣamimaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ prathamapadena samastye ityucyate, tathāpi prāthamyaṃ tāvat bhakṣaṇaguṇabhūtam, tadapi vaṣaṭkāranimittakatvāt vaṣaṭkartṛbhakṣaṇasya prāthamyaṃ na nimittāntareṇa |
kiṃ tarhi ? vaṣaṭkāreṇaiva |
tena vaṣaṭ- karturiti saṃbandhāt guṇabhūtasyāpi prāthamyasya sāpekṣatvāt spaṣṭa eva samāsadoṣa iti |
bhakṣaṇaprāthamyayoḥ niṣkṛṣyā- nuvadituṃ vā'śakyatvāt vaṣaṭkartṛḥ prāthamya- viśiṣṭamapūrvameva bhakṣaṇaṃ vidhīyate iti |
nanu ‘ekaṃ sāma tuce kriyate stotrīyam’ iti samāsāpekṣaṃ samāsasyāpi ṛcamantra trividhānaṃ dṛṣṭam, tathā prāthamyavidhānaṃ bhaviṣyati |
naitat |
tatrāpi samāsāsyaiva vidhānatvāt, kintu ṛcāṃ sāmānyabhicāreṇaiva prāptatvāt trivasya cāprāptatvāt trivalpo vidhirityucyate |
iha tu yāvada- vaṣaṭkāraṃ bhakṣaṇaprāthamyasamāsārtha eva vivakṣitā- tparyānakṣameva viśiṣṭaṃ vidhīyate |

[2] dravyayo- vikalpaḥ kartavyo yathā- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ abhīṣomīye- kādaśadvādaśakapālayoḥ āgneyādenāmnātyorvikalpyaḥ śāstrā- ntarādhikaraṇe (2|4|18-33) uktaḥ |
yaugikānāṃ hi dravyavācitā uktā 'sarvaṃ yaugikaiḥ śabdairarthameva mīyate' (vā. pṛ. 677) iti |
[3] guṇayo- vikalpaḥ kartavyo yathā- 'kṛṣṇāsāraḥ abhīṣomīyaḥ' ; 'lohitasāraḥ abhīṣomīyaḥ' iti |
[4] kriyayo- vikalpaḥ kartavyo yathā- jyotiṣṭome vahiṣpavamānaṃ prasarpatāṃ anyonyacchandvāraṇe 'yadi prastotā'pacchindāt brahmaṇe varaṃ dadyāt, yadi pratihartā sarvavedasaṃ dadyāt, yajuddātā adakṣiṇo yajñaḥ parisamāpya tena punaryajeta yat pūrvasmin dāsyan syāt tad dadyāt' iti viśiṣṭa- dānādinaimittikavidhīnāṃ yugapacchede vikalpaḥ iti panne (6|5|17-20) uktam |
[5, 6] jātidravyabhāvayoḥ dravyatadabhāvayośca vikalpayoḥ kartavyayoḥ udāharaṇe yathā- vājasaneyinām 'ṛtu-nakṣatra-saṃbhāra- cātuḥprādya-jāgaraṇa- idhma-pūrvādhrdhānvārambhaṇa-sārparājñīne vā kuryāt' ityādhāne śrutam |
tadiha nakṣatraśabdena kṛttikāyukteḥ jātidravyabhāvayorvikalpaḥ |
saṃbhāra-cātuḥ- prādyaśabdebhyaśca yaugikatvena dravyavācitvāt dravya- tadabhāvayorvikalpaḥ |
kiṃtu vidhiniṣedhatvāt nyāyata eva iti vādyanto'nuvādaḥ |
[7] guṇatadabhāvayo- vikalpaḥ kartavyo yathā- dāśikavedikāne vājasaneyinā- meva vediparimāṇaviśeṣatadabhāvayoḥ, 'dhyāmamātrā paścāt syādityāhuḥ' iti 'nātra mātrā'sti' iti ca śatapathāt |
[8] kriyātadabhāvayorvikalpaḥ kartavyo yathā- 'atirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' ; 'nāti- rātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti |
tadevamevidho nyāyagamyo vikalpaḥ |
so'yaṃ nyāya- gamyo vikalpaḥ kartavyapuruṣārthabhedena dvividhaḥ |
tatra aṣṭavidho'pi kartavyaḥ udāhṛtaḥ |
eva sa ca aṣṭa- vidha eva jātidravyayoḥ, jātiguṇayoḥ, jātikriyayoḥ, dravyaguṇayoḥ, dravyakriyayoḥ, guṇakriyayoḥ iti dik- viṣayāḥ ṣaṭ |
tathā jātidravyaguṇānāṃ jātidravya- kriyāṇāṃ jātiguṇānāṃ dravyaguṇānāṃ ceti trika- viṣayatvāt medāḥ, tathā catuṣṭayaviṣaya ekaḥ |
itye- kādaśabhedāḥ na saṃbhravanti aikārthyābhāvāt |
puruṣā- rthasya tu ete'pi ekādaśa saṃbhavanti |
pūrvoktāśādau iti ekonaviṃśatividho'sau |
[1] tatra nyāyagamyaḥ puruṣārthavikalpo yathā- 'vānaspatyena brahmavarcasakāmasya praṇayet' iti vājasaneyināmuktam |
'kāṃsyena brahmavarcasakāmasya praṇayet' iti tu caturthe udāhṛtam (4|3|14 mādhye) |
atra hi jātireva phalārthaṃ vidhīyate |
yathā hi 'audumbare yūpo bhavati' ityatra atideśena 'yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati' ityatra 'juhvā juhoti' ityanena dravyaprāpteḥ jātimātraṃ ṛtavarthatvena vidhīyate, tathā kāṃsyavānaspatyayorapyapi 'vamasenāpaḥ praṇayet' ityanena ākāraviśiṣṭadravyaprāpteḥ jātireva phale vidhīyate |
ata eva vānaspatyakāṃsya- maye camasākāre eva pātre kartavye |
taduktaṃ tantraratne caturthe 'naimittike vikāratvāt' ityadhikaraṇe (4|3| 214) |
'nanu praṇayane viśeṣata eva camaso vihitaḥ |
satyam |
na tu kāṃsyavidhinā virudhyate |
ākāravāci hi camasaśabdaḥ, na prakṛtiviśeṣopamekṣate |
śakyate hi kāṃsyenāpi tadākṛtikaṃ pātraṃ saṃpādayitum, sāmānyavihitaṃ homārdhe vāraṇameva tena virudhyate' iti granthena |
tasmāt jātyorevātra ekasmin phale vihitayoḥ : nyāyagamyo vikalpaḥ iti |
[2] nyāyagamyaḥ puruṣārthadravyavikalpo yathā- 'godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet' itivat yaugi- kena śabdena dravyāntarasya paśuphalārthatvena vihitasya vikalpo bhavati |
[3] nyāyagamyaḥ puruṣārthaguṇavikalpo yathā- 'yadi kāmayīta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāt nīcaiḥ sado minuyāt' iti dṛṣṭārthyavihitanaimittikānāṃ guṇena saha dṛṣṭārthyavihitaguṇānāṃ parasparasya vikalpaḥ iti |
[4] nyāyagamyaḥ puruṣārthakriyāvikalpo yathā- ekārthānāṃ kāmyaidīnām |
[5-7] nyāyagamyasya puruṣārthajāti- tadabhāvayoḥ, dravyatadabhāvayoḥ, guṇatadabhāvayorvikalpasya udāharaṇāṇi mṛgyāṇi |
[8] puruṣāthau hi jātidravyaguṇāḥ guṇaphalasaṃbandhaveveva saṃbhavanti, teṣāṃ ca vikalpasiddhayarthaṃ niṣedhāḥ yadyapi abhāgāpratiṣedheṣu (1|2|15) vārtika- kṛtā vaiyarthyātpratiṣedhāḥ, tathāpi yatra tadviṣayāḥ guṇaphala- saṃbandhavidhayaḥ sāmānyataḥ pravṛttāḥ, sāmānya eva ca tanniṣedhāḥ, 'abhicāramahīnaṃ ca kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret' iti kāmyāniṣedhavata tatra puruṣārthasyāpi jātidravyasya vikalpaḥ saṃbhavati |
vārtikakṛttu vaiyarthyaṃ niṣaṃdhasya anuṣṭhānamāphalakatvāt |
tasya tu doṣārthatvāt vastuto na vaiyarthyam |
niṣedhābhāvaṃ hi kāmyasya kāmanā- mī. ko. 440
yāmati satyāṃ aicchikānanuṣṭhānasiddhāvapi kāmyānuṣṭhāne doṣo na sidhyate iti tadanuṣṭhāne doṣabodhanena arthavān niṣedhaḥ, yathā 'abhicāramahīnaṃ ca kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret' iti kāmyānāmahīnānāṃ niṣedhaḥ |
tādṛśāni tu puruṣārthajyāditrayaviṣayāṇi udāharaṇāni anveṣyāṇi |
[8] nyāyagamyaḥ puruṣārthakriyātadabhāvayostu vikalpo yathā- ahīnavikalpa evoktaḥ |
udāharaṇāntaramapi yathā- piṇḍapitṛyajñe 'jīvapitṛkasya homāntaṃ jīvapitṛnārambho vā' iti piṇḍapitṛyajñe vihito niṣedhaśca |
tatra puru- ṣārthakriyātadabhāvayorvikalpo nyāyagamyaḥ |
na cātra vāca- niko vikalpo vāśabdāt iti bhramitavyam, vihitaprati- ṣiddhasya nyāyadeva vikalpo bhavati ṣoḍaśigrahaṇāgrahaṇayo- riva iti vāśabdyasya anuvādtvāditi |
evaṃ jātidravyādīnāṃ ekādaśa ye vikalpabhedāḥ teṣā- mapi udāharaṇāni anveṣyāṇi |
evaṃ nyāyagamyaḥ eko- naviṃśatividho vikalpo nirūpitaḥ |
evameva vācanika- syāpi vikalpasya ekonaviṃśatibhedā jñeyāḥ |
tatra tu ṛtvarthajātivikalpe vācanike udāharaṇaṃ mṛgyam |
ṛtvarthadravyavikalpasya vācaniko yathā- 'ya iṣṭyā paśunā somena vā yajeta somāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇa- māsyāṃ vā' iti |
na cātra nyāyagamyaḥ 'homāntaṃ jīva- pitṛnārambho vā' itivat vāśabdyastu anuvādaḥ iti vācyam |
tatra hi ekavākyopādānāt samuccayā- saṃbhavācca nyāyādikalpaḥ |
iha tu iṣṭipaśusomānāṃ uddeśyānāṃ bhedāt ekavākyānarthakyasaṃbhave'pi iṣṭyuddeśena kāladvayavidhaiva paśūddeśena somoddeśena ca kāladvaya- vidheḥ prayogavicchittena 'dvādaśāhrena prajākāmaṃ yājayet' ityanekarūpaphalānanyavidhivat anutpattividhitve api anekaguṇavidhinimittakavākyabhedābhāvāt ekavākyo- pādānena samuccayaprasaktau vāśabdena vācanika eva vikalpaḥ |
ata eva vāśabdepādānābhāve dṛṣṭārthayopi guṇayoḥ ekavākyopādānāt samuccaya atroktavaiśāradī- karaṇe vārtikakṛtā (pṛ. 392) 'yadi caikaṃ vākyaṃ bhavet tataḥ sarvavidhihekabhāvanāvidhānāt na vikalpaḥ syāt' iti |
prayogavidhitvācca vākyabhedaparihārasaṃbhave tadarthaṃ
paurṇamāsyamātrāsyāpādābhyāṃ parva lakṣyate, tataśca aicchiko vikalpaḥ 'paśunā yajeta' ityatra 'ayaṃ vā paśurya vā paśuḥ' itivat ityabhidhānaṃ mūrkhasya upeyam |
vāca- nikaḥ ṛtvarthaguṇavikalpo yathā- 'guggulu aguggulu muṣṭī- luṃnāti' iti |
ihāpi na nyāyāt vikalpasiddhiḥ, yujāṃ cātujāṃ ca muṣṭīnāṃ ekavākyopādānena samuccayaprasaktau vāśabdena vācanikatvādeva vikalpaḥ |
atra hi 'barhirlunāti' iti vihite'pi lavane kālādiprayoga- vidhicihnābhāve'pi ca yugayukpadalakṣitobhayaviśiṣṭa- vikalpavidhānāt vākyabhedaḥ yathā 'rathaṃtaraṃ vā' ityatra vakṣyate |
vācanikaḥ ṛtvarthakriyayoḥ vikalpo yathā- 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' 'bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' iti vākyadvayavihitapṛṣṭhastutyoḥ vikalpamāpannaṃ rathaṃtaraṃ vā pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati, bṛhadvā pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati iti vāśabdalakṣitai- kavikalpavidhiḥ |
nanu pṛṣṭhadvayameva vākyabhedaḥ syāt |
na |
naktaṃ vivakṣitam, na dvitvam, kiṃtu pṛṣṭhamātramuddiśya vikalpavidhī vidheyavikalpasāmyādeva pṛṣṭhadravyalābhāditi ṛtvarthayostu jātitadabhāvayoḥ dravyatadabhāvayoḥ guṇatadabhā- vayoḥ kriśatadabhāvayośca ye vācanikā vikalpaḥ, tadudāha- raṇānāṃ evaṃvidho viṣayaḥ- yatra vikṛtī ātideśika- jātyādicatuṣṭayasya niṣedhā vāśabdyuktaḥ śrutāḥ, prākṛta- jātyādyeva vā vāśabdyuktaṃ śrutam, tatrāsau caturvidho'pi vikalpaḥ saṃbhavataḥ |
na ca tatra nyāyādikalpasiddhiḥ, nāthyādarthavidhabhāve hi aupadeśikena niṣedhena 'na tau dadhau karoti' itivat prākṛtasya jātyādervādha eva syāt, ato nyāyādisidhyan vācaniko vikalpa iti |
tādṛśāni nodāharaṇāni mṛgyāṇi |
evaṃ jāti- dravyādīnāṃ ekādaśa ye vikalpāḥ teṣāmapi vācanikānāṃ udāharaṇāni anveṣyāṇi |
yathā 'payasā pāyasena vā śrāddhaṃ kurvīta' ityādīni |
puruṣārthajātyoḥ, puruṣārtha- dravyayoḥ, puruṣārthaguṇayoḥ, puruṣārthakriyayorvikalpe udāhara- ṇāni |
tatra puruṣārthajātivikalpe vācaniko yathā- 'tilairvrīhiyavairmāṣairdravyairmūlaphalena vā |
dattena māsaṃ prīyante vidhivat pitaro nṛṇām' iti |
puṣyārthadravyavikalpo vācaniko yathā- manuḥ- 'kusuladhānyako vā syāt
kumbhīdhānyaka eva vā |
hyaihiko vā'pi bhavedathasta- nika eva vā |

tathā ahīne anekayajamānake yena kenacidyajamānena śukrapātrārambhaḥ, audumbarīsamānaṃ ca kāryaṃ iti dvādaśe uktaṃ (12|1|12|13) |

ghaṣṭhe (6|1|16-7) nityakarmaṇi aśakyā- jyāgasya sthāpitatvāt |
evaṃ ekādaśa ye vikalpabhedāḥ teṣā- mapi puruṣārthaviṣayāṇāṃ vācanikānāṃ udāharaṇāni anve- ṣyāṇi, yathā 'payasā pāyasena vā śrāddhaṃ dattena māsaṃ tṛptiḥ pitṛṇām' ityādīni |

iha yadyapi brāhmaṇatvādijāteraicchatvaṃ na kauṇḍinyatvādijāteḥ, tathāpi ṛtvakārakatvamātreṇa ṛtvarthatvavyavahāraḥ |

śrautāt godohanāt tatra camasasya nirākriyā |
' iti (vā. pṛ. 838) evamuttaratra |

śrāddhe hi payaḥpāsādi bhinnavākyevihitam, tatra lokto bhojane samuccayenāpi klṛptaṃ vikalpenāpi yathāprāptaṃ ca vidhīyate iti na nityaṃ samuccayaḥ, nāpi nityaṃ vikalpaḥ iti hemādrau uktaṃ yuktaṃ ca |
ataḥ aicchike ṛtvarthajātidravyādikalpe tadudāharaṇam |
puruṣārthajātidravyavikalpe api aicchikā ekona- viṃśatireva |
tatra yadyapi tulyaphalanāṃ jātyādīnāṃ nyāyagamyo vikalpo na tu aicchikaḥ, tathāpi bhinna- phalanāṃ anyataraphalakāmanāyāṃ aicchiko vikalpo bhavati |
teṣāṃ nabhyaphalakāmanāyāṃ samuccaya'pi bhavati, ato vakṣyamāṇāni tadvipayāṇi samuccayodāharaṇā- nyeva anyataraphalakāmanāyāṃ vikalpāni jñeyāni |
puruṣārthajātidravyavādināṃ tā catvāri udāharaṇāni samucca- yena sambhavanti vikalpavidhayāṇi, tānyucyante |

[2] yathārthadravyatadabhāvayoḥ aicchiko vikalpaḥ |

vikalpabhedā: vikalpabhedā:
vikalpa: [ 4 ] tathā 'citrayā yajeta paśukāma:' iti pārthevihitacitreṣṭikriyātadabhāvayo: aicchiko vikalpa: iti |
evaṃ aicchikavikalpasya ekonaviṃśati: kṛtyarthaviṣayā: ekonaviṃśatiśca puruṣārthaviṣayā: ityevaṃ aṣṭatriṃśat aicchikavikalpabhedā: , pūrvoktāśca saptaviṃśati: nyāya- gamyavikalpabhedā: , aṣṭatriṃśacca yācanakavikalpabhedā: iti sarve militvā tryadhikaṃ śataṃ ( 103 ) vikalpa- bhedā: siddhā: |
punarapi dvividho vikalpa: pūrvokto yathāsaṃbhavaṃ avyava- sthito vyavasthitaśca |
ādyo yathā- agnihotre daśadravya- vikalpa: |
dvitīyo yathā- 'vrīhibhiriṣvā vrīhibhireva yajeta ā yavebhya: yavaireva yavaireva yajeta ā vrīhibhya:' iti śrīdhāyamyottaraṃ vrīhibhireva darśapūrṇamāsau kāryāṃ yavā- graṇāvadhi, yavāgraṇyottaraṃ ca yathaiva darśapūrṇamāsau kāryā vrīhyagrayaṇa
vikalpe'pi aṣṭau doṣā na santi, kasyāpi śāstrasya pratītaprāmāṇyatyāgābhāvāt |
'paśunā yajeta' iti hi ekameva śāstram, tatra ca ekatvaviva- kṣāvaśena kadācit kasyāścit puṃstvarūpadāne'pi sakalastacchāstrārthaḥ anuṣṭhīyate evaitat kasya tat śāstrasya prāmāṇyatyāgādi |
evaṃ svecchayā vyaktyaṃtaro- pādāne'pīti |
evameva vācanike'pi vikalpe aṣṭau doṣā na santi |

kecit prakṛtigatā eva, kecit vikṛtyu- padiṣṭapadārthaviṣayāḥ, kecit aprakṛtivikṛtyātmaka- jñopadiṣṭapadārthaviṣayāḥ, kecit vikṛtau upadiṣṭadiṣṭa- padārthaviṣayāḥ, kecit vikṛtau atidiṣṭamātraviṣayā iti |
tatra [1] prakṛtau upadiṣṭapadārthamātraviṣayo bhāva- vikalpo bhāvābhāvavikalpaśca yathā- māsāgnihotre prakṛtau nityāgnihotre payaādidaśadravyāṇāṃ vikalpaḥ |
dadhyadhi- śrayaṇatadabhāvavikalpaḥ |
'na dadhyāśrayet, adhi- śrayedityeke' iti bahuvacanān brāhmaṇam |
[2] vikṛtau upa- diṣṭayorbhāvayoḥ bhāvābhāvaviṣaya vikalpo yathā- vājapeye prājāpatyāṃ ṛtupaśubhiḥ sahālabdho brahmāsāmakatve vā ityādipadārthayoḥ kāryovikalpaḥ ; 'atirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' 'nātirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti ṣoḍaśi- mahattadabhāvavikalpaḥ |
[3] aprakṛtivikṛtyātmakarma- padiṣṭayorbhāvayoḥ abhāvaviṣaya vikalpo yathā- āghāne patramāneṣṭīnāṃ pūrṇāhutyā saha vikalpaḥ; tatraiva vājapeyenayāṃ ṛtu-nakṣatra-saṃbhāra-cātuḥprāśya-jāgaraṇa-impūpūrvā- nvārambha-sāparāyaṇīṃ vā kuryāt' iti pūrvavadvāhatam |
[4] vikṛtau upadiṣṭayorbhāvayoḥ tādṛśayorbhāvābhāvayośca vikalpo yathā- 'iṣṭyā paśunā somena yajeta, somāvā- syāyāṃ paurṇamāsyā vā' ityatra iṣṭyadoṣapāttāyāṃ amāvāsyā- vikṛtau atidiṣṭāyā amāvāsyāyāḥ, upadiṣṭāyāḥ paurṇa- māsyāḥ vikalpaḥ; evaṃ iṣṭiśabdopāttāyāṃ paurṇamāsīvikṛtau atidiṣṭāyāḥ paurṇamāsyāḥ, upadiṣṭāyāḥ amāvāsyāyāḥ vikalpaḥ |
bhāvābhāvodāharaṇaṃ tu 'na tau paśau karoti' iti paśuyāga rūpāyāṃ vikṛtau atidiṣṭayoḥ ājyabhāgayoḥ, upadiṣṭasya ca tanniṣedhasya vikalpaḥ iti |
[5] vikṛtau atidiṣṭamātraviṣayastu bhāvayorvikalpo yathā- 'jāghanyā patnīḥ saṃyājayanti' iti |
tat patnīsaṃyājānāṃ jāghanyārthatvaṃ na bhavati, aprākṛtakāryatvāpatteḥ, kiṃtu prakṛtito vaikalpikāḥ prāptāyāḥ jāghanyāḥ niyamārtham |
tatra copādeyatvāt jāghatyekatvaṃ vivakṣitam |
tataśca paśugaṇe pratisaṃskārārthaṃ saṃskārāvṛttiḥ iti jāghanīsamuccayanyāyā- pravṛtteḥ (12|4|16-16) yā kācit jāghanī upādeyā iti vikalpaḥ |
idaṃ ca dvādaśe 'dravyavikāraṃ tu pūrvavadarthakarma syāt' ityadhikaraṇe uktaṃ (12|4|16) vikṛtau atidiṣṭasya bhāvasya anupāditena atidiṣṭanā- bhāvena vikalpe udāharaṇam |
atra na kaścidvācyaḥ prakṛtau avaikalpya eva, vikṛtau tu niṣedhopadeśe'pi padārtha- ntaravikalpatvāt arthāt svābhāvena saha vikalpaṃ bhajate, tādṛśadāhārthaṃ anye bhede |
tathyā- agnīṣomīye prayāja- śeṣāghāraṇaṃ vapāyā atraikalpikamevāsīt prājāpatya- paśurālambhe tu kāladvayaṃ vihitaṃ ṛtupaśubhalakāle brahma- sāmakāle veti |

tathā puruṣārthānāmukyādisaṃsthānāṃ bhinnaphalanāmapi aicchiko vikalpaḥ anyonyam |
tathā saṃsthānāṃ svasamānaphalaiḥ jyotiṣṭomadaśāṅgaśritairjātibhāveḥ saha aikārthyāt nyāya- gamyo vikalpa iti |

tantrakramādīnāmapi kriyādharmatvāt dharmadharmiṇoścābhedāt tadvikalpāḥ kriyā- vikalpabhede evāntarbhavanti |
tathā kacit vikalpasyāpi anyatarakoṭyā saha vikalpo bhavati, yathā asoma- yājinaḥ sāṃnāyyavikalpaḥ : 'nāsomayājī saṃnayet, tadu sameva nayet' iti vidhipratiṣedheṣucalāt |
somayājinastu sāṃnāyyameveti |
'puroḍāśabhyāmevāsāṃyājinaṃ yājayet yāvet āgneyaścaindrāgnaśca, sāṃnāyyena tu somayājinam' iti vacanāt |

smārtodāharaṇatrayaṃ tu vijñāneśvareṇoktaṃ - 'śrutyā saha, bhartrā saha, pitrā saha' iti (1|253) sapiṇḍīkaraṇe vikalpaḥ smṛtibhedenoktaḥ |
smṛtiḥ 'pitāmahādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ smṛtam |
' 'paiṭhīnasiḥ - 'aputrāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ tu patiḥ kuryāt sapiṇḍanam |
ityanyadādibhiḥ sahaivādyāḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ bhavet |
' yamaḥ - 'patyā caikena kartavyaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ striyāḥ |
sā mṛtā'pi hi tenaivaṃ gatā mantrāhutistataḥ ||
' uśanāḥ - 'pitṛḥ pitāmahe yadvat pūrṇa saṃvatsare sutaiḥ |
mātṛmātāmahe tadvadeṣā kāryaṃ sapiṇḍatā ||
' iti |
tatra aputrāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ bhartā svamātraiva sapiṇḍyaṃ kuryāt |
anvārohaṇe tu putraḥ svapitreva mātuḥ sapiṇḍyaṃ kuryāt |
āmurādidivā- hotvannaḥ putrikāputraśca mātāmahenaiva |
brāhmadivā- hotvannaḥ pitāmahena pitāmahyā vā vikalpena kuryāt iti |
tathā mātuḥ piṇḍadānādau gotre vikalpaḥ : 'svagotrād bhraśyate nārī vivāhāta saptame pade |
svāmigotreṇa kartavyaṃ tasyāḥ piṇḍodakakriyā ||
' iti bhartṛgotraviparyāta, 'pitṛgotraṃ samutsṛjya na kuryāt bhartṛgotram ||
' iti janmayeva vipattau ca nārīṇāṃ paitṛkaṃ kulam ||
' iti pitṛgotraviparyāta ca vacanāt |
tatra āmurādidivāheṣu putrikākaraṇe ca pitṛgotrameva, brāhmadi- vāheṣu trīhiyavavat vṛhadrathaṃtaravat vikalpa eveti |
tathā kṣayāhaśrāddhe ekoddiṣṭaṃ pārvaṇaṃ veti vikalpaḥ |
'sapiṇḍī- karaṇādūrdhvaṃ pratisaṃvatsaraṃ sutaiḥ |
mātāpitroḥ pṛthak kārya- mekoddiṣṭaṃ mṛte'hani ||
' iti yamena ekoddiṣṭavidhānāt |
'sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryāt pārvaṇavat sadā |
prati- saṃvatsaraṃ cihnān chāgaleyoditi vidhiḥ ||
' iti śātā- tapena pārvaṇavidhānāt |
tatra saṃnyāsinaḥ kṣayāhe sutena pārvaṇaṃ kāryaṃ 'ekoddiṣṭaṃ yatenāsti tridaṇḍagrahaṇādiha |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇābhāvāt pārvaṇaṃ tasya sarvadā ||
' iti praceto- vākyāt |
amāvāsyākṣaye tu pretapakṣakṣaye ca pārvaṇameva 'amāvāsyākṣaye yasya pretapakṣakṣaye tathā |
pārvaṇaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ naikoddiṣṭaṃ kadācana ||
' iti smṛteḥ |
anyatra kṣayāhe asaṃnyāsinaḥ pārvaṇoddiṣṭayoḥ trīhiyavavat vikalpa eveti |
iti vikalpabheda nirūpaṇam |

vikṛtau tvaniyama: syāt pṛṣadājyavat grahaṇasya guṇārthatvād ubhayośca pradiṣṭatvād guṇa- śāstraṃ yadeti syāt |
vikṛtau 'saumāraudraṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śuklānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ brahmavarcasakāma:' ityādī vikṛtihyavayo: aniyama: vikalpa: syāt |
grahaṇasya hinirdeśasya guṇārthatvāt śrīhinirdeśa: śuklatvādiguṇasaṃbandhāt na yāgasaṃbandhāt |
vrīhyaśvet śuklā: |
yāgastu vrīhibhirvā yavairvā |
pṛṣadājyavat yathā 'pṛṣadājyenānuyājān yajati' ityatra ājyaṃ pṛṣatāsaṃbandhāt bhavati tasmāt vikalpa: |
ubhayośca vrīhiyavayo: noṭakena pradiṣṭatvāt prāpitatvāt vikalpa: |
guṇāstraṃ 'śuklānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ' 'kṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ' ityādi guṇaśāsanaṃ tu 'yadā iti syāt' ('yadīti syāt' iyapi pāṭha:) yadā vrīhya: tadā śuklā: iti vidhānārthaṃ syāt |
tasmāt vikalpa: iti pūrva: pakṣa: |
aikādhyādvā niyamyeta śrutito viśiṣṭatvāt |
'saumāraudraṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śuklānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ brahma- varcasakāma:' ityādi vikṛtau vrīhiyavayorvikalpa: |
vrīhigrahaṇaṃ tu śuklaguṇasaṃbandhāt iti pūrvapakṣe prāpte, siddhāntayati |
yāśavda: prasiddha: |
vrīhiyavayo: aikādhyāt havirjanana- rūpaikakāryakaratvāt ubhayo: prāptayo: śrutita: pratyakṣaśravaṇena viśiṣṭatvāt viśeṣato vihitatvāt niyamyeta vrīhidravyaṃ yavānāṃ nivṛtti: |
tasmānna vikalpa: |
virodhitvācca lokavata |
saumāraudrādicarau vrīhiyavayorvikalpo yavānāṃ bādha iti siddhānte sādhakāntaramāha |
vrīhyatvena ekakāryakarāṇāṃ parasparaṃ virodho bhavati, evaṃ vrīhiyavayorvirodhinvācca pratyakṣaśrutā vrīhayo yavān nivartayeyu: |
lokavat yathā 'matsthānaṃ na payasā samīyāt' iti matsyā: payo nivartayanti tadvat |
kratośca tadguṇatvāt |
'saumāraudraṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapecchuklānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ brahmavarcasakāma:' ityādi vikṛtau yadi vrīhīṇāṃ yāgena saṃbandha: syāt tarhi śuklaguṇena saṃbandho na syāt iti cettatrāha siddhāntī krato: yāgasya, tadguṇatvāt tau yuktatvā ca vrīhiśca guṇo yasya sa tadguṇa: |
aśruka- hāyanīvat śuklatā vrīhiśca kratoreva guṇau |
paścācca parasparānvaya: |
tasmāt uktavikṛtau vrīhiyavayorna vikalpa: |
virodhino ca tacchrutāvāśabdād vikalpa: syāt |
saumāraudrādicarau vrīhīṇāṃ niyamo yavānāṃ nivṛtti: iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha |
virodhino madhye tacchruto tasya anyatarasya virodhina: pratyakṣa śravaṇe sati anyasya ca adrādavat śabdaśrutvāt kathaṃ vikalpa: syāt iti kāku: |
kiṃca vikalpa: anyāyāya: syāt ityādyā- hāra: |
tathā ca saumāraudrādicarau śuklādīnāṃ pratyakṣa- śravaṇāt yavānāṃ cāśravaṇāt vrīhīṇāṃ niyama: yavānāṃ bādha: |
pṛṣadājye samuccayād grahaṇasya guṇārthatvam |
saumāraudrādicarau 'śuklānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ' iti vrīhigrahaṇaṃ na yāgasaṃbandhārthaṃ kiṃtu śuklaguṇasaṃbandhārthe iti pūrvapakṣe pṛṣadājyecchanta ukta: 'vikṛtau tvaniyama:' iti sūtre (10|7|15|164) taṃ pṛṣadājyadṛṣṭāntaṃ veśyena vighaṭa- yati siddhāntī |
pṛṣadājye grahaṇasya ājyanirdeśasya guṇārthatvāt pṛṣattāguṇasaṃbandhasaṃbandhārthatvaṃ yuktam, dadhnā ājyasya samuccayāt, dadhnā pṛṣattāyā upādanīyatvāt |
tena na pārkṣikaṃ dadhi, ājyena ca samuccaya: saumāraudrādicarau tu vrīhiyavayorna samuccayasaṃbhava: |
tato viṣamo dṛṣṭānta: |
yadyapi caturavattīti tu niyame nopapadyate |

asti ca kuśānāṃ prakṛtisaṃbandhināṃ dvāreḥ pratyāmnānena kāryasiddhau atideśena vikṛtyuttvā- bhāvāttve|
'na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte' ityādirūpadāsanatvācca hotṛvaraṇādervikṛtyudbhavabhāvāttetyapi|
atra vikṛtyudbhava- grāhakapramāṇābhāvasya ghaṭādāvapi sattvādātraṃ viśeṣaṇam|
nityaprayoge prasaṅgasthale cātideśasyaiva vikṛtyavagrāhaka- pramāṇasya sattvādanyam|
yadyapi na prasaṅgasthalemya eva 'kāralābhamātra tasmin prayoge prajājādipadārthasyāṅgatvam, tathāpi sarvatra prakṛtau vikṛtau vā padārthānāmanyata upa- kālābhame prajājādimistatpradhānopayogakyuta, upakāra- lābhe tu tatraiva karaṇapriyayogyatāṃ kurvādityevaṃvidhamyeva pramāṇasya kalpanācca vikṛtyavagrāhakapramāṇasattvam|
ata eva prakṛterapi daivyadharmātnaimittikavikṛtiprayogāntaḥpāte prasaṅgasiddhirāpyahatā|
atra cānyasaṃbandhino'nyatatvagrāhakapramāṇābhāva ityuktau vikṛtisaṃbandhina upahomādeḥ prakṛtisaṃbandhinaḥ prajājā- dervā jyotiṣṭomādyatagrāhakapramāṇābhāvavattvāt prādhāpateḥ prakṛtivikṛtipadopādānam|
atra ca prakṛtiśabdo nātideśa- nirūpakaparaḥ, vikṛtiśabdo vā nātideśatatparaḥ|
tathātve gṛhamedhīyasya vastuto darśaprakṛtibhāvena tatra prajājā- dibhāve niruktalakṣaṇatvādyāmeḥ|
apitu darśādisaṃbandha- prakārakajñānaviśeṣasyaiva vikṛtitvadaḥ; prakṛtiśabdaścokta- viśeṣyatānirūpakaprakāraparaḥ, tacca jñānaṃ mauryādātideśa- vākyajanyaṃ pramāṇarūpam, gṛhamedhīye tu 'ājyabhāgau yajati' ityetadvākyābhāvātpramāṇaṃ tārkikam|
ata eta- ayasādhāraṇyeṇa doṣajanyajñānatvenānugamaḥ|
ata eva jyotiṣṭomādau doṣeṇa vikṛtitvabhrame prajājādibhāve nāti- vyāptiḥ|
astu vā gṛhamedhīyavṛttiprayājādibhāvādhyā- hananīyādibhāvavat svarūpeṇopyāyātvenābhāve'pi prasaṅga- gasyaiva daśamādhyāyānnirūpyatvam|
evaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇavitvasya yatprakṛti-saṃbandhitva- viśiṣṭasya yadvikṛtitvadasyagrāhakapramāṇaviṣayatvābhāvaḥ: tadabhāvāccittasya tatra bādhitatvamiti niṣkṛṣṭārthaḥ phalitaḥ|
yadi tu niruktavākyādhyāyāntare kvācitkaṃ nirūpaṇaṃ saṃbhāvyeta tathāpi dṛśye tasya prādhānyena nirūpaṇācca kācitkatvatiḥ|
iṣyata eva hi tantrāvāpanirū- paṇasya tṛtīye prāsaṅgikaṃ nirūpaṇaṃ sarvapṛṣṭhāyām, nāmadheya- tvādeśca dharmodāhaṇādevādyam|
ata eva bhāṣyakāgektamapi bādhakakṣaṇamatisaktamapi nātīvāsaṃgatam, tathāhi-yadviśeṣadarśane yasya śāstrasya yadviṣaye yādyaniśrayajanakatvaṃ tādyaniśrayasya tadviśeṣa- darśanenāprāmāṇyaniścaya eva tadviṣaye tasya śāstrasya bādhaḥ|
bhavati ca prāpadādirūpaviśeṣadarśane'tideśaśāstrasya kuśādanīyādiviṣaye, tattaduddeśyasaṃbandhiniścayaṃ tasya tadviśeṣadarśanenāprāmāṇyaniścaya iti tadviṣaye tasya śāstrasya bādhaḥ|
idaṃ ca yadyapi rāgaprāptānutavadanādi- bādhe'saṃbhavati, tathāpi tasya prāsaṅgikanirūpaṇīyatvādbī- kārāt na kṣatiḥ|
idaṃ hi bhāṣyasāmānyārtha adhyāyānta- rasthaśrutiliṅgādivādhāsādhāraṇamapi prādhānyenaiva nirūpaṇī- yatvāt yathā nāsaṃgataṃ tathā mamāpīti na kaściddoṣaḥ|
paraṃ tu atideśopajīvitvasya bhāṣyakāroktatvādevacchedā- gacchedenāsambhavāt tadanaṅgīkāraḥ|
anya ca bādhasyopajīvitvābhāve'pi uhasyāti- dipadārthadharmatvenātideśaprayāsānantatvāt taduttaraṃ nirūpaṇe kṛta evāsan iti uhenāpi saṃgatiḥ|
ayaṃ ca bādhastrividhaḥ arthalopāt, pratyāmnānāt, pratiṣedhācceti|
tatrānyabhinnabādhopadeśātvenāpi pratipāda- nīyam, yatprākṛtapadārthānāmupakārāntareṇa svarūpeṇaiva na vikṛtāvātideśaḥ|
yena prakṛtyadṛṣṭakāryāsaṃbhave vikṛtāvevā- dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanāntaraṃ kalpayitvā bādhabhāvaḥ śakyeta|

atideśalakṣaṇaṃ ca padārthamādāyopapannataram|

upakārāṇāṃ prakṛtatvāpi karaṇaniṣṭayogyatāyāḥ pṛthakapadāryā- nuniṣṭatvānāmapi padārthākṣepakatatkalpane gauravāt|
ati- deśasye'pi ca prakṛtatvavāsāyātpadārthānāṃ mupakāramānatvātideśaḥ|
