codanāprabhūtatvāt codanāyāḥ ekādaśatvaviśiṣṭaprajātivadheḥ codakalope prabhutvāt samartha- syāt |
tathā ca prajādibhāgasya ekādaśatvasaṃkhyāyāśca vidhāne śabdasya samarthatvāt prākṛtītikartavyatā na prāpnoti |
pradhānaṃ tvaṅgasaṃyuktaṃ tathā bhūtamapūrva syāt tasya vidhupalakṣaṇatvāt sarvo hi pūrvavān vidhiviśeṣaṇāt pravartitaḥ |
amīṣomīye paśau 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati ekā- daśānuyājān' iti śrutam |
ekādaśatvasaṃviśiṣṭe prajādi karmāntarama vidhīyate, atra prākṛtī itikarta- vyatā na prāpnoti iti pūrvapakṣaṃ tuśabdena nivartayan siddhāntamāha |
naitadasti prākṛtī itikartavyatā na prāpnotīti |
kintu prāpnotyeva |
prākṛtaṃ pradhānaṃ yathā aṅga- saṃyuktaṃ yādṛśāsaṃyuktam, tathābhūtaṃ tādṛśāsaṃyuktaṃ apūrva vikṛtisāmānyaṃ syāt |
kacit vikṛtau sauryādau 'prayāje prayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti' iti tasya prākṛtāṅgasya vidhupalakṣaṇatvāt vidhānasya upalammāt sarvo hi sarva eva vidhiḥ |
pūrvavān prakṛtyuparka iti aviśeṣāt aviśeṣeṇa pravartitaḥ syāt |
'prakṛtitvat vikṛtiḥ kartavyatā' iti sarvavikṛtiṣu niyamaḥ |
tasmāt agnīṣomīye paśau api prakṛtitaḥ itikartavyatāṃ prāptāyāṃ ekādaśatvādi- guṇavidhaya eva iti siddhāntaḥ |
na cāṅgavidhiranaṅga syāt |
amīṣomīye paśau 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati ekādaśānuyājān' iti śrutam |
tatra prakṛtitaḥ prāptāyāṃ itikartavyatāyāṃ ekādaśatvādiguṇavidhiḥ iti siddhāntaṃ upohyati |
na ca anaṅge karmaṇi aṅgasya viśeṣavidhiḥ syāt |
bhavati ca viśeṣavidhiḥ : 'āśvavālaḥ prastaraḥ' iti |
nahi asati prasare āśvavālatvarūpo viśeṣaḥ śipyeta |
tasmāt vikṛtiṣu prakṛtitaḥ itikartavyatāṃ prāptāyāṃ viśeṣaguṇavidhayaḥ |
karmaṇaścaikaśatvāt saṃnidhāne vidherāsyāsaṃyoge guṇena tadvikāraḥ syācchabdasya vidhigāmitvāt guṇasya copadeyatvāt |
siddhāntasādhakaṃ aparaṃ viśeṣamāha |
karmaṇaḥ pradhāna- karmaṇe guṇakarmaṇaśca aikaśśabdāt ekaḥ śabdo vidhāyako yasya tadekaśabdam, tasya bhāva aikaśśabdam, tasmāt |
ekena hi prayogavacanena aṅgapradhānānucyante |
tasmāt pradhānavacanena aṅgānāṃ saṃnidhānam |
evaṃ saṃnidhāne sati vidheḥ aṅgavidheḥ āsthayā nāmnā saṃyogo bhavati yaḥ prajājasaṃjñako yāgaḥ tatra ekādaśatvaguṇavidhiḥ iti |
evaṃ sarvatra yāge guṇena tadvikāraḥ syāt |
saṃkhyayā mantreṇa ca saṃkhyāntaraṃ mantrāntaraṃ ca vikriyeta |
guṇena vaikṛta- guṇena tadvikāraḥ prākṛtaguṇavikāraḥ syāt |
tathā ca śabdasya ekādaśādiśabdasya vidhigāmitvāt prayājādi- vidhigāmitvāt, guṇasya ca ekādaśatvādeḥ upadeśatvāt vidheyatvāt nānarthakaṃ punarvacanam |
tasmāt paśau prakṛtitaḥ itikartavyatā prāpyate, prāptāyāṃ ca guṇavidhayaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
akāryatvācca nāmnaḥ |
prajājāḥ, anuyājāḥ iti nāmnaḥ akāryatvāt avi- dheyatvāt 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati' ityādinā na karmā- ntaravidhiḥ |
kintu agnīṣomīye paśau prakṛtitaḥ prāptānāṃ prayājānāṃ ekādaśatvasaṃkhyārūpaguṇa vidhiḥ, iti siddhāntaḥ |
tulyā ca prabhutā guṇe |
tulyā ca prabhutā sāmarthyaṃ codakasya guṇe, guṇān prayājādīn prakṛtitaḥ prāpayitum |
prāpteṣu ca teṣu saṃkhyā- diguṇavidhayaḥ |
ayathavā tulyā prabhutā sāmarthye ākhyāta- śabdānām |
ye hi śaknuvanti guṇavatsaṃjñinā guṇaṃ karma ca tridhātuṃ śaknuvanti tatra te kevalaṃ guṇaṃ vidhātum |
tasmāt agnīṣomīye paśau prāptānāṃ prayājānāṃ ekādaśatvasaṃkhyā- rūpaguṇasya vidhiḥ iti siddhāntasiddhiḥ |
sarvameva pradhānamiti cet |
yadi ākhyātaśabdo guṇamapi vidhāsyati, evaṃ sati sarvaṃ pradhānaṃ syāt agnīṣomīyaprayājeṣu pradhānatvaṃ syāt iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
tathābhūtena saṃyogatvāt yathārthavidhayaḥ syuḥ |
ākhyātaśabdavācyāt guṇasyāpi pradhānatvaṃ prasajyeta iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā sūtreṇa, tannirasyati siddhāntī |
tathābhūtena ākhyātaśabdabhūtatvena saṃyogatvāt, nahi pradhāna- bhūto guṇabhūto vābhavati |
kintu yathārthavidhayaḥ syuḥ |
ye arthāḥ yathā bhavanti pradhānabhūtā guṇabhūtā vā teṣāṃ yathārthanāmeva satāṃ vidhayaḥ syuḥ |
yat pradhānaṃ tat pradhānameva yat guṇabhūtam, tat guṇabhūtameveti |
vidhitvaṃ cāviśiṣṭamevaṃ prākṛtānāṃ vaikṛtaiḥ karmaṇā yogāt tasmāt sarvaṃ pradhānārtham |
vidhe upakaroti iti vidhiḥ tasya bhāvo vidhitvaṃ aṅgattvaṃ iti kutūhalam |
prākṛtānāṃ padārthānāṃ vaikṛtaiḥ padārthaiḥ saha vidhitvaṃ aṅgattvaṃ evaṃ aviśiṣṭaṃ tulyam |
karmaṇā āryatvādipraśaṃsā rūpeṇa yogāt saṃbhavāt |
'agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati, yajñasya pratiṣṭhe' iti prakṛtau ya evārthavādaḥ, sa evārthavādo vikṛtau bhavati 'agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati, yajñameva pratiṣṭhāpayati' iti tathā 'cakṣuṣī ete yajñasya yadājyabhāgī' iti prakṛtau, 'ājyabhāgī yajati cakṣuṣī eva nāntareti' iti vikṛtau |
tasmāt sarve etajātīyakaṃ pradhānārthe vikṛtau guṇabhūtam |
samatvācca tadutpatteḥ saṃskāraivādhikāraḥ syāt |
itaśca paśyāmo na sarve pradhānam, pradhānārthamapi kiñci- ditīti |
tadutpatteḥ tayoḥ prakṛtitvavikṛtyoḥ prakṛtau vikṛtau na utpatteḥ prayājānuyājānāṃ utpattiḥ kramasatvāt tulya- tvāt |
ādau prayājāḥ madhye pradhānaṃ tato'nuyājāḥ iti kramaḥ prakṛtau vikṛtau ca samāna eva |
tasmāt saṃskāraiḥ dṛṣṭadṛṣṭavighā upakāraiḥ sahitasya pradhānasya adhi- kāraḥ vikṛtiprayogavidhiḥ vidhāyakaḥ syāt |
tasmāt sarve pradhānam, pradhānārthamapi kiñcidasti |
adhikaraṇārthantu tasmāt prakṛteḥ prāsāyāmitikartavyatāyāṃ guṇavidhayaḥ paśau ekādaśaprayājānuyājāvākyāni iti |

vikṛtau sarvārthaḥ śeṣaḥ prakṛtitvat |
idaṃ samāmananti - 'yathāvarṇaṃ vai kāmyā iṣṭayaḥ tā upāṃśu kartavyāḥ' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ aṅgapradhānārtha- mupāṃśutvam, uta pradhānārthamiti |
pūrve vikṛtauvedideśāt prāptānāṃ bahirājyadharmāṇāṃ aṅgapradhānārthatvaṃ prasaṅgāt sāpavādaṃ nirūpya idānīṃ vikṛtāvevopadiṣṭadharmāṇāṃ kiṃ aṅgapradhānārthatvamuta kevalapradhānārthatvaṃ iti prasaṅgā- nirūpyate |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ - prakṛtau vidhīyamānāḥ sāṅgapradhānārthāḥ |
ataḥ vikṛtāvyapāṃśutvādayo dharmāḥ sāṅgapradhānārthā eva |
na ca kāmyā iṣṭaya ityanena pradhāna- mātropādānamiti vaktavyam, sāṅgasyaiva pradhānasya kāma- sādhakatvāt |
aṅgānāmapi kāmyatvenopādānāviśeṣāt |
tasmāt vikṛtāvapi yathāprākṛtastanakārya evopāṃśutva- vidhiriti |
evaṃ prāpte abhidhīyate |
sukhyārthaṃ vā'ṅgasyācoditatvāt |
ayamiprāyaḥ - bhavedevaṃ yadi prākṛtabarhirmevavidhi- tulyatvamasya bhavet |
tatra hi prakaraṇāt pradhānārthatve prāpte vatrīyastvadaṅgapradhānārthatvaṃ dharmāṇāmavadhāritam |
iha tu kāmyā iṣṭaya iti śravaṇādaṅgameva pradhānārthatvaṃ pratipāda- yati |
na ca sāṅgasya kāmopapattaye'ṅgānāmapi kāmyaśabda- vācyatvamiti vaktavyam |
yato'ṅgānāṃ laghu pradhānopakāra- dvāreṇa paramparā pradhānopāyatvam, pradhānasya tu sākṣādeva |
na tu sākṣātsaṃbhave paramparāśrayaṇamucitamiti pradhānedhīnā- meva mukhyakāmyaśabdavācyatvāt tāsāmeva upāṃśutvamiti siddham |
prayojanam - pūrvapakṣe aṅgamadhyepyupāṃśutvaṃ kartavyam |
siddhānte tu pradhānamātreveti |
sūtraṃ tu-mukhyārthaṃ evāthamu- pāṃśutvavidhirastviti kṛte acoditatvāditi |

vikṛtau sarvārthaḥ śeṣaḥ prakṛtitvat |
'yathāvarṇaṃ vai kāmyā iṣṭayastā upāṃśu kartavyāḥ' iti kāmyeṣṭiṣu āyavarṇavedoktayajñavat upāṃśuḥ svaraḥ uktaḥ |
sa śeṣaḥ śeṣabhūtaḥ upāṃśuḥ svaraḥ vikṛtau tasyāṃ tasyāṃ kāmyeṣṭau sarvārthaḥ pradhānārthaśca syāt, na
vikṛtau |

kevalaṃ pradhānārtha eva|
prakṛtivat|
prakṛtau yathā vedi- dharmā ājyadharmāḥ sarvathā bhavanti tadvat|
iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ|
mukhyārtho vā''jñayācoditatvāt|
'yathāvadhaṃ vai kāmyā iṣyaḥ tā upāṃśu kateyyāḥ' iti kāmyeṣṭiṣu ārṣavadhavedakayajñavata upāṃśuḥ svara uktaḥ|
sa vikṛtibhūtakāmyeṣṭiṣu pradhānārthaśca jñeya iti pūrvasūtreṇa pūrvapakṣe prāpta|
ukta upāṃśuḥ svaraḥ mukhyārthaḥ pradhānārtha eva syāt nājñārthaḥ|
kutaḥ? ajñasya accoditatvāt|
'kāmyāḥ iṣyaḥ' iti hi uktam|
kāmyāśca pradhānārthā eva|
aṅga- yāgāstu na kāmārthāḥ kintu pradhānārthāḥ|
tasmāt uktavākye aṅgaṃ na coditam|
tattu noṭakena labhyeta|

tautvā |

jyotiṣṭome yaḥ somavikrayī somasya vikretā ṛtvikṣa eva anyatamaḥ syāt iti utsūtre pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhānta- yati sūtram |
tu-śabdaḥ pūrvasūtrebhya upabheyo vailakṣaṇyasya bodhakaḥ |
vikrayī yaḥ somaṃ vikrīṇāti sa tu anya eva ṛtvigbhyaḥ syāt |
karmaṇaḥ vikrayasya acoditatvāt |
yathā somasya krayo vihitaḥ na tathā vikrayo vihitaḥ |

videdhanādhikaraṇam 3538 vidyā:
abhiṣekāt pūrvaṃ tu prayogaḥ |
kutadeśo hi abhiṣekaḥ 'māhendrasya stotraṃ prati abhiṣicyate' iti |
pratyakṣān mrahāya abhiṣekāt pūrvaṃ pratyekamya |
nyāyamātraṃ itarat 'ante tu yādāyaṇaḥ' iti |
ḍupa - abhiṣecanīyāt ūrdhvaṃ prāgu daśapeyāta 'paṣṭhīhī dīyati' ityevamādayaḥ paṭhyante |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ abhiṣekaḥ apakṛṣyamāṇaḥ itarān apakarṣati uta neti |
kevalaḥ apakṛṣyate 'ante tu bādarāyaṇaḥ' (5|2|199) iti |
rājyasyānte iyāśaṅkaikaiva nāsti |
ataḥ abhiṣecanīyānte ini |
taya abhiṣekamātrasya apakarṣaḥ, yathā amāvāsyāyāṃ vedimātrasya |
prajāyānujñānānāṃ prakṛtau saṃbandhasya anavagatatvāt vikṛtau utkarṣāpakarṣau yujyate |
iha saṃbandhasya anavagatatvāt apūrvaḥ ayuktaḥ iti |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ |
aśāṭhya pāṭhasya pratyakṣatvāt pūrvaiḥ padārthairasti saṃbandhaḥ |
na cāyaṃ pāṭhaḥ atra kṛtārthaḥ; yathā paurṇamāsyāṃ vedeḥ |
ataḥ pūrvaiṣāmapakarṣaḥ |

anyo'pi dvividhaḥ - ekakartṛkopārakhyānarūpaparakṛtikalpyaḥ, aneka-kartṛkopārakhyānarūpapuruṣākṛtikalpyaśca |
tatra phalārthavādakalpyo yathā - 'yasya parṇamayī juhū-rbhavati, na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇoti' iti |
siddhavatkīrtanāyavādakalpyo yathā - 'vrīhi ha vai yajñasyodarāṇi gāyatrī bṛhatī anuṣṭup ca, atra hovāvapanti ata evodrapanti' iti |
prakṛtikalpyo yathā - 'tābhyāmetamagrīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ paurṇamāse prāyacchat' iti |
indrasyedamapyupākhyānaṃ tasmādindro'tribha-diti upakramāt ityatra prāyacchaditi kriyāyāṃ kartṛtvena anupaṅgāt |
purākalpyo yathā 'tāvantrātārmīpomau ājyasyaiva no upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti |
vidhya-ntaraśeṣārthavādakalpyo yathā - 'upari hi devebhyo dhārayati' iti |
mantrakalpyo'pi dvividhaḥ mantragatyākhyātasya leṭtva-kalpanāt vidhiyuktasyākhyātarūpakalpanāt |
tadyathā yathā - 'vasantaya kapiñjalānālabhate' iti |
dvitīyo yathā - upāṃśuyājādau yājyānuvākyāsūktavādimantrakalpyo devatāviviḥ |
yathā vā 'uccā di dakṣiṇavanto astyadhve adhvaḥ saha te sūryeṇa' ityadhavanaphalavidhiḥ |
[pṛ. 13] atha pratyakṣavidhivibhedāḥ prāyaśa ucyante |
te ca kecit smārtā api saṃbhavantaḥ pratyakṣabhedadarśanenaiva uttaprāyāḥ iti na pṛthagucyante |
kecit smārtā eva saṃbhavantīti tatratatra vakṣyante |
vidhiḥ punardvividhaḥ - arthakarmavidhiḥ guṇakarmavidhiśca |
guṇakarmavidhistrividhaḥ - adṛṣṭārthaḥ, dṛṣṭārthaḥ, ubhayārthaśca |
uttaro dvividho - pratipattirūpo apratipattirūpo ca |
tatra dṛṣṭārthaṃ pratipattiryā - 'catvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ prāsyati' iti |
ubhayārthaṃ pratipattiryā - āśrayārthameva svisa-kṛdādi |
apratipattirūpaṃ dṛṣṭārthe guṇakarma yathā - 'vrīhī-navahanti' iti |
apratipattirūpaṃ ubhayārthe guṇakarma yathā - paśupuroḍāśāyādi āśrayārtham |
vidhiḥ punarapi caturvidhaḥ - utpattividhiḥ, viniyo-gavidhiḥ, prayogavidhiḥ, adhikāravidhiśca |
tatra utpattyā-dividhiḥ caturvidho'pi pratyekaṃ dvividhaḥ - kratvarthaḥ
puruṣārthaśca |
tatra kratvarthaḥ utpattividhividharyā - 'samidho yajati' ityādi |
puruṣārthaḥ utpattividhividharyā - 'agni-hotraṃ juhoti' ityādi |
kratvartho viniyogavidhividharyā - 'vrīhīn prokṣati' ityādi |
puruṣārtho viniyogavidhividharyā - dravyalenavidhiḥ |
kratvarthaḥ prayogavidhividharyā, ārambhaṇīyādividhiḥ ādideśakāladeśādyekavākyatā-''pannaḥ |
puruṣārthaḥ prayogavidhirapi dvividhaḥ - avāntaraprayoga-vidhiḥ, mahāprayogavidhiśca |
tatrāyo yathā - 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta' 'amāvāsyāyāmamāvāsyā yajeta' ityādi |
atra ca phalavākye karaṇatvena prayogacche-dena karmaṇye vidheyatvāt tasya karaṇatvākṣataṃ asyāhitya-manyonyamapi vivakṣitam |
kālasyāpi ca vidheyatvāt tadekatvamapi vivakṣitam |
mahāprayogavidharyā - 'same dadhīpūrṇamāsāmyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
atrāpi paṇṇā-mekaprayogatāyāḥ pūrvokto'ḍiloḍapi nyāyastulyaḥ |
tasya phalaṃ ekaḥ saṃkalpaḥ |
[pṛ. 14] kratvarthaḥ adhikāravidhirapi dvividhaḥ - naimittikaḥ san, aṭopenanirdhāryate, anaimittikaḥ san, doṣanirghātārthato'pi ca |
tatrāyo yathā - 'bhine juhoti' iti |
dvitīyo dvividhaḥ - vihitātikramaṇanimittakaḥ, niṣiddhācaraṇanimittakaśca |
tatrāyo yathā - 'yadi rakto yajña ātimintyā bhūḥ svāheti gārhapatye juhuyāt' ityādi |
ṛgvedārniṣiddhācaraṇe'pi asya pravṛtteḥ dvitīyodāharaṇamapi idameva |
puruṣārthaḥ adhikāravidhividhividhaḥ - kāmyaḥ, naimi-ttikaḥ, saṃvalitaśca |
kāmyo'pi dvividhaḥ - karmaphalasaṃbandhaparaḥ guṇaphala-saṃbandhaparaśca |
tatrādyo yathā - 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' ityādi |
dvitīyo yathā - 'dadhaindriyakāmasya juhuyāt' ityādi |
naimittiko'pi dvividhaḥ - niyatanimittakaḥ aniyata-nimittakaśca |
[pṛ. 15] tatrāyo yathā - 'yāvajjī-vamagnihotraṃ juhoti' ityādi |
dvitīyo yathā - 'yasyāhi-tāgnermṛgahan dahet kṣāmaveda'gnaye puroḍāśamaṣṭākapāle nirvapet' ityādi |
tṛtīyo'pi dvividhaḥ - nimittajanyadoṣanāśaphalasaṃvalitaḥ, itaraphalasaṃvalitaśca |
tatrādyo'pi dvividhaḥ - vihitāti-kramaṇanimittakaḥ, niṣiddhācaraṇanimittakaśca |
tatrāyo yathā - 'yo'māvāsyāṃ paurṇamārthā vātipātayeta amaye pathikṛte-'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet' ityādi |
niṣiddhācaraṇanimittako yathā - 'yadyekaṃ yūpamupaspṛśet epa te vāyo iti brūyāt' ityādi |
itaraphalasaṃvalito yathā - 'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte' ityārabhya 'yasmin jāte etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati, pūta eva tejasvyannāda indriyāvī paśumān bhavati' ityanto jāteṣṭividhiḥ |
vidhiḥ punarapi ekādaśavidhaḥ - (1) sāmānyavidhiḥ, (2) viśeṣavidhiḥ, (3) pratiprasavavidhiḥ, (4) upasaṃhāravidhiḥ, (5) apavādavidhiḥ, (6) vyavasthāvidhiḥ, (7) paryudāsavidhiḥ, (8) abhāvavidhiḥ, (9) sādhāraṇavidhiḥ, (10) utkarṣavidhiḥ, (11) apakarṣavidhiśca |
iha ca abhyanujñāvidhividhaḥ pratiprasavavidhiro'pyasti, yathā - 'paṇyāṃ karmaṇāmasya trīṇi karmāṇi jīvikā |
yājanādhyāpane caiva viśuddhāt pratigrahaḥ |
' iti |
tathā pratiprasavo'pyasti 'śritagakajo'bhojyāt' iti |
tathā pratiprasavo'pi abhyanujñāvidhividho'pyasti 'pūpā praviṣṭabhāgaḥ' iti |
atastau pṛthagvācau |
yadyapi ca upasaṃhāravidhiḥ viśeṣa-vidhibheda eva, pratiprasavavidhirapi ca sāmānyavidhi-viśeṣavidhibhedau saṃbhavataḥ, tathāpi bhedaṃ vinā'pi sāmānya-saṃbhavāt govalīvardanyāyena pṛthagdṛṣṭaḥ |
ekādaśavidho'pi vidhividhividhaḥ - kratvarthaḥ puruṣārthaśca |
tatra kratvarthaḥ sāmānyavidhividharyā - 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti |
puruṣārthaḥ sāmānyavidhividharyā - putrakāmeṣṭeḥ |
kratvartho viśeṣavidhividharyā - 'pade juhoti' iti |
puruṣārtho viśeṣavidhividharyā - 'yaḥ kāmayeta vīro ma ājāyeteti, sa caturhotāraṃ juhuyāt' iti |
vīraputra-kāmanāyāṃ hi caturhotrahomena bādhāt putrasāmānyātkāma-syaiva putreṣṭiḥ |
kratvarthaḥ pratiprasavavidhividharyā - 'pūpā
vidhi:
pratiprasavabhāgaḥ' iti |
puruṣārthaḥ sa yathā - grahaṇe sūtake'pi śrāddhavidhiḥ smārtaḥ |
pratiprasavavidhiḥ punaḥ pañcavidhaḥ - luptārthapratiprasavaḥ, bhūtāniṣiddhapratiprasavaḥ, paryudastapratiprasavaḥ, niyama- vidhinā phalato vyāvartyaṃta yat tadviṣayaḥ pratiprasavaḥ, pari- saṃkhyayā vyāvartitaṃ yat tadviṣayaśceti |
tatrādyo yathā - 'pūṣā pratiprasavaḥ' iti tātparyaḥ (314124|136) |
dāśamikaśca [pṛ. 16] kṛṣṇalacarau 'vṛte apayati' iti (10|2|1|12 - 2) |
dvitīyo yathā udāhṛtaḥ smārtaḥ, grahaṇe sūtake'pi śrāddhavidhiḥ |
'smārtakarmaparityāgo rāhoranyatra sūtake' iti rāhoranya nimitte yat smārtakarma śrāddhādi tasya mṛtake parityāgaḥ, na rāhunimittaka-smārtasya ityarthaḥ |
śaunako'pi 'na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni' iti niṣiddhasya pratiprasavaḥ 'agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta' 'vāyavyaṃ śveta- mālabheta' iti |
paryudastapratiprasavo yathā- bhaṭṭasomeśvaramate 'na prathamayajñe prayujyāt' ityasya paryudāmatvāt pratiprasavaḥ 'agniṣṭome prayukti' iti |
niyamavidhi vyāvartitapratiprasavo yathā- 'dvaitarevā- rtivatvaṃ kartavyam' iti varaṇaniyamena avṛtavyāvṛttau satyāṃ 'amṛtaḥ māmidhenīranvāha' iti honuraktasyāpi prati- prasavaḥ |
parisaṃkhyāvyāvartitapratiprasavo yathā- daśame paśo- rekahaviṣṭvamityatra uttare'dhikaraṇe 'hṛdayasyāgre'vadyati' ityādi parisaṃkhyā iti yathāsūtraṃ bhāṣyakṛto matam |
'ekādaśā vai paśoravadānāni' iti parisaṃkhyā iti someśvaraḥ |
ṛtvarthaḥ abhyanujñāvidhiryathā- 'yadi somavikrayī prativindeta pūrvatena vastrākāṇḍena avakṣaṇena vā nāśā- yeyuḥ, lakuṭairdhnanti ityeke, nityavadeke vadhaṃ pramāṇayanti' iti āpastambasūtre |
puruṣārthaḥ abhyanujñāvidhiryathā- 'krītarājako'bho- jyānnaḥ' iti |
abhyanujñāvidhiḥ punardvividhaḥ - kuto'pi adhyāvṛttaṃ yat tadviṣayaḥ, kuto'pi vyāvṛttaṃ yat tadviṣayaśca |
tatrādyo yathā- 'ṣaṇṇāṃ tu karmaṇāmasya trīṇi karmāṇi jīvikā |
yājanādhyāpane caiva viśuddhācca pratigrahaḥ |
' iti |
dvitīyaḥ pañcavidhaḥ - niṣiddhaviṣayaḥ, paryudastaviṣayaḥ, niyamāvyāvartitaviṣayaḥ, parisaṃkhyāvyāvartitaviṣayaḥ, upa- saṃhāravyāvartitaviṣayaśceti |
ādyo yathā- manūktaḥ 'na dīkṣitasyānna- maśnīyāt' iti niṣiddhe 'jīvitavyamayāpabho''nnamatti yastastataḥ |
ākāśa iva paṅkena na sa pāpena lipyate |
' iti |
dvitīyo yathā - 'kīrātrajako'bhojyānnaḥ' iti |
ubhayośca [pṛ. 17] prayojanaṃ alpadoṣatvaṃ nirdoṣatvaṃ cetyuktaṃ vārtike 'sāmānyābhyanujñānādviśeṣaśca viśiṣyate |
viśeṣo'pyantarnādoṣaḥ stokato'pyetatkriyā |
' iti (pṛ. 169) |
evaṃ paryudastasyāpi vidhirdvividhaḥ |
sāmānyarūpo viśeṣarūpaśca |
tatrādyo yathā- 'na dīkṣita- syānnamaśnīyāt' ityasya paryudastatvapakṣe 'agnīṣomīye saṃsthite yajamānasya gṛhe adhītavyam' iti |
dvitīyo yathā aitareyabrāhmaṇe 'aśitavyaṃ vapāyāṃ hutāyām' iti |
ubhayośca prayojanaṃ brahmatvaphalatvaṃ paryudāsavidheḥ |
iyāha bhaṭṭasomeśvaraḥ |
niyamavidhi vyāvartityābhyanujñā yathā- viprāderdhryājano- pāthiniyamavyāvartita kṣatriyādivṛttiḥ |
āpadi abhyanu- jñāyate 'ajīvaṃstu yathoktena brāhmaṇaḥ svena karmaṇā |
jīvet kṣatriyadharmeṇa |
' iti |
parisaṃkhyāvyāvartityābhya- nujñāvidhiryathā- pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ' ityanena vyāvartitānāṃ mārjāradīnāṃ abhyanujñāvidhiḥ 'prāṇālaye' ityādiḥ |
upasaṃhāravyāvartitaviṣayaḥ abhyanujñāvidhiryathā- 'bhavatputro brāhmaṇo bhikṣeta' iti sāmānyaviśeṣasaṃhāriṇa 'brāhmaṇo cared bhaikṣam' ityanena vyāvartitasya kṣatriyāde- rabhyanujñāvidhiḥ 'cāturvarṇye caredbhaikṣam' iti |
ṛtvarthe upasaṃhāravidhiryathā- 'āgneyaṃ caturdhā karoti' iti |
puruṣārthaḥ sa yathā- 'brahmahā dvādaśābdāni' iti sāmānyaṃ pūrvayorvarṇayoḥ 'vedādhyāyinaṃ hatvā' iti viśeṣe upasaṃhiyate |
vidhi:
upasaṃhāraḥ punarapi dvividhaḥ - upasaṃhārasya upasaṃhāra- viṣaye niyamataḥ prāptau, aniyamataḥ prāptau veti |
āyo- dāharaṇāni uktānyeva |
dvitīyodāharaṇaṃ tu 'yajuryuktaṃ rathamadhvaryave dadāti' iti |
vyavasthāvidhiḥ kratvartho yathā- 'vātraighnī paurṇamāsyā- manūyate, vṛdhanvatī amāvāsyāyām' iti |
'caturhotrā paurṇamāsībhimiśret pañcahotrā'māvāsyāyām' iti ca |
[pṛ. 18] puruṣārtho vyavasthāvidhiryathā- kṣayāhe pārvaṇaikoddiṣṭavyavasthāvidhiḥ |
vyavasthāvidhiḥ punaḥ trividhaḥ - ubhayaprāptau, anubhaya- prāptau, anyataraprāptau veti |
ādyo yathā-vātraighnīvṛdhanvatyoḥ |
ādyabhāgakrame pāṭhatā liṅgācca ubhayaprāpteḥ |
dvitīyo yathā caturhonapañcahotramantrayoḥ |
tayoḥ prakaraṇe anāmnānāt |
yathā vā 'yadagneye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti' 'sūryāya ca prajāpataye ca prātaḥ' iti |
brāhmaṇena devatātrividha- pakṣe abhisamayayoḥ aprāpteḥ |
tṛtīyo yathā - vāsiṣṭhānāṃ nārāśaṃso dvitīyaḥ prajājaḥ tanūnapādanyeyām' iti |
atra hi vidhipāṭhakramāt tanūnapādeya dvitīyaḥ prātaḥ, na nārāśaṃsaḥ |
tathā 'yadi rathaṃtarasāma somaḥ syāt aindravāyavāgrān mahān gṛhṇīyāt, yadi bṛhatsāmā śukrā- grān' iti |
atrāpi hi pāṭhata aindravāyavāgrataiva prāptā, na śukrāgratā iti |
vyavasthāyāḥ dvividhatvāt punarapi dvividho vyavasthāvidhiḥ - nyāyagamyā vyavasthā vācanikī ca |
tatrādya yathā- utpannavatvādādeḥ, ājīvyadhayoḥ |
vācanikī tu vyavasthā sattathā, tena saptavidhasta- trividhiḥ - deśato vyavasthā, kālato vyavasthā, kartṛto vyavasthā, saṃkhyāyata vyavasthā, karmato vyavasthā, phalato vyavasthā, nimittato vyavasthā iti |
(1) deśato vyavasthā yathā- 'varuṇapraghāseṣu uttare vihāre adhvaryurhaviṣpādyādati, mārutīmeva pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇasmin' iti |
smārtamudāharaṇaṃ yathā- 'narmadottarabhāge tu kartavyaṃ siṃhayukte |
kulīre saṃsthite bhānānupākuryāttu dakṣiṇe |
' iti bṛhaspateḥ |
(2) kālato vyavasthā yathā- 'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnimādadhīta' 'grīṣme rājanyaḥ' 'varṣāmu rathakāra ādadhīta' iti |
smārtamudāharaṇaṃ yathā- 'divā saṃdhyāsu karṇaśvatrasūtra uddiśyam |
kuryānṛpapurohite ca rātrau cedagnimāmukhaḥ |
' iti |
(3) kartṛto vyavasthā yathā- 'payovrataṃ brāhmaṇasya, yavāgū rājanyasya, āmikṣā vaiśyasya' iti |
tathā - 'cārha- dviguṃrājñāmanyaḥ' [pṛ. 19] brahmasāma kuryāt, pāthuradhamaṃ rājanyasya, gayovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya' iti |
tathā - 'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarpatī iti dvayoryajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt, ete asugramindvaḥ iti bahubhyo yajamānebhyaḥ' iti |
(4) saṃkhyayāto vyavasthā yathā- āgnīdhradhasānāya- dharmāṇām |
smārta tudāharaṇam 'garbhāṣṭame'bde kurvīta brāhmaṇasyopanayanam |
garbhādikādaśe rāśo garbhāt dvādaśe viśaḥ |
' iti |
(5) karmato vyavasthā yathā- 'rathaṃtare prasūnamāne saṃmīlayet, bṛhati samudaṃ manasā dhyāyet' iti |
smārtaudāharaṇaṃ tu 'iṣṭiśrāddhe kṛtajñaḥ, satyo nāndīmukhe vasuḥ |
naimittike kālakāmo, kāmye tu dhurilocanī |
purūravadryaṃ caiva pārvaṇe samudāhṛtau |
' ityādi |
'pinye svadita- mityevaṃ vācyaṃ goṣṭhe tu suśrutam |
saṃpannamilā- bhyudaye daive rocitamityapi |
' iti |
(6) phalato vyavasthā yathā- 'mṛnmayena pratiṣṭhākāmasya prayayet, kāmyena brahmavarcasakāmasya' iti |
smārtaudāharaṇaṃ tu, brahmayajñe eva phalaviśeṣārthe ṛgyajuḥsāmyādhyayana- vidhiḥ |
(7) nimittato vyavasthā yathā- 'yadi rathaṃtarasāmā somaḥ syāt aindravāyavāgrān mahān gṛhṇīyāt, yadi bṛhatsāmā śukrāgrān' iti |
smārtaudāharaṇaṃ tu 'tṛṇāmkṛtacūḍānāṃmṛddhirnimittaiḥ smṛtā |
nirvṛttacūḍa- kānāṃ tu nirātracchuddhirvismṛte |
' iti manuḥ |
tathā anyatarakoṭivyavasthā yā koṭyantarasya ārthikī vyavasthā bhavati sā'pi bhāvaviṣayā abhāvaviṣayā ceti dvividhā |
tatrādya yathā- 'āgneyo vai brāhmaṇo devatā, sa somenendrāgnīṣomīyo bhavati, yadevādeḥ paurṇamāsaṃ haviḥ tat tarhi anunirvepat, tarhi sa ubhayadevato bhavati' iti agnīṣomīyapuroḍāśe kṛtasomayāgapuṃvipa- yatvena vyavasthāpite arthāt tadabhāvaḥ akṛtasomayāga-
puṃviṣayatvena vyavasthita bhavati |
‘pūrvedyuramāvāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti’ iti amāvāsyāyāṃ pūrvedyuḥ vedikaraṇe vyapa- sthāpite arthāt havirbhāsasonattaraṃ vedikaraṇaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vyavasthitaṃ bhavati |
tadidaṃ udāharaṇadvayaṃ pañcame siddham |
‘tathā'pūrvam’ (5|1|16|29) [pṛ. 20] ityatra pūrvam, ‘utkaṣāṃd brāhmaṇasya’ (5|1|4|10-14) ityatra uttaram ||
paryudāsavidhiḥ ṛtvartho yathā- ‘yajatiṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karoti, nānūyājeṣu’ iti |
puruṣārtho paryudāso yathā- ‘nekṣetonyanmādidalaṃ’ ityādiḥ |
paryudāsavidhiḥ punardvividhaḥ- paryudāsasya svātantryāt, paraviśeṣaṇatvācca |
tatrādye ‘nekṣeta’ ityevodāharaṇam |
dvitīyastu dvividhaḥ- paryudāsasya uddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvāt vidheyaviśeṣaṇatvācca |
tatra uddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvena ‘anū- yājeṣu’ ityādāhāryam |
vidheyaviśeṣaṇatvāccathā- ‘nāparyeyaṃ brūṇīte, na hotāṃ brūṇīte’ iti |
punarapi vakṣyamāṇaniṣedhaṣoḍaśatvavat paryudāso'pi ṣoḍaśavidhaḥ |
tathāhi, prakṛtau vikṛtau prakṛtivikṛtyā- tmake aprakṛtivikṛtyātmake ca karmaṇi samānavidhānaḥ paryudāsavidhiḥ: ‘nānūyājeṣu yeyajāmahaṃ’ iti |
atra hi ātideśikadvārā pratīkṣaṇāt ‘saptadaśo vai prajāpati- ryajñe'nye'nyataḥ’ ityatra kārtikadṛktasya dviruktatānnyāyā- pavādasya sāmyāt |
evaṃ prakṛtitārānupakāraparyudāsaḥ, vikṛtigatārādupa- kāraparyudāsaḥ, aprakṛtivikṛtyātmakakammaṃgatādupakāraparyudāsaḥ |
prakṛtigata-pratipatticariktasaṃnipātidṛṣṭārthaparyudāsaḥ, prakṛtigata- pratipārparyudāsaḥ; vikṛtigatopadiṣṭasya pūrvavat trividhasya saṃnipātinaḥ paryudāsāḥ trayaḥ, vikṛtigatārādupa- kāraparyudāsaḥ pūrvavat trividhasya saṃnipātinaḥ paryudāsāḥ trayaḥ: iti dvādaśa |
eṣāmudāharaṇāni yathāsaṃbhavaṃ mṛgyāṇi |
abhāve ṛtvartho vidhiryathā svitkṛdarthāvacanāt ājyavidhiḥ ‘yā vai kāṃcit devatāmantarāyāt tasyā ādyucyate ājyanaitā devatāḥ parisaṃkhyāya yajeta’ iti |
tathā ‘abhyāmāve tu vipasya pāṇāvevopadayet’ iti |
puruṣārthaḥ abhāve vidhiyathā- ‘satrāyāgaṃ viśvajitā yajeta’ iti |
sādhāraṇavidhirvidhiviṣaḥ-- viniyogasādhāraṇavidhiḥ anuṣṭhānasādhāraṇavidhiśceti |
tatra ādyo yathā- ‘yadā- tidhyāyāṃ vahiḥ tadupasadāṃ tadabhīpomīyasya’ iti |
yathā vā bahiṣo vardhidhamānāṃ ca vedyā vedidharmāṇāṃ ca vidhiḥ aṅgapradhānasādhāraṇaḥ |
[pṛ. 26] dvitīyo yathā- upadeśena abhīpomīye, atideśena ca savanīyā'nuktravyayoḥ aṅga- bhūtasya yupasya anuṣṭhānasādhāraṇyathā: ‘dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti’ iti apakarṣavidhiḥ iti |
utkarṣavidhiḥ yathā-- ‘āgnimārutāddhvaṃmanuyāje- śaranti’ ‘sa eṣa aupavasathye'han dvevalayaḥ paśūnā- labhyate’ ityagrīpomīyasya krayasaṃnidhau utkarṣaḥ utkarṣa- vidhiḥ |
sādhāraṇavidhivyatiriktako'pi yathā- ‘tiṣṭhantaṃ paśuṃ prayajanti’ iti |
punarapi sāmānyādividheyakādaśakaṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ dvivi- dham- dṛṣṭārthamadṛṣṭārthaṃ ca |
tatra adṛṣṭārthau sāmānyaviśeṣa- vidhī yathā udāhṛtāveva āhavanīyapadavidhi |
dṛṣṭārthau tu somaphalacamasavidhiḥ |
pratiprasavavidhistu udāhṛto dvividho'pi adṛṣṭārtha eva |
dṛṣṭārthastu pratiprasavavidhi- ryathā- ‘paśuṃ saṃjñapayati’ iti |
abhyanujñāvidhistu sarvo'pi dṛṣṭārtha eva, na tu adṛṣṭārtho'pi iti |
upasaṃhāravidhisu pūrvoktaḥ ṛtvarthaḥ: dṛṣṭārthaḥ |
puruṣārthastu pūrvoktaḥ adṛṣṭārthaḥ |
vyavasthāvidhistu prākṛtaḥ: sarvo'pi adṛṣṭārtha eva |
yadyapi vārtanīdhradhanvayoḥ ājyabhāgadevatābhūtāmaprakāśānātha- tvāt dṛṣṭārthaiva tathāpi tulyārthayordvayoḥ vyavasthāvidhiḥ adṛṣṭārtha eva |
dṛṣṭārthau vyavasthāvidhirathā āpastambā- śilādhyādyasyavidhiḥ tatsaṃsthāparyupagotrajñānarūpadṛṣṭārthaḥ ityuktaṃ smṛtyādhikaraṇanyāyamudāhṛtam |
paryudāsavidhisu prāgukto dvividho'pi puruṣārthaḥ adṛ- ṣṭārtha eva |
dṛṣṭārthastu paryudāsaḥ ‘yajatiṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karoti nānūyājeṣu’ iti atra yadyapi anūyājeṣvati- riktaṣu ityeṣo na dṛṣṭārthaḥ tathāpi vidheyayeyajāmahaṃhā
yāgaprakāśakatvena dṛṣṭārthatvāt paryudāsavidhiḥ dṛṣṭārtha ityucyate |
abhāvavidhistu pūrvodāhṛtayormadhye ṛtvartho yaḥ saḥ dṛṣṭārthaḥ: puruṣārthastu adṛṣṭārthaḥ |
sāmānyādividheyakādaśakaṃ punarapi jāti-dravya-guṇa- kriyā-viṣayatvena yathāsaṃbhavaṃ caturdhā |
jātidyādipa- yatvamapi uddeśye, vidheyārthe, ubhayāṃśe ceti jātyādi- viṣayamapi trivyekādaśakaṃ pratyekaṃ trividhaṃ iti dvāviṃśa- duttaraṃ śataṃ bhedā bhavanti |
eṣāmudāharaṇāni anveṣyāṇi granthagauravabhayāt na pradarśitāni |
[pṛ. 22] vidhiḥ punarapi aṣṭavidhaḥ- (1) dhātvarthamātravidhiḥ (2) saguṇādhātvarthavidhiḥ (3) kiñciduddidya dhātvarthavidhiḥ (4) tatraiva viśiṣṭadhātvarthavidhiḥ (5) dhātvarthoddeśena anyavidhiḥ (6) dhātvarthe anyayoḥ saṃbandhavidhiḥ (8) dhātvarthāṃnuraktena pratyayena anyayoḥ saṃbandhavidhiḥ (8) muktvā dhātvarthe anyayoreva saṃbandhavidhiḥ |
atra dūṣaṇabhūpaṇaṃ dvitīyādhyāyāprastāve vakṣyate |
vidhiḥ punarapi trividhaḥ- apūrvavidhiḥ, niyamavidhiḥ, parisaṃkhyāvidhiḥ |
trividho'pyasau caturvidhaḥ- jāti- vidhiḥ, dravyavidhiḥ, guṇavidhiḥ kriyāvidhiśceti |
tatra jāterapūrvavidhiyathā- ‘khādiraṃ vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kuryāt’ iti |
dravyasyāpūrvavidhiyathā- ‘godohena paśukāmasya praṇayet’ iti godohanadravyasya yaugikatvena dravyatvāt |
guṇasyāpūrvavidhiyathā- ‘yadi kāmayeta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāt nīcaiḥ sado minuyāt’ iti |
kriyāyā apūrvavidhiyathā- ‘agnihotraṃ juhoti’ iti |
devatāvidhiḥ, homādhikaraṇabhūtāhavanīyadāvidhiśca apūrvavidheva antarbhūtaḥ |
devatāyāḥ yāgasiddhayā dṛṣṭārthatve'pi vidheyapramāṇatvāt |
āhavanīyadāvidheya adhikaraṇatvena dṛṣṭārthave'pi homavidhanā anākṣitatvena adṛṣṭārthatvasya ādhārāmihotrādhikaraṇavārtike uktatvāt |
tadevaṃ dvividho'pi apūrvavidhiḥ dṛṣṭārthaḥ: adṛṣṭārthaśca |
devatāvidhirapi taddhita-caturthī-mantravarṇa-dvitīyā-artha- vādabhedāt pañcavidhaḥ |
tatrānye sphuṭāḥ |
ārthavādikaḥ arthavādabhedeṣu vakṣyate |
adhyayanavidhirapi apūrvavidhiḥ: dṛṣṭārthaśca |
nahi ayaṃ niyamaḥ |
apūrvavidhiḥ punarapi dvividhaḥ- ṛtvarthaḥ: puruṣārthaśca |
tatrādyo yathā- [pṛ. 23] ‘samidho yajati’ ityādiḥ |
dvitīyo yathā- ‘agnihotraṃ juhoti’ ityādiḥ |
niyamavidhisu trividhaḥ- pratinidhiniyamaḥ, prati- pattividhiḥ, tadubhayavyatiriktaśceti |
pratinidhiniyamo- 'pi tāvat apūrvavidhivadeva jāti-dravya-guṇa-kriyā- viṣayatvena caturvidhaḥ |
tatra jātipratiniyamo yathā- pūtīkavidhiḥ |
dravyapratiniyamo yathā- ‘yadi satrāyā dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyeta yo'sya tasya sthāne dīkṣitā syāt’ iti |
nedigradvadasya yaugikatvena dravyavāci- tvāt |
‘yadyupakṛtaḥ paśuḥ palāyeta anyaṃ tadrayasam’ iti tu kātīyamānāṃ |
guṇapratiniyamo yathā- kātīyamānāṃ kṛṣṇasāraṅgābhāve lohitasāraṅgāvidhiḥ amīpomīye paśau ‘yadi kṛṣṇasāraṅgaṃ na vindedatho lohitasāraṅgaḥ syāt’ iti |
iti datapathāt |
kriyāpratiniyamo yathā- āpastambaḥ- ‘yadi yajamānaḥ prasavet prajā- patervibhānāma lokaḥ’ iti dhruvāyā yajamānabhāga- mavadhāya samidhupayā saha juhuyāt’ iti |
atra homaḥ prakṣepamātra devatā'bhāvāt |
tathā āhitāgniprāpta- pratipatteḥ ‘dakṣiṇe haste juhumāsādayāti’ ityādyāyāḥ pratinidhiḥ patitāhitāgniprāptaye anyaḥ samayeta ‘pātrāṇi tu dadedathau yajamāne vṛthā mṛte’ iti |
tathā dvijā- bhāve śrāddhabhojanasya pratinidhiḥ smaryate |
hemādrau devvalaḥ- ‘nidhāya vā darbhvaṭanāsane samāhitaḥ |
preyānprepsuṃ vidhānaṃ pratipādayet |
nirdiṣṭayāpyatha- mudadhuṣya yatra pātraṃ tato gatiḥ |
pātrābhāve kṣipedathau gave dadyādathāsu vā |
' iti |
pratinidhiniyamaḥ sarvaḥ ṛtvartha eva, na puruṣārthaḥ: api iti na dvividhaḥ |
tathā prati- nidhiniyamaḥ sarvo'pi dṛṣṭārtha eva, nāhadṛṣṭārtho'pi iti na dvividhaścidho veti |
pratipattividhiḥ kriyāvidhivareva, na jātidravyaguṇa- vidhiḥ iti na caturvidhaḥ |
tathā pratipattividhiḥ dravyo- ddeśyaka eva, na jātiguṇakriyoddeśyakaḥ iti na uddeśya- cāturvidhyādapi caturvidhaḥ |
pratipattiḥ punaḥ ṛtvarthaiva [pṛ. 24] na puruṣārtha iti na dvividhataddhiḥ |
prati-
pattividhiḥ punaḥ dṛṣṭārthaḥ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthyatha, nādṛṣṭamātrārthaḥ iti na trividhaḥ |
tatrādyo yathā- 'cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ prāsyati' ityādiḥ |
dvitīyo yathā- sviṣṭakṛdvidhiḥ iti |
pratipattiḥ punaśca dvividhā- sākṣādagniyuktaprati- pādyaviṣayā sākṣādagniyuktopādānānuṣṭhānasiddha- pratipādya- viṣayā ca |
tatrādyā udāhṛtaiva |
dvitīyā yathā- 'śakṛt pravidhyati' iti |
pratinidhipratipattiniyama- vyatireko'pi niyamavidhiḥ pratipattividhivat jñāyā- diviṣayatvena tāvaccaturvidhaḥ |
tatra jāterniyamavidhiyathā- ṛyavākye 'gavā' iti |
gopadeva eva kraya- vākyaṃ ākṛtyadhikaraṇavārtike 'adravyatvādvāt' iti sūtre ananyathāsiddhamanye udāhṛtam |
dravyasya niyama- vidhiyathā- 'ekahāyanā' iti |
guṇasya yathā - 'aruṇā' iti (aruṇā ekahāyanā gavā somaṃ krīṇāti) |
kriyāyā yathā- 'vrīhīnavahanti' iti |
so'yaṃ pratinidhipratipattividhivyatiriktaḥ niyamavidhi

vidhi: pravartanākṣadabhāvanā |
pravṛtti- hetvarthāpāraśca pravartanā |
na ca samīhitasādhyādanya cetanaḥ pravartayituṃ śakyate iti vidhiḥ svasya pravartanātsiddhayartha svabhāvayāthāḥ bhāvanāyāḥ samīhitabhābhyatvaṃ gamyan bhāvanā- karaṇasya samīhitoddeśapravṛttavyāpāragocaratvaṃ gamyati |
uktaṃ ca nyāya ratnamālāyāṃ 'kartuḥ samīhitaṃ yena sidhya- tyaṅgaṃ taducyate |
pramāṇaṃ ca vidhisattra śrutiliṅgādi- saṃyutaḥ |

guṇasaṃbandha eva nāvagatapūrvaḥ, yūpasyālaukikatvāt |
ataḥ kathaṃ taddvāreṇa yūpotpattipaśurniyojanāśrayatvam |
anenaiva vākyena yūpasaṃbandhakaraṇe ca vākyabheda iti |
ucyate- yūpasaṃbandhopasthityā yūpetvataḥ paśuniyojanaṃ vā āśrayaḥ |
prakaraṇaśrutenaiva āśrayeṇa bhavitavyam, nātidiṣṭeneti kimiyaṃ rājājñā buddhiparipravṛttiścātraiva kāraṇam |
sā ca prakaraṇavihitasyaiva codakaprāptasyāpi na viśiṣyate |
tena yatra godohanādī prakaraṇavihitameva labhyate, tatra tathābhūtasyaiva āśrayatvam |
yatra codakaprāptaṃ labhyate, tatra codakaprāptasyaiva |
nāpi yūpasya alaukikatvena audumbaratvasaṃbandho nāvagataḥ |
yataḥ, yadi viśeṣeṇa prakṛtakatvapūrvaṃ yūpasaṃbandho nāvagataḥ, tadā godohanasyāpi prakṛtapūrvayūpasaṃbandhasaṃbandhaḥ pūrve nāvagata eva |
atha tatra sāmarthyataḥ sāmānyena pūrvamevagataḥ, tadā alaukikatve'pi yūpasya kā
ānarthakyam |
tatra avadyaṃ stutiḥ kalpayitavyā |
śama- yitrībhiḥ adriḥ asya avakānāṃ ca saṃnno'yaṃ yajamānasya kathaṃ śamayati iti |
tatsāmānyāt itareṣu 'yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ' ityādiṣu tathātvam |
tathā iti yāvat, tāvat tathātvamiti |
kiṃ tat sāmānyaṃ vidhyasaṃbhavaḥ śrutisaṃbhavaśca |
prakaraṇe saṃbandhaprakarṣo na kalpayeta, vidhyāna- rthakyaṃ hi taṃ prati |
darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇānte 'yo vidvadhaḥ sa nairaṃtaḥ, yo'dutaḥ sa raudraḥ, yaḥ śrutaḥ sa sadaivaḥ, tasmādvidahatā dṛtakṛtyaḥ sadaivatvāyaṃ' ityetadvākye 'yo vidvadhaḥ sa nairaṃtaḥ' ityādiḥ 'avidahatā' ityādividhiśeṣatayā arthavādarūpaṃ cet prakaraṇe svīye darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe evaṃ saṃbhavan san niveśeta, apakarṣaḥ prakaraṇādanya niveśaśca na kalpayeta |
nairaṃtayānumānena vidvadhatva- vidhāne hi tatra svīkriyamāṇe apakarṣaḥ syādeva |
hi yataḥ taṃ prati prakaraṇasaṃnihitaṃ darśapūrṇamāsamuddiśya vidhyānarthakyaṃ vidvadhatvavidheḥ asaṃbhavatvakathaṃ syāt prakṛtayoge nirṛtidevatāviraheṇa nairaṃtapadena prakṛta- karmānuvādāsaṃbhavāt |
iti katūrirajñācāryāḥ |
codadhāre |
kevalastutivādāt satyeva vidvadhasya nairaṃtatvanindayā 'tasmādvidahatā dṛtakṛtyaḥ' iti vidheḥ śeṣībhavan 'yo vidvadhaḥ' iti vākyaśeṣaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prakaraṇe iti |
tena yākāṅkṣākṣaṇe saṃbhavan labhyaniṣedhāḥ san apakarṣaṃ, karmaṇi ghañ, apakṛtyamānaḥ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ vikṛtiṣu nivi- śamāno bhavituṃ na kalpeta (kalpyeta ityasya sthāne) na samartho bhavet |
vidhitvakatve tu vikṛtiṣu apakarṣaḥ prasajyeta iti yāvat |
kutaḥ ? hi yasmāt taṃ prati darśapūrṇamāsa- karmaviśeṣaṃ prati darśapūrṇamāsayoriti yāvat |
vidhyā- narthakyaṃ 'yo vidvadhaḥ sa nairaṃtaḥ' iti vidheḥ asaṃbha- vitvetvam, 'tasmādvidahatā dṛtakṛtyaḥ' iti avi- dāhavidhānena 'yo vidvadhaḥ' ityanuvādasyāsaṃbhavāt |
iti kutūhalam |
nanu 'yo vidvadhaḥ sa nairaṃtaḥ' ityatra yo nirṛti- yāgaḥ tamuddiśya vidadhadravyavidhisaṃbhave arthavādatva- kalpamananyāyyaṃ ata āha |
prakaraṇe darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe saṃbhavanu niścitamānaḥ arthavādarūpeṇa apakarṣaḥ |
prakaraṇa- viyogaḥ na kalpeta, vidhiprāptaṃ muktvā prakaraṇasaṃbandha- kalpānapakṣo na saṃbhavati |
ataḥ vidhikalpanāyanarthakyaṃ darśa- pūrṇamāse nirṛtiyāgābhāvāt |
iti subodhinivṛttiḥ |
yadi śrutiḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoreva śrutaḥ svātavidhyate |
tathā saṃbhavaprakarṣo na kalpayeta (apakarṣakalpanāprasaṅgo na syāt) |
apakṛṣyate ityapakarṣaḥ |
vidhipakṣe tu yatra nairaṃtaḥ tatra vidadhatā nīyeta (apakarṣaḥ syāt) |
tathā sati prakaraṇaṃ bādhitaṃ bhavet |
darśapūrṇamāsakarma prati (tanetyarthaḥ) nairaṃtatābhāvāt vidadhavidhānaṃ anarthakaṃ syāt |

vidhe: prakaraṇāntare'tideśāt sarvakarma syāt |

vacanena sarvasya prāptītvāt |
yathā 'prajāpatyaṃ caruṃ nirvapetkṛṣṇalamāyuṣkāmaḥ' ityatra caruśabdāt pākaḥ kartavyaḥ |
iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |

dvitīyavarṇake tu pākavat avaghāte'pi kartavyaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
atha tṛtīyaṃ varṇakam |
'vaśvadevaṃ caruṃ nirvaped bhrātṛvyavān taṃ barhiṣadaṃ kṛtvā śāmyā rūpyeṇa vyūhet idamahamamuṃ cāmuṃ ca vyūhāmi iti, yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ dhyāyet, yadapo'vamṛyet yacca sphya ālipset tad viṣṇava urukramāyāvayet' iti śrūyate |
atra viṣṇuḥ uru- kramaḥ āvāhayitavyaḥ |
iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
sūtrākṣarārthaḥ sa eva |
adhivā'bhidhānasaṃskāradravyamarthe kriyeta tāda- rthyāt ||
sattvaṃ prākṛtaṃ vikṛtau kartavyaṃ uta kiṃcit prādhyamapi iti vicāre sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
taṃ nirākartuṃ adhivā-śabdaḥ |
abhidhānasaṃskāradravyaṃ arthe kriyate |
abhidhānaṃ ca saṃskāraśca abhidhānasaṃskārau |
abhidhāna- saṃskārābhyāṃ yuktaṃ dravyaṃ abhidhānasaṃskāradravyaṃ iti uttarapada- lopaḥ |
'svayaṃ ditaṃ barhirbhavati' iti abhidhānayuktaṃ barhirādi dravyam, 'devasya tvā savituḥ prasave |
ādade ' iti ādānasaṃskārayuktaṃ asidrūpaṃ dravyam, arthe uktaṃ- dravyasya prayojane sati kriyeta kartavyam |
tādarthyāt tādṛśaprayojanārthatvāt tasya dravyasya |
arthalope tu dravya- syāpi vikṛtau lopa eva |
iti prathamaṃ varṇakam |
dvitīya varṇake tu kṛṣṇaleṣu avaghātāvādhaḥ kartavyaḥ |
ādita eva vitupatvāt |
sūtrākṣarastu sa eva |
tṛtīya varṇake tu abhidhānasaṃskāro nivartate, prayoja- nābhāvāt |
viṣṇuḥ urukramaḥ nāvāhayitavyaḥ |
teṣāmatrakṣiśatvāt ||

tacca |

vidhe: prayojanavicāraḥ |
prayojanaṃ khalu iha vidheḥ vedaprāmāṇyasiddhirarvā, padārthasaṃgrahapratītirvā, hitāhitasādhanatā'vagamo vā pravṛttinivṛttinimittam |
na tāvat prāmāṇyasiddhiḥ, antareṇāpi vidhiṃ tatsaṃbhavāt |
syādetat, vidhivirahe kāryyatayatā bhūtārthava- gāhino bhūtasya ca mānāntaraviṣayatayā tadapekṣatvādedasya prāmāṇyaṃ vihanyeta, puruṣavākyavat |
tat anupapannam |
atredaṃ tu bhavān pṛṣṭo dhyācakṣvā, yadetat puruṣavacasā- mānāntarāpekṣatvam, tat kiṃ bhūtārthatayā, āhosvit puruṣabuddhiprabhavatayā, na tāvat bhūtārthatayā pratyakṣādīnāma- prāmāṇyaprasakteḥ |
tānyapi hi bhūtārthānyeva |
caityavandanā- divākyasya ca kāryārthābhidhāyino nirapekṣatayā prāmāṇya- prasaṅgāt |
viniyogamātraparametat, na kāryaparaṃ iti ca svatantrasiddhāntaśraddhāmātravijṛmbhitam, na prāmāṇikaṃ iti nivedayiṣyate |
tasmāt vastubhūtaprabhavameva sāpe- kṣatve hetuḥ, tacca bhūtāyai'pi vaidike nāsti iti nāsti sāpekṣatā |
sā ca kāryaniṣṭhānāmapi puruṣavacasām |
tatra prāmāṇyasiddhiḥ artho vidheḥ |
nāpi padārthasaṃgrahapratītiḥ, vinā'pi vidhinā 'syālyāmodanaṃ pacati caitraḥ' iti padārthasaṃgrahapratīte- rupapatteḥ |
yadi manyeta 'vivakṣā'dhīnatvenāni paṃso vacanāni, vivakṣā ca mānāntarādhārādhīnā, mānāntaraṃ ca padārthasaṃsargagocaram, na padārthamātragocaram, iti tatprabhava- tayā puṃvākyānipi padārthasaṃsargameva gocarayanti, na svayaṃvaṃ vedavākyāni apauruṣeyāṇi, iti padārthasaṃsargasiddhayartha vidhireśitavyaḥ' iti, tadyuktam |
vidhāvapi tadanupa- patteḥ |
'tasmin sati tadākāṅkṣānvayaḥ saṃbandhaḥ- padārthānāṃ' iti cet, tadākāṅkṣaiva kutaḥ |
'tadaparyava- sānāt' iti cet, na kriyādiṣvapi sāmyāt |
yathā hi śabdābhihito vidhiḥ viṣayaviniyojyādibhirvinā na paryavasyati, tathā kriyādyo'pi padārthaḥ kārakādi- bhirvinā iti te eva padairupāttāḥ ākāṅkṣāyogyatā- saṃnidhisacīnāśca saṃsargaṃ gamayiṣyanti iti kṛtaṃ vidhinā |
viśiṣṭārthapratītiprayuktatvena ca padānāṃ samabhi- vyāhārasya loke viditatvāt tatsādhayatvācca vaidikārtha- pratīteḥ |
nāpi hitāhitasādhanatā'vagamaḥ |
tasya prayojanaṃ saṃbhavati, 'saṃtāpamapanayati ca tatasya salilāsekaḥ,' 'dahati ca jvalanajvālākalāpāliṅganaṃ' iti vartamānāpa- deśādapi hitāhitasādhanatā'vagamāt |
tataśca īpsā- jihāsābhyāṃ pramāṇāntarādeva pravṛttinivṛttyorupapatteḥ vyartho vidhiḥ iti |
(atrocyate) mā bhuvan anyāni prayojanāni vidheḥ, puruṣārthasādhanatā'vabodhastu vidhinirbandhanaḥ |
na hi 'svargaṃ- kāmo yajeta' iti vidhau asati svargo bhāvanāyā bhāvyaḥ saṃbhavati |
sā hi bhāvyāmātrāpekṣiṇī |
bhavitā ca bhāvyaḥ, yāgādyaśca bhavitāraḥ, iti samānapadopādānatayā prakṛtyartha- tayā ca tadanurūpatayā eva bhāvanāyāḥ pratīteḥ |
svargasya ca padāntaropādānatayā puruṣaviśeṣaṇatayā ca vyavasthānāt tamapahāya yāgādīneva bhāvayatā bhāvanā gṛhyate |
kartavye- kṣitopāyatārūpavidhipyupahitamaryādā punarayaṃ bhāvanā samāna- padopādānamapi prathamāvagatamapi duḥkhākaratayā kartavyape- kṣitamapahāya svargameva bhāgyamavalambate |
samāsā- ditatathāvidhabhāvyatayā ca yāgādīn karaṇatayā svīkaroti iti puruṣārthasādhanatā teṣāṃ siddhā bhavati |
kathaṃ tarhi varta- mānāpadeśyo loke puruṣārthasādhanatā'vagatiḥ ? (uttaraṃ-) pramāṇāntarāvaśāt, na śabdasāmarthyāt |
yathā caitat tathā 'dravyasaṃskārakarmasu' iti ca, 'asādhakaṃ tu tādarthyāt' iti ca vyākhyāna upapādayiṣyati svayamevācāryaḥ |
kaṇikā, pṛ. 2-4. vidhe: procanānapekṣasya pravṛttau asāmarthyāt arthavādasaṃvidhāne ca svayaṃ aparokṣatvāt arthavāda-
sahitasyaiva vidhāyakatvāvagatiḥ iti śaṅkāgranthaḥ |
mevāpūrve kāryamātmā manyate |
prayatna eva bhavitavye prarocanānapekṣatve vidheḥ svaviṣayecchāsādhanatvajñāpana- apūrve prayojakabhūtasya bhāvayitugārama no vyāpāra iti mātreṇa pravartakatvopapatteḥ arthavādābhāve'pi vidhāyakatvā- bhāvanādāvedenocyate |
na ca kāryābhidhānaṃ kṛtimanabhi- virodhaḥ |
... arthavādādinepekṣasya vidhaumātrasya pravṛtti- dadhatāṃ liḍādīnāmupapadyate iti kṛtimpyabhidadhati |
apūrva dāktau api arthavādānarthakyaparihārāmātrārthaṃ arthavādā- ca |
na ca yugapadanekābhidhānaṃ doṣaḥ, tathā avagamāt nyapratītiḥ |

avagato hi pramāṇena liḍādīnāṃ kāryā- sāmarthyena arthavādānanyāt prāgeva vidhyuddeśārthanirṇayāt |
midhāvitā ānuguṇyāt |
kṛterguṇabhūtā pradhānapadavartitva- ...prarocanānapekṣasya asāmarthye'pi arthavādābhāve vidhereva pūrvātmani kārye, avivādā ca kartrādisaṃkhyāvācitā prarocanāśaktyāvirbhāvaḥ |
... vinā'pi tu arthavādena liḍādīnāṃ kāryābhidhāvināmāpi |
na cābhidheyatāmātreṇa vidhaireva prarocanādādhikyatvena vidhāyakatvopapattiḥ |
... bhāvanāyā eva vākyārthatvaṃ bhāvyaṃ apūrve prati guṇāve- arthavādasadbhāvakṛtatvāt prarocanāśaktyapagamasya |

tat karmasahacaritān dharmān ānayati |
teṣu asatsu etat abhidhānaṃ iha na yujyate iti teṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ tatra bhāvo vijñāyate |
evamihāpi prayā- jādīnāṃ darśanaṃ asatyāṃ vaidikyāṃ na yujyate iti tasyā api iha bhāvo vijñāyate |
nanu asati nyāye liṅgakāraṇam |
satyamevam, uktaṃ tu nyāyaḥ bhāgitvāt iti |
yattu dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ laukikī iti, tatra brūmaḥ |
yadyapi dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ syāt, tathāpi vaidikī eva niya- myeta |
katham ? yathā dhenuḥ kiśorina |
tathāyā kṛṣṇa- kiśorā dhenuriti |
yadyapi dhenuśabdo godhenvāṃ dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ, tathāpi abhidhānasāmānyāt aśvadhenvāmapi bhāgi iti kiśorina liṅgena aśvadhenvāṃ vijñāyate |
evamihāpi yadyapi laukikī dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ, tathāpi itikartavyatā- sāmānthena bhāgitvāt liṅgena vaidikī vijñeyā |
utpattīnāṃ samatvād yathādhikāraṃ bhāvaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam— athavā naiva liṅgena niyama iti |
kutaḥ ? utpattīnāṃ samatvāt |
dharmāṇāṃ prayājādīnāṃ upa- ttyaḥ samāḥ |
sarveṣāṃ āmeyādyabhāvena, na parasparasāpekṣatvena |
kimataḥ ? yadi prayājādīnāṃ anugrājādayaḥ aṅgāni syuḥ ; tato 'yatra pradhānaṃ tatrāṅgāni' iti prayāja- darśanaina anugrājādayaḥ anumīyeran |
yadā tu sama- pradhānā ete, tadā prayājadarśanena kāmaṃ prayājā anumīye- ran prayājadharmā vā, na tu anugrājādayaḥ |
tasmāt liṅgamidamākam |
tattu abhidhānavat iti, atra brūmaḥ |
yuktaṃ tat |
yatra hi paraśabdaḥ paratra prayuktaḥ san taddharmā- natidiśati ityuktam |
api ca vidhirasau agnihotravat hotavyamiti |
ayaṃ punaranuvādaḥ |
tenātra prayājādīnāmeva nāsti prāptiḥ, kutaḥ anugrājādīnām |
tasmāt viṣama upanyāsaḥ abhidhānavat iti |
ato yathādhikāraṃ bhāvaḥ syāt, ye dharmā yasyāpūrvasya adhikāre āmnātāḥ te tatraiva bhaveyuḥ |
utpattiḥ śeṣavacanaṃ ca vipratiṣiddhamekasmin |
bhāṣyam— evaṃ tarhi 'sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet' ityanena ākhyātena pradhānasya vidhānotpattiḥ |
śeṣāṇāṃ ca vacanaṃ bhavatu |
kathaṃ kṛtvā ? nāntraṃ pradhānamucyate kasmai cit prayojanāya kalpate iti |
tena ca prāpitānāmajñānāṃ etebhyo liṅgebhyaḥ viśeṣāvadhāraṇaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tatredamucyate 'utpattiḥ śeṣavacanaṃ ca vipratiṣiddhamekasmin' |
ekasmin śabde pradhānasya utpattiḥ, ajñānāṃ ca vacanaṃ na saṃbhavati |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? utpannaṃ hi pradhānaṃ aṅgāni apekṣate |
apekṣayā ca tāni gṛhyante |
tasmāttadapi yuktam |
yadi ca 'nirvapet' ityanena śabdena aṅgānyapi vidhīyeran tataḥ teṣāmapi phalasaṃbandhaḥ syāt, tathā aṅgatvameva vyāhanyeta |
tataḥ ayamapi vādo na ghaṭate |
tasmāt yathokto laukikaḥ evābhyupāyaḥ |
vidhyanto vā prakṛtivaccodanāyāṃ pravartata tathāhi liṅgadarśanam |
bhāṣyam— vidhyanto vā sauryādikāyāṃ codanāyāṃ pravartata, na dharmā laukikāḥ |
kaḥ punarayaṃ vidhyanto nāma ? vidheranto vidhyantaḥ |
atha vidhiḥ kaḥ ? yadvākya- mupalabhya puruṣaḥ kasiddhidhre pravartate, kutaścidvā nivartate sa vidhiḥ |
vidhīyate hi anenārthaḥ |
yathā loke 'devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklām' iti |
tadya 'abhyāja' iti vidhirvādi |
itaraḥ antaḥ |
vede'pi 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' iti vidhyādiḥ |
vidhya- nto'pi pradhānavidhivarjitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ pauroḍāśikaṃ brāhma- ṇam |
tena sameto'yaṃ vidhyādiḥ |
viṣṭiprāptyaninuvṛtti prati puruṣaṃ pravartayati |
tasmāt so'ntaḥ |
tathā 'somena yajeta' iti vidhyādiḥ |
saumikamapi brāhmaṇaṃ vidhyantaḥ |
eṣa vidhyanto nāma |
eteṣu ca sauryādiṣu vidhyādirasti vidhyanto nāsti |
eteṣvapi sa vidhyantaḥ kalpyeta |
kathaṃ kṛtvā ? apari- pūrṇaṃ yat vākyaṃ tat adhyāhāreṇa vā pūrvaita, vyavahita- kalpatayā vā |
tatra adhyāhārāt vyavahitakalpanā jyāyasī |
adhyāhāre hi aśrutaḥ śabdaḥ kalpyeta |
itaratra śrutena saṃbandhaḥ |
tasmāt vyavahito brāhmaṇāvayavaḥ asya paripūrakaḥ kalpyate |
yathā 'vasantāya kapiñjālālabhate'
'śrīpāya kalaviñjālālabhate' iti |
tena vaidikī itikartavyatā prāpyate |
nanu yadi tat brāhmaṇaṃ asya antaḥ kalpyate, tatra na bhavati |
tadetat mayūranṛtyaṃ āpadyate |
tadyathā, mayūrasya nṛtyataḥ anyapātriyate anyat saṃtriyate |
evamihāpi idaṃ saṃtriyate tat apāyriyate |
naiṣa doṣaḥ |
pratyakṣastatra bhāvaḥ |
iha punarānumānikaḥ |
na ca ānumānikaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bādhate |
iha tarhi na prāpnoti, pratyakṣavirodhāt |
syādevam, yadi virodhaḥ syāt |
na tu asti virodhaḥ |
tatrāpi bhaviṣyati ihāpi |
tadetaduktaṃ 'vidhyanto vā prakṛti- vaccodanāyāṃ pravartata' iti (10 sa.) |
ucyate |
prakṛtivaditi kim ? āha, asme prakṛtiniyamaṃ kari- ṣyati, ithamasya prakṛtiriti |
taducyate, vidhyanto vā prakṛtiriva pravartata |
yo yasya karmaṇaḥ prakṛtiriti, yasya āgneyaḥ prakṛtiḥ, tasya āgneyādeva |
yasya agnīṣo- mīyaḥ, tasya agnīṣomīyāditi |
evaṃ sarvatra |
atha kasmāt na laukiko vidhyantaḥ kalpyate ? ucyate |
laukikasya vidheḥ abhāvāt vidhyanta eva nāsti, kutaḥ tatkalpaneti |
āha, laukikī itikartavyatā prāpyatāṃ kiṃ vidhyantakalpaneti |
ucyate |
vaidikī hi atra iti- kartavyatā, na laukikī |
kasmāt ? tathāhi liṅgadarśanaṃ prayājādi samarthanaṃ bhavati |
dup-- kathaṃbhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ yatra itikartavyatā āmnāyate, tatra kathaṃbhāvasya avyāvṛttatvāt codanā sadṛśaṃ vākyaṃ buddhau upasthāpayati |
tad vākyamavabodhitaṃ vākyārthamavabodhayati |
sa ca vākyārthaḥ phalakaraṇetikarta- vyatāyuktaḥ |
tatra phalakaraṇe anākāṅkṣitatvāt na saṃbadhyate |
itikartavyatā tu apekṣitatvāt saṃbadhyate upamitalakṣitaprāpaṇena |
sādṛśyaṃ ca vaidikenaiva bhavati, na laukikeneti |
liṅgahetutvādiliṅge laukikaṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- yadi liṅgāt vaidiko'bhyupāyo bhavati, tena tarhi ? aliṅge laukikaṃ syāt |
yatra karmaṇi kiṃcidliṅgaṃ nāsti, tatra laukikaṃ syādihānam, yathā 'aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet yasya sañjātā vīyuḥ' iti |
liṅgasya pūrvavaccodanāśādasāmānyādenāpi nirūpyeta yathā sthālī pulākena |
bhāṣyam— atrocyate |
syādetadevaṃ yadi liṅga- hetuko vaidika upāyaḥ syāt |
na tu atra liṅgahetukaḥ |
kiṃ hetustarhi ? vidhyantahetukaḥ |
vidhyanto'pi nyāya- pūrvaḥ |
sa ca nyāyastulyaḥ sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ vaikṛtānāṃ liṅgavatāṃ aliṅgavatāṃ ca |
kutaḥ ? nodanāśabda- sāmānyāt |
karmacodanāyāṃ śabdaḥ samānaḥ |
sarvatra vidhyādirasti, na vidhyantaḥ |

tadvicchaliḍādarthasya tu sarvatra dhātvarthe eva, nañaḥ asattve dhātvarthe iti gurubhūtānekasamabhivyā- hāraśānakāryakāraṇabhāvakalpanāpattiḥ |
evaṃ 'yaṭo nāsti' 'na pacati caitraḥ' ityādau liḍādisamabhivyāhārābhāve nañarthasya abhāvasya āśraye prathamāntapadasyāpye anvayaḥ, liḍādisamabhivyāhārasattve 'tu dhātvarthe eva iti dhyutpannenatvam |
tathā ākhyātāthasya kṛtyādeḥ nañaḥ asattve ākhyātasaṃbandhena prathamāntapadasyāpye, tattvale tadarthe pratiyogitāvattvasaṃbandhena iti gurubhūtāḥ kāryakāraṇa- bhāvāḥ |

tadvat ihāpi viṣayitāviśeṣasya pravṛttiprayojakatāvacche- dakatvaṃ liṅādidaśakatāvacchedakatvaṃ ca |

yatra 'kalañjabhakṣaṇaṃ atisādhanam' iti vākyāt aniṣṭasādhanatvādidhāvabodhaḥ tatra tajjanya- anumitirjanayati nāśāviśeṣaṇam |
aniṣṭasādhanatvasyaikā- nuvidhāvityādihetvantarajanyatvāniṣtasādhanatvānumitijanya- saṃjñananāśakālīnapravṛttayabhāvādāyā tādṛśaprayogāpatti- vāraṇāya svaviṣayaketyādi |
atra nirūpasaṃkrayena nivāra- ṇāprayojyābhāvavartamānātādṛśaprayogāpattiḥ |
ataḥ svaviṣayakajñānam svadhvaṃsasamānakālīnasvajñānopadheyameva viśiṣya tattadvyaktitvena praviṣṭaṃ iti jñānāya viśeṣapadam |
atra prathamaṃ svapadaṃ pravṛttikāraṇatāvacchedakībhūtatatsambandha- vyaktiparam, dvitīyaṃ svapadaṃ tu pūrvavat liṅgādisattadvyakti- param |
tena niṣkrasambandhasyasamānakālīnaliṅgādisāno- padheyahetujñānajanyāmitijanya ityādiḥ phalito'rthaḥ |
evaṃ ca anumititvasya viśiṣṭāpatterapi na kṣatiḥ |

yadā
vyatirekagamyeti na prāmāṇikī kāryateti yuktametat |
kintu evaṃ sati suduḥkhaparihāraniriteṣu tatsādhanatva pravṛttikāraṇamaṅgīkṛtaṃ syāt |
tataśca 'gāmānaya' ityatra gavānayanasya suduḥkhaprāptiparihāratvābhāvāt pravṛtti- hetubhūtāṃ kāryatāmabhidadhāno vidhiśabdaḥ samīhita- sādhanatāmabhidhāyī syāt |
tena kāryaṃ gavānayanaṃ kyahaṃ yathāvidhe puruṣāṇāṃ kṛtiḥ pravartate tathāvidhamityarthaḥ |
tathā- vidhatā tāvacca svayaṃ samīhitatayā saṃbhavatīti tatsādhanataiva pariśeṣyāt kāryavācinā śabdenābhihitā bhavati |
tathā ca vede'pi apūrvasya svayaṃ suduḥkhaparihārarūpatvā- bhāvāt tatsādhanataiva kalpyetati kāryarūpamabhidadhāno liṅ satīhitasādhanatāmevābhidadhyāditi naimittikaniṣedhā- dhikārayorapi sādhanarūpāpūrvābhidhānāt tadvailenāśvatamapi phalaṃ kalpanīyaṃ syāt |
nanu na sutralaṃ kāryatvam, tatsā- dhane'pi bhāvāt |
na sādhanatvam, sukhe'pi bhāvāt |
tadubhayānugataṃ kāryabuddhyāvalambanaṃ kāryatvaṃ nāma pravṛttikāraṇa- miti |
maivam |
na hi sādhane kāryatvaṃ nāma kiñcit pravṛttivelāyāmuttarakāle vā pratyakṣaṇāvagamyate ityuktam |
ato nāstyubhayānugataḥ kāryatvaṃ nāma kaściddharmaviśeṣaḥ |
kartavyaśabdastu ayamekopādhivaśāt ubhayatra pravartate, nad dravyamapi sādhyamānaṃ stoddeśena puruṣaṃ pravartayatīti anenaivopādhinā kāryaśabdapravṛttiḥ |
tasmāt kāryatā- nagatiḥ kriyāyāṃ pravṛttikāraṇam, api tu samīhitasādha- natvajñānam |
bhavatu vā samīhitasādhanatvopapannameva kārya- tvam |
tattu kriyāyā evābhidhātavyam |
tataiva pravṛttidha- nāt |
satyaṃ loke kriyaiva kāryatayā śabdena pratipādyate, vede tu phalakāminiyojyānuyānuguṇyāttviṣyarega kārya liḍā- dibhirabhidhīyate iti cenmaivam, kriyāyāmapi kāminaḥ kāryatāvagamavirodhāt |
nāsti phalasādhanībhavituṃ samarthā bhaṅguratvāt, iti cenna, apūrvadvāreṇopapatteḥ |
nānyadvāre- ṇāpyasya sādhanatvaṃ saṃbhavati atiprasaṅgāt |
avā- ntaravyāpāre vā śaktirvā sādhanatvamupapādyate nāpu- rvam |
tathā śaktimati vyāpāravati vā'tīte śakti- vyāpārayoḥ sthityanupapatteriti cet, kimidānīṃ kāṣṭhānāṃ pākasādhanatvaṃ nāsti tatrāpi hi kāṣṭhebhyastejasāḥ paramāṇavaḥ samudbhūtāḥ sthālyudaramanupraviśantaḥ taṇḍulān vikledayanti |
na ca teṣāṃ dravyarūpāṇāṃ kāṣṭhāvāntaravyāpāratvaṃ tacchaktitvaṃ vā samastīti na tadvāreṇa kāṣṭhādīnāṃ sādhanabhāvaḥ syāt |
mā bhūditi cenna, sarvalokaprasiddhi virodhāt |
'kāṣṭhaiḥ pacati' iti nivivādaprayogatvāt |
tasmāt yadeva yena samīhitaphalahetvāpannaṃ tadupāyatvabhūtamanantarā sādhyate tadeva tasyāvāntarasyāpāratvena abhidhīyate |
tena saṃbha- vatyevāpūrvasya karmāvāntaravyāpāratvam |
yadi caivaṃ neṣyate tato'pūrva prapya sādhanatvaṃ karmaṇo na syāt |
tadapi na karmāntaraṃ jāyate svecchayāyuttaratannānuṣṭhānapratī- kṣaṇāt |
tatrāvadyamyutpatyapūrvāṇi avāntaravyāpāratvenai- pitavyāni |
utpatyapūrvāṇyeva kāraṇānāni, na yāgādīni, iti cet, na, asiddhatvācchabdādarthatvāt |
adhikāravākye phalakāminiyojyānyanuguṇāpūrvābhidhā- yitve sthite paścādāgneyādivākye'pyapūrvābhidhānasiddhiḥ |
prākta lokavagatakriyābhidhāyitvameva teṣu saṃbhavatītya- siddhatvādyutpatyapūrvāṇāṃ na paramāpūrvasādhana-vena anvaya- saṃbhavaḥ |
na ca yajaterapyabhidhāyitvam, yenāvā- ntarapūrvāṇāṃ pratyayārthaparamāpūrve prati kāraṇatvaṃ syāt |
tasmāt yajiriva karaṇam |
kiñca kāryatvamevā- pūrvasyopapadyate kṛtisādhyaṃ hi kāryamucyate |
kṛtitva puruṣaprayatnaḥ |
na ca prayatnasādhyatā apūrvasya saṃbhavati, ciravinaṣṭe prayatne tadutpādāt |
prayatnena hi yāgaḥ, tato'vāntaravyāpāratvaṃ, tataḥ paścāt adhikārāpūrvam, tasmāt kāryatvānupapatterna kāryābhidhāyitvavācatā apūrvasya saṃbhavati |
tatrāvadyaṃ prayatnasādhyatvamapūrvasya yāgāntarapūrvadvāreṇāśritavyam |
tadat yāgasyāpi phala- sādhanatvamapūrvadvāre kimiti neṣyate ? mā vā bhūt phalasādhanaṃ kriyāpūrva sādhanaṃ tāvadatraiva, tāvatāpi kāryatayā tāmavagantumarhatyeva puruṣaḥ, yasmin akṛte samīhitaṃ na prāpyate, kṛte ca prāpyate sākṣādapāḍyā vā tadeva kāryatayā budhyate, na tu sākṣāt bhāvaviśeṣa- statropayogī |
avaśyaṃ ca kāminaḥ kriyāmapi kāryā- vagatiriṣyate |
kathamantyathā svatantraḥ pravartate |
satyam, asyeva tatrāpi kāryavagatiḥ, na tu śābdī kintarhi
ārthī, kāmānuguṇāpūrvasādhanatvāt |
tāmapi kāryatayā kāmī pratipadyate, iti cenna, vikalpasahatvāt |
ki phala- prasūtā kāryāvagatiḥ kriyāyāmutpatyapūrvaprasūtā |
na tāvadapūrva- prasūtā, kāmyepu vidheranuṣṭhāpakatvānupagamāt |
yadi hi vidhinibandhanā kāryāvagatiḥ kriyāyāḥ syāt, tato vidhiśiktānuṣṭhānatayā karaṇāśrasyāpi vidheyatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
phalaprasūtatvamapi bhavaduktyā nītyā na sidhyati, na hi phala- kāmaḥ puruṣaḥ kṣaṇikaṃ karma kāryatayā avagantumalam |
tasyāḥ sākṣātsādhanatvāyogyāt apūrvasya cāvāntaravyāpāratvā- bhāvāt tadvāreṇāpyasādhanatvāt |
sādhanasādhane ca sādhyārthinaḥ kāryāvagamānupapatteḥ |

(śaṅkate -) idaṃ tarhi kathaṃ (bhāṣyoktaṃ -) 'prayojakaḥ kaścit puruṣārthaḥ ; aprayo- jakaḥ kratvarthaḥ' iti |

) sūtre tu puruṣecchādhīnapravṛttiḥ puruṣārthaḥ ; kratuvidhedhīnapravṛttiśca kratvartha iti |

yo hi yadicchati sa tat karoti iti bhāvanāyāḥ prārambha icchā |

(sūtraṃ vivṛṇoti -) arthyamānaṃ prati puruṣavyāpāraḥ ābhimukhyena saṃbadhyate ataḥ arthanayogāt svargādeḥ tatkarmatayā abhisaṃbandhaḥ; anyathā- 'nvayāt |
ato na kevalaṃ 'yajeta' iti phalāpekṣatvāna (vidhyupahitāyā bhāvanāyāḥ) api tu svargādeḥ (kami- yogāpāditasādhyabhāvasya) anyathāsaṃbandhāt |
tathā ca saṃbandhāt kathaṃ svarga prati sādhanatvena gamyate ||
(yaṅkate -) kathaṃ punaḥ svargasyānviśepaṇasya bhāvanābhisaṃbandhaḥ, tadsaṃnve vā anyaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ katham mamāno vā |

tathā 'daṇḍī paipānvayāha' iti daṇḍa pradhāno daṇḍī (yathā 'maitrāvaruṇaḥ paipānvayāha' iti paipānvayatvena maitrāvaruṇasya prāpte 'daṇḍī paipānvayāha' iti maitrāvaruṇasyaiva viśeṣavidhinānupapatteḥ viśeṣaṇamya daṇḍasya cāprāptervidheyatvān tatpare daṇḍidravyaḥ, tathaiha 'yajeta' iti bhāvanākṣepādeva bhāvayituḥ prāptervidheyatvāt bhāva- viśeṣapekṣatvācca bhāvanāyāḥ, svargasya ca puruṣaviśeṣaṇa- syāprāptatvāt kamikarmatvā ca bhāvayitvāt anya- tatrāprāpteḥ tatparā svargakāmaśrutiriti ), tadabhisaṃbandhī tu tatparaḥ (bhāvanāsaṃbandharaḥ) svātmanā avivakṣita eva |
evaṃ ca samāso'pi upapannaḥ |
svatantrasya hi anyasaṃbandhe tadasaṃbhavāt (puruṣasaṃbandhāsaṃbhavāt) sāpekṣatvāt samāso na syāt : tadabhisaṃbandhe tu (puruṣasaṃbandhena) taddvārā- anyasaṃbandhe nairbhāvyabhāvāparodhena iti yuktaḥ manāsaḥ |
anyathā sarvameva viśeṣaṇaṃ asamāsaṃ syāt |
tasya kāryamaṃsuto vaiyarthyāt |
saṃpratye vā sāpekṣatvāt (bhavanmate -) samāso bhavet |
yatra āmnāyārthe sādhyasādhanamanvayaḥ : (sādhyā- ntarasya svargāderasanmavāyaḥ) iti |
(dūṣaṇati -) bhāva- nāyāṃ tāvat rūpādeva tatsamāvāyaḥ (sādhyasaṃbandhaḥ) |
tasyā bhāvyamānatvāt |
dhātvarthe'pi tasya tādarthyena bhāva- nāyāḥ (dhātvarthasya) sādhyatvaṃ tat vidhināpāstam |
atha (anyārthavacana -) bhāvanāpadamātram |
tatra kāraṇāttve'pi (pakṣādiṣu) samānam |
uktaṃ hi 'karṇa
vidhiviveka:
nanu sarvatra katrtravyāpāragocaraḥ ' iti (bhāvanāviveka -) |
na ca tātmajñānanupravedakatvanāca |
na ca dṛṣṭameva prayojanaṃ dravyaguṇaśabdādarthasvarūpato'pi (dravyaguṇaśabdādarthaviśeṣatva dhātvarthasya rūpato'pi) niṣpādyasya sādhanatvāt (prāga- siddheḥ) siddhasyopādānābhāvāt (godohanādīnāṃ tu anyataḥ siddhārthānāṃ sattāmupādānāt) |
śrutyaiva bhāvanāmanurajyatā yāgādeḥ tadviśeṣaṇatva pratīteḥ (bhāvanāyā viśeṣaṇasya pratīteḥ : sādhyatvāvagamaḥ |
yadapi coditam, sarvābhimata- sādhanatvena karmaṇe guṇabhāvāt guṇapradhānabhāvena dvaividhyaṃ hīyeteti tatrāha -) dvividhatvaṃ tu apūrvabhāvābhāvakṛtam |
puruṣaprayatnasya yāgādiviṣayatvaṃ svarge (sādhye) api aviruddham, dṛṣṭe iva cchedye paraśuviṣayatvam |
na ca yāgādervyāpāratvaṃ śabdādeva (sādhanatayā) tatpratīteḥ |
jñānapradāpādīnāṃ notpatterapi vyāpāratvābhyupagamāt |
( yathoktaṃ ' svargaṃ kuryāt ' ityaśakyopadeśa iti, tadupapannam, dvidhā hi bhavati kriyānarhatā atyanta- sattvāt gaganavat, atyantasattvādvā tatpuṇyavat |
na caita- dubhayamapi svargādau samastītyāha -) na ca svargo nityaḥ, atyantamasattvāt yenātraśakyaḥ |
upāyājñānāt iti cet (pariharati -) ata eva sa (upāyaḥ -) jñāpyate (vidhinā, ataśca jñātopāyaḥ śakyo bhaviṣyatīti) |
na cāvadyakartavyatāprasaṅgaḥ (svargādeḥ) phalaśiṣṭanuvādāt karaṇādoṣasaṃhārācca vibeḥ, ' dadhnā juhoti ' iti yathā |
(na vayamācakṣmahe na phalavidhayeti, kiṃtu taduddeśyatvāt ) phalavidhayāyā eva pravṛtteḥ yāgaviṣayatvena (aprāptatvāt |
) śabdo hetuḥ (pramāṇaṃ) iti yāgo vidhīyate |
nahi anyā puruṣasya karmaṇi pravṛttiḥ, anyā karaṇe, karaṇe eva pravṛttaḥ phalapravṛtto bhavati, karmaṇaiva (phale) pravartta- mānaḥ karaṇe pravarttate |
tadevaṃ arthāvagamamātra vaiyarthyam |
nāpyanyat (ātmajñānādhikārānuveśaḥ) prayojanam |
' svargakāmo yāgaṃ kuryāt ' iti yāganiṣṭhe śabde taruṇatvāt (tatraiva tātparyasamavāyāt) apramāṇatvāt (ātmajñānādhikārānapraveśasya |
tatparatve vā -) śruta- hānāt aśrutakalpanācca (śrutāgakartavyatāhānāt aśru- ātmapratipattiḥ, karmabhiḥ kṛtakāmanirvahaṇe dānatvena kāme- ranāgaditamanasā ātmatattvasya suprāpyatvāt |
yadi khalu kāmanirvahaṇāni karmāṇi, taiśca kṛtī na prayojanāntarama- pekṣate kāmī, tathā ca tatpara eva karmetividhiḥ iti nānyaparatve pramāṇam (kāmanānepekṣatvāt) |
na cā- śāstravam, śreyo'bhidhāyakatvāt śreyasaḥ prītirūpatvāt, prīteśca kāmeṣu prayātasaṃvaidyatvāt |
na ca bhogo nirvaha- ṇam, nahi kāmānāṃ tṛptirasti |
atha pravṛttyantaranivṛttyā, tatrāpi yadi kāmī yāgena kuryāt nānyenopāyena kāmam, ko viśeṣaḥ kāmapakṣe (kāmākṣepe iti kaṇikāyām) caitanaḥ kāmanivṛttyāyāṃ pravṛttau, kathaṃ ca pakṣe'pi aprāptavidhau anyanivṛttiḥ |
atha kāmī yāgaṃ kuryāt kāmam, (uttaraṃ -) durlabhamarthadvayaṃ avi- deṣataḥ śrautalakṣaṇikādikam |
(yāgaṃ kuryāditi śraute saṃbhavati, na kāmanivṛttilakṣaṇikī yuktā āśritu- miti ) yāgavidhiparatve na kāmaniṣedhaḥ, kāmaniṣedha- paratve na yāgavidhiḥ |
arthāta (arthāpatyā) kāma- nivṛttiḥ (iti cenna) ubhayasyāpyasamavāyāt |
sarvadṛṣṭā- yeṣupravṛttitirodhe na karmavidhikte'pi apārthakāḥ syuḥḥ dṛṣṭopāyasādhyatvāt tadarthasya (yāgādeḥ) |
svābhāvika- tvācca phalopabhogasya svabhāvatvāt evāmnāyārthaḥ : chadmanā āśritaḥ syāt |
tasmāt mahadaṇḍapadamidaṃ ' dṛṣṭenaiva karmavidhayaḥ : ātmajñānādhikārārohanti ' iti |
niyojyā- nuśāsanaṃ śāstrasya iti jñānaniyogo'pi niyojyānu- śāsanamayaṃ iti na tata ātmapratipattiḥ |
(śaṅkane -) jñānasvabhāvādāditi cet, (nirākaroti -) vidhivaiya- rthyāt |
athānyatvādidaṃ iti cet, na, niyamārthatvāt (avahantyādividheḥ) |
na jñānaviśeṣaṇatvam, pakṣe'pi aprāpteḥ |
samāropeṇa ca saṃbhavāt na tattvaparicchedaḥ |
(upasaṃharati -) tasmātsādhane dhātvarthe adhikāra- siddhiḥ |
sādhanatvaṃ cāsya vidhiḥ ityuktam ||
vidhivi- vekaḥ samāptaḥ |
